apps.name: AnimaEngine
apps.short_description:
Elevate your desktop with Anima Engine!

Customize with animations, APNGs, GIFs, images, videos, and audio in formats like MP4, WEBP, and more. Use AI tools to edit visuals, remove backgrounds, and create a style that's uniquely yours.

The only limit is your imagination!

apps.name: AudioCat
apps.short_description:
AudioCat makes it easy to mix your microphone, soundboard clips, and selected app audio into one virtual input. Share
  music, videos, and sound effects through Discord, OBS, games, calls, and more—with simple controls for every source.

apps.name: Aurel Voice
apps.short_description: AUREL Voice is an AI audio software that turns any headset microphone into a studio-grade setup. Get real-time noise removal, auto-calibration, and 1-click tone control for Discord, OBS & games. Runs 100% locally on your PC — no cloud, no account.

apps.name: Beamline
apps.short_description: Bring curated CRT, LCD and VHS looks into supported games. Set up a game in Beamline, launch it as usual, and tune the picture from the in-game overlay.

apps.name: Blender
apps.short_description: Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite. Free to use for everyone, for any purpose.

apps.name: BordQ
apps.short_description: Soundboard, AI voice changer, live browser audio, and phone remote — one Windows app, one payment. Works with Discord, OBS, Zoom, and any game. No subscription.

apps.name: Crosshair X
apps.short_description: Improve your aim and accuracy in every shooter you play. Crosshair X overlays a custom crosshair on top of any game, even games that do not include one. Choose from thousands of community designs or build your own with the designer.

apps.name: Cursor Flux
apps.short_description: Add motion blur, trails, and glow effects to your cursor for a smoother, more stylish pointer that fits your setup without changing your workflow.

apps.name: Dashvera HUD
apps.short_description: Dashvera HUD is a customizable Windows 11 desktop utility for monitoring CPU, RAM, GPU, and storage information. Keep essential system readings in view, personalize your HUD, and access useful tools including a built-in clock and calculator.

apps.name: GammaBoost+
apps.short_description: The #1 display control tool for gamers: make games brighter, more vibrant, and easier to see in the dark. Adjust gamma, brightness, contrast, digital vibrance, and color in real time — one-click presets, per-game profiles, LUT import/export, OBS sync, Stream Deck, and eye care.

apps.name: Gantry VR
apps.short_description:
Somewhere to watch. A video player for the Steam Frame, running natively on the headset. Plays your own
files, from the headset or your network: flat, 3D, 180 and 360. Watch from a gas station at night, under the
aurora, or in orbit. Nothing leaves your network.

apps.name: Graphmat
apps.short_description: GraphMat is a real-time material editor that combines node-based workflows with familiar layers, giving you a fast and flexible way to design and export seamless PBR textures for games and 3D projects. A capable, affordable alternative for developers and artists.

apps.name: Gunstock Buddy
apps.short_description: Align your VR gunstock, smooth tracking jitter, and save setups for your games and weapons, all without leaving SteamVR. Supports Windows PC VR and Steam Frame, both standalone and when streaming from a PC.

apps.name: HereSphere VR Video Player
apps.short_description: HereSphere is a cutting edge VR video player that enhances immersion. Features include an autofocus depth algorithm, software IPD adjustment, head-tracking, spatial audio, lens distortion and alignment corrections, online video streaming, and video tagging with advanced search features.

apps.name: HudSight - crosshair overlay
apps.short_description: Create unique crosshairs for any game! Choose from many built-in crosshairs or download from the Steam Workshop, and create your own. User-friendly interface, anti-cheat compatible. Customize your gaming experience!

apps.name: IKANDY: Music Visualizer
apps.short_description: Sold as a music visualizer, built as a real-time visual engine. Five render engines behind one HDR finish, over 500 reactive visuals, MilkDrop on our own engine, AI and shader creation, and a shared moon. Free to play. Pro adds creation and outputs.

apps.name: Instant Song Creator
apps.short_description: A music production studio with AI-assisted composition. Describe a song, generate music and sound effects locally on your PC with Stable Audio 3, then arrange, mix and export in a full multitrack workspace.

apps.name: Lily2D
apps.short_description:
A code-first 2D Game Engine featuring fast iteration using Swamp - a sleek, deterministic, custom script language. 
Lily2D has shader-based rendering, software synth for music and sound effects, networking, input handling and multi-platform export.

apps.name: Morphic
apps.short_description: Live wallpapers for Windows: scenes, videos, images, web pages and audio on your desktop. A built-in editor with particles, effects and keyframes, scheduled playlists, auto-pause in games, and Steam Workshop. A lightweight native engine that's easy on your system.

apps.name: Mouse X
apps.short_description: You look at your mouse every single day. Personalize it with Mouse X. Use custom live cursors on your desktop, and share your own custom cursor skins on the Steam Workshop!

apps.name: Notched
apps.short_description: Stay on top of everything with an elegant Windows hub featuring music controls, live lyrics, weather, calendar, and real-time system and game widgets.

apps.name: OyasumiVR
apps.short_description: Software that helps you sleep in virtual reality. OyasumiVR detects when you are asleep and automates various tasks and settings to make VR sleeping as comfortable as possible.

apps.name: Room Planner - Design Home 3D
apps.short_description: If you just bought a house or an apartment or want to decorate your existing property, we can help you do it easier, with less hustle and achieve better results in less time for the little fraction of total expense.

apps.name: RPG Architect
apps.short_description: Want to build a game, but not sure where to start?  Focus on designing your game and let RPG Architect do the rest!  We've abstracted most of the nitty-gritty stuff out so you can focus on building your next great adventure!

apps.name: Stream Avatars
apps.short_description: Stream Avatars is a content creation tool for live video broadcasting that adds flair to your video to promote viewer engagement and channel growth! Viewers can also spend their hard-earned stream currency on avatar customizations.

apps.name: SVFI
apps.short_description: SVFI: Squirrel Video Frame Interpolation. An app to enhance your low-fps video or image sequence into high framerate footage with AI

apps.name: Tessera Start Menu
apps.short_description: The full-screen Windows 10 Start menu, back on Windows 11. Pin apps, files and shortcuts straight from File Explorer, sort them into named groups, and keep it all over blurred wallpaper or live acrylic.

apps.name: TrueHands
apps.short_description: TrueHands is a SteamVR overlay utility that renders your real hands and arms directly into VR in the color of your choice, so that chroma key/pass-through solutions can show your hands on your steering wheel, flight stick, or other controls while staying fully immersed in any VR experience!

apps.name: UNREFERENCE - Image Privacy Tool
apps.short_description: UNREFERENCE is a local desktop application for photo batching, metadata removal, and pixel-level privacy. Convert, crop, and watermark files while stripping EXIF, GPS, and camera history—or apply subtle sensor-level adjustments to disrupt tracking. Fast, private, and 100% offline.

apps.name: VR Gigapixel Gallery
apps.short_description: Free: Put your own photos from your PC on the wall in VR – in full resolution, as TIFF up to 4 GB. Your images stay on your PC. Plus thousands of Gigapixel images at true size in the designer house or neutral room, with a ppi traffic light for print quality.

apps.name: VR180 SyncPro
apps.short_description: VR 3D video tool with a synchronized VR player and preset workflows for GoPro models. Play left/right videos in a headset. Auto pairing, multidimensional sync, half-frame adjustment, gyro stabilization, auto/manual horizon calibration, lens/FOV controls and RTX deblur, from footage to export.

apps.name: Wallpaper Engine
apps.short_description: Use stunning live wallpapers on your desktop. Animate your own images to create new wallpapers or import videos/websites and share them on the Steam Workshop!

apps.name: 标记朋友
apps.short_description: MarkFriends is a free Windows desktop tool. Send question marks, cheers and sound emotes to friends with hotkeys or wheels. Join Steam rooms for up to 8 people, choose random or mouse-position placement, and use the interface in 14 languages.

apps.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard Playtest
Chess Variant: Chase The King Playtest
Mushroom Man and the Problematic Pizza Parlour Playtest
Raid Lead - Echoes of Gaia Playtest
Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil Playtest
The Circle of the Time Playtest
The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em Playtest
theHunter: Call of the Wild™ Playtest
Trust Me, I Work Here Playtest
A Red Specter Haunts the World – Free Sample
apps.short_description: Build a highly organized Communist Party with iron discipline; seize power through armed struggle; liberate all oppressed people; and march toward the fulfillment and realization of the Party’s highest goals and ultimate ideals

apps.name: Abalon Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactics and deckbuilding game that challenges you to command your favorite fantasy characters in novel ways. Explore an open world of ever-changing adventures where a roll of the dice can change your fate. Master your strategy to achieve the most satisfying victories.

apps.name: Absolute Dap Demo
apps.short_description: Dap up your friend and fight bizarre bosses together! Absolute Dap is a co-op action boss rush about two best friends trying to stop an alien invasion from ruining their friend's first date. The game is ridiculous. The friendship isn't.

apps.name: Abyssal Merge Demo
apps.short_description: Abyssal Merge is a chaotic bullet heaven roguelite where multitasking is your only hope of survival. As a lone captain in a monster-infested ocean, you must fight off waves of enemies while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net to unlock game-breaking weapon synergies.

apps.name: Age of Sail Demo
apps.short_description: Set sail across dangerous seas in this co-op pirate adventure. Trade goods, fish for resources, upgrade your ship, and battle ruthless pirate NPCs as you build the ultimate vessel.

apps.name: Airport Control 27 Demo
apps.short_description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

apps.name: Alice's World Demo
apps.short_description: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

apps.name: Alien Archeologist Demo
apps.short_description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

apps.name: All Haul the King Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

apps.name: Animals League Unite Demo
apps.short_description: Play the whole first world: 10 Meadow levels for 2 to 8 players, on one screen or online. Stack up, shout, fall together, then make your own levels in the level editor.

apps.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest Demo
apps.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

apps.name: Apococlicks Demo
apps.short_description: Dark horror post-apocalyptic incremental clicker game

apps.name: Apple Crumble Demo
apps.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

apps.name: Architecture & Design Demo
apps.short_description: Try the Demo: draw a floor plan, raise walls, place doors and windows, then furnish and paint every surface on a beach lot, with a selection from the furniture catalogue. Everything uses real measurements and is fully parametric. The full game adds many more functions, objects and much more to come!

apps.name: Ashburrow Demo
apps.short_description: Descend alone or with up to five friends into a gnoll warren where death ends the run but not the story. Fight with blade, shield and spell, bank your gold into permanent unlocks, and hire militia to hold the gate when the clan musters to take it back.

apps.name: Ashen Swarm Demo
apps.short_description: Turn deadly sins into weapons in this gothic bullet heaven roguelite demo. Keep your Oath or embrace Corruption, claim lasting artifacts through your choices, and survive until the court arrives at 13:13. Two heroes. Three stories that continue across runs.

apps.name: ASUKA x Redline Reverie Demo
apps.short_description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

apps.name: AuraFalls Demo
apps.short_description: Try Aura Falls free. Roll around the island hub with up to three friends, survive waves of robots together, bowl a strike in a neon alley, and settle it one-on-one in the ring. Everything you earn carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Bad Pig House Demo
apps.short_description: You lost your piggy family... Rebuild your home to stay safe.

apps.name: Banana Airways Demo
apps.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

apps.name: Beatrix Demo
apps.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. The demo opens three Circles: Lust, Greed and Violence. Place tarot cards on a grid, surround enemy cards to flip them to your side, and build the board with effects that fire whenever a card lands on them.

apps.name: beautiful freaks of the desert - demo
apps.short_description: This is the demo for 'beautiful freaks of the desert', a hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic, that requires lightning fast reactions and strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the beginning of the trip...

apps.name: BERGWERK - A Mining Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own mining company in the coal region of Grubental! Construct your colliery above ground, descend into procedurally generated depths, and operate over 15 heavy machines. Master mine statics, infrastructure, complex transport networks, and sell your coal on dynamic markets.

apps.name: Beyond The Roots Demo
apps.short_description:
Face the guardians of the sky. Beyond The Roots is a challenging 2D pixel art Boss Rush where every fight is a test of precision.

Play as a determined human aiming to rise to the rank of gods and take down the fallen angels blocking your path.

apps.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Head out on your first job and transform a neglected garden. Start up the mower, grab the blower to clear leaves from the paths, and blast the dirty driveway with a pressure washer. Tackle wild weeds, sort the remaining trash, and feel the ultimate satisfaction of perfect order.

apps.name: Blacksite Lazarus Demo
apps.short_description: Sent to investigate a medical facility gone dark, a private military contractor discovers a nightmare of death and mutation. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a cancer cure that created something far worse.

apps.name: BlastBall: All-Stars Demo
apps.short_description: Curve shots, unleash Blasts, and power up the chaos! Try the BlastBall: All-Stars demo for physics-driven Soccer and Gagaball with 1-4 players, each sport with its standard arena. Take on bots, share the couch, or invite friends to private online matches.

apps.name: BloomTale Demo
apps.short_description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

apps.name: BOOMER Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam engine, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

apps.name: Bottle Flip Inc Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

apps.name: BroCode Demo
apps.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

apps.name: Broken Horror Anthology Demo
apps.short_description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

apps.name: Burger Shooter Demo
apps.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

apps.name: Capy of Gods Demo
apps.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

apps.name: Catacrypt Demo
apps.short_description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

apps.name: Chaos Coin Demo
apps.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

apps.name: Chicken Show Demo
apps.short_description:
Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win!
Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure.
Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

apps.name: Chronicles Meteorfall Demo
apps.short_description: The demo for Chronicles Meteorfall

apps.name: Chumps Chained Demo
apps.short_description: After a failed phishing scheme, two scam artist best friends are cursed by an evil wizard who permanently chains them together. In this 2D couch co-op platformer, join Walter and Jellybean in navigating through the wizard's mayhem and a surreal world to undo the curse!

apps.name: Ciao Pizza: Cooking Chaos Demo
apps.short_description: Run a chaotic pizza shop alone or with up to three friends. Make every pizza by hand, deal with impatient customers, keep the kitchen running, and race deliveries across town before everything gets cold, burnt, or completely out of control.

apps.name: Claw & Load : Mine,Shoot,Meow! Demo
apps.short_description: In the cursed Eternal Night Continent, ancient magic clashes with firearms as you battle for survival. Serve the Tsundere Demon Cat, fend off hordes of undead horrors, and command an army of Guardian Mewlings armed with bizarre weapons. Each run is a desperate loop of mining frenzy and combat chaos！

apps.name: Clear the Snow Demo
apps.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

apps.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival Demo
apps.short_description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. This demo contains a taste of Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, where you meet the main characters of the story, delve into the Labyrinth and face off against the Scarlet Church for the first time.

apps.name: Cloudwright Demo
apps.short_description: Build a cozy factory in the clouds. Salvage your crashed airship, set conveyors humming across your home island, and build your first balloon. Play the opening chapter of Cloudwright solo or in online co-op, up to 8 players.

apps.name: Come to my party! Demo
apps.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming of age story where every choice carries weight.

apps.name: Conquer the Labyrinth Demo
apps.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is a third-person anime-inspired ARPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

apps.name: Cosmoteer Demo
apps.short_description: Design and simulate the starship of your dreams! Command it in epic battles and manage your crew while exploring a dangerous galaxy. Play alone or with friends, test your ship in online PvP, and let your imagination reach for the stars!

apps.name: Court Vision Demo
apps.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

apps.name: Crackheads Demo
apps.short_description: Begin a new life in the Crackheads demo, alone or with friends. Scavenge trash, break into ATMs, beg for cash, stay high, and manage a thriving Crack House as you grow your empire.

apps.name: Cranked Demo
apps.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

apps.name: Creature Kitchen Demo
apps.short_description: Get a taste of this creepy-cozy atmospheric cooking simulator in the Creature Kitchen Demo!  Meet your local wildlife and feed them favorite snacks as you start your exploration through a strange house and the nearby woods.  The witching hour has only begun...

apps.name: Crimson Ark Demo
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG with three playable heroines. Hunt for random loot, enhance your gear, and build your magic. Use optional auto-hunting in the field, then take manual control for boss fights. Explore the opening region in this level-20 demo.

apps.name: Crownmarked Demo
apps.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, raise citizens into adventurers and fight beside powerful companions in Crownmarked, a kingdom-building action RPG set in a fractured fantasy world trapped in an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

apps.name: Crystant Demo
apps.short_description:
Crystant is a strategy survival game that combines board game-style exploration, turn-based tactical combat, and Roguelite progression.
Explore the floors, manage resources, strengthen your team, and fight against mutated creatures.

apps.name: Dandelion Void Demo
apps.short_description: Take your first steps through the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Explore your new surroundings, establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

apps.name: Deadzone Rogue 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo of Deck Breaker, a roguelike deckbuilder where the cards you FOIL travel from quest to quest, forever. Build absurd combos from 200+ cards and 35 heroes that each warp the rules—then carry your favorite discoveries into the next adventure.

apps.name: Deep Six Demo
apps.short_description:
A post-WW1 stealth action game where equipment is scarce, and time of day, weather, sound, movement, and position can all betray your position.
Avoid, distract, knockout or kill as you traverse unique locations, sabotage war machines, save your comrades, and take down elite soldiers.

apps.name: Deslot Legends Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo of Deslot Legends, a tabletop slot racing game where every millimeter matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit on three circuits, compete in your first Career cups, and carry your progress over to the full game.

apps.name: Did You See That? Demo
apps.short_description: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

apps.name: DISK-Y Demo
apps.short_description: Show transfer student Yuu around the school in a short psychological horror visual novel with a dreamlike, disjointed story. An experimental retro game originally made for a single 3.5-inch floppy disk, now on Steam.

apps.name: Dogeminer 2: Back 2 The Moon™ Demo
apps.short_description: Mine your way across the cosmos in this wholesome & silly adventure! Recruit loyal helpers, loot legendary gear, and build your empire all the way to the moon and beyond! Such wow!

apps.name: Down to Floor Zero Demo
apps.short_description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

apps.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN!  Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

apps.name: Dream Eaters.exe Demo
apps.short_description: Trapped in a secret sleep experiment, you and your friends must survive terrifying nightmares, completing tasks to wake up before it's too late. Play solo or in co-op, but beware the experiments are never the same and something watches from the dark.

apps.name: Drellnathor Demo
apps.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

apps.name: Drums & Steel Demo
apps.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and in this demo. May the best army win.

apps.name: Dulat Demo
apps.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

apps.name: DungeonBox Demo
apps.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

apps.name: Echo Pandemic Demo
apps.short_description: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

apps.name: Elemental Lands Demo
apps.short_description: A lone King holds back an elemental horde! Explore lands to mine mana & build your base to support heroes in turn-based tactical battles. Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck & RPG hero party. Play spell cards & command 3 heroes to position, capture objectives to defeat enemy hordes.

apps.name: Empires of a Tiny Universe Demo
apps.short_description: Empires of a Tiny Universe is a relaxed single-player RTS where you build and expand your empire across space. Manage planetary infrastructure, develop new technologies for your fleet, and conquer the galaxy - all from a clear, minimalist perspective.

apps.name: Engagement Demo
apps.short_description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull with a visual for every upgrade, raise a wing of named pilots who rank up, fuse and fly in squads, and hold out against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

apps.name: Escape from Doomstown Demo
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you lead a squad of survivors into a zombie-infested town. Scavenge for supplies, take down dangerous foes, and get out before the horde closes in. Build your base, recruit survivors, strengthen your squad, and fight your way out of this doomed city!

apps.name: Escape the Flood! Demo
apps.short_description: A first person survival crafting game for 1 to 10 players. The sea keeps rising and the island is going under. Gather what you can, craft a boat and get everyone aboard before the last hill floods. Or sail without them.

apps.name: Estancia Protocol Zero Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

apps.name: Evard The Hermit: Through Fears Demo
Eyeball Alley Demo
apps.short_description: You are an eyeball, and everything is an eyeball. Roll through trippy worlds where gravity follows every curve of the surface beneath you. Roaming eyeballs knock you off course, and the fifth hit kills you. Dig tunnels through anything.

apps.name: Facrobry Demo
apps.short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

apps.name: Factory Life Demo
apps.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

apps.name: FailRooms Demo
apps.short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

apps.name: False Oath Demo
apps.short_description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

apps.name: Fast Food Fortune Demo
apps.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

apps.name: Fear The Reaper Demo
apps.short_description: Fear The Reaper is a PVP multiplayer horror game in which players take on unique roles and live out the experience of starring in a slasher film while counting down to the terrifying Judgment Hour!

apps.name: FLASK Demo
apps.short_description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

apps.name: Flecto Demo
apps.short_description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

apps.name: FMV - Full Motion Voyeur Demo
apps.short_description: Investigate heinous villain and ordinary lives via hidden cameras in this live-action psychological horror FMV. Search intel, solve passwords, and choose who to sacrifice to the Demon to save your captive lover, Mona. Play the early alpha demo now and help shape the game!

apps.name: Funeral for the Sun Demo
apps.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned town and uncover 400 years of damnation, family history and revolution. Witness the past with your own eyes, construct a web of connections between townsfolk, discover secret identities, and learn the foul supernatural truth of what sleeps beneath the rubble.

apps.name: Gate Guard Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

apps.name: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown Demo
apps.short_description: Your first step into a living world. This free demo of GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is being prepared around third-person exploration, village and forest encounters, and the beginning of a journey with a wolf companion.

apps.name: General Practice Demo
apps.short_description: Scrub in for 6 levels in General Practice, a wacky co-op adventure where the deadlines are tight and the treatments are… questionable. Diagnose, (mis)treat, master multiple contraptions, enjoy the tomfoolery and wreak no harm! Play solo or with up to 4 friends, locally or online.

apps.name: Geometry TD Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Geometry TD: tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Fly through open space, put your crew to work, and stop a pirate boarding with geometric towers. Play time is limited to 15 minutes.

apps.name: GloveUp! Demo
apps.short_description: GloveUp! demo is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters and fight through opponents of all shapes and styles!

apps.name: Golf 5 MAX Demo
apps.short_description: Try Golf 5 MAX free! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust. The full game launches November 2 on Steam with 25% off for two weeks. Wishlist it now!

apps.name: GRAVHOUNDS Demo
apps.short_description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

apps.name: Green Space Demo
apps.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

apps.name: Gridbound Demo
apps.short_description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

apps.name: GRIDHACK Demo
apps.short_description: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!

apps.name: Grilluminati Demo
apps.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

apps.name: GrimKeep Demo
apps.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

apps.name: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell Demo
apps.short_description: Demons are not the danger, YOU ARE THE DANGER!!! play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.

apps.name: Haunted Schoolbag Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first night of Haunted Schoolbag as Minato. Reach into a bag you can't see: grab hilts to use items, avoid blades, and read the numbers to survive. A Minesweeper-style deduction and item-building roguelite. Face Hanako or the After-School Broadcast.

apps.name: Headshot Holdout Demo
apps.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines.  There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

apps.name: Here Comes the Horde Demo
apps.short_description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Play this demo for the taste of the full experience and try yourself out in the first 7 levels of the game.

apps.name: Hexmental Demo
apps.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

apps.name: Hiveheart Demo
apps.short_description: Your tiny colony's adventure begins! Explore the depths of nature in this pink colony, gather resources, and build your nest step by step. Just don't let the little ones go starve! Command your soldiers and workers to keep your queen safe, and turn your colony into a thriving nest.

apps.name: Hush Piñata Demo
apps.short_description: Cansada de apanhar, ela vendou os próprios olhos e voltou sedenta por vingança. Neste jogo de festa de terror e comédia para até 9 jogadores, a Piñata vendada caça pelo som, e até mesmo a sua voz no microfone faz uma silhueta brilhar na escuridão dela. Realize as tarefas em silêncio e arranque o rabo dela antes que ela perceba.

apps.name: I Want to Play the Villain! Demo
apps.short_description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

apps.name: Imperial Kingdoms Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a medieval kingdom in this 4X grand strategy game with pausable real-time. Establish vital infrastructure to supply your capital and sustain your armies. Design custom military templates, manage production estates, and conquer rival kingdoms via strategic sieges and raids.

apps.name: Imperionis Demo
apps.short_description: Command a Roman centuria during the first 24 days of the campaign in Gaul. Make decisions, manage your camp, and fight three hex-based tactical battles manually or with real-time autobattle.

apps.name: In Print Demo
apps.short_description: In Print is a chaotic rogue-lite shooter where each round’s loser picks a new power-up to build a unique combo. Rain fire with the power of Hellvetica or fly through the skies with Wingdings. All while sporting your finest office attire.

apps.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Worldwide Beta Test Demo "Leave Your Inazuma Mark on the World!"
Inearth Demo
apps.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

apps.name: Inn Over Your Head Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

apps.name: Iron Hunters Demo
apps.short_description: BUILD A WAR MACHINE. BREAK THE RUN. A survivor-like where you build a mech into an absurd war machine. Upgrade, evolve, and combine weapons mid-run to create game-breaking synergies as you battle hordes of enemies across alien worlds.

apps.name: JOHN GLEEP Demo
apps.short_description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

apps.name: KILLSEC Demo
apps.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

apps.name: Last Moon Demo
apps.short_description: In this demo, discover the beginning of Last Moon. Become a Lunar Knight and rekindle the light of a dying world, alone or in co-op. Explore the first lands of Eterna, master weapons, skills and runes, and face the Shadow before it consumes everything.

apps.name: Legend of Defenders Demo
apps.short_description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

apps.name: Legion of Judgment: Fallen Angel Demo
apps.short_description: Legion of Judgment is a Noir action-RPG Metroidvania game that offers a new and deeper player experience. Explore forgotten memories to become stronger, manage a hotel in reality to create a powerful legion and win the war against werewolf guild.

apps.name: Lenin Street Geek Shop Demo
apps.short_description: Become a shopkeeper in the first geek store in a snowy 2000s town: sell CDs, snacks, and fan merch, influence your customers' lives, get involved in shady business, and grow your small store.

apps.name: LEVELS Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

apps.name: Life in the Kingdom Demo
apps.short_description: Take the throne at twenty five. Rule until you die. Marry, raise heirs, free your towns from scheming rivals, and carve through dungeons with an evolving arsenal. One ruler, one lifetime, one unforgettable reign. An adventure packed kingdom life-sim where every year counts.

apps.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own ice cream shop in the Livin' the Cream demo! Serve customers, make Soft Serve and Scoop Ice Cream in three flavors, serve with different types of cones, and customize your shop with different floors, walls, counters, and tables.

apps.name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry? Demo
apps.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

apps.name: Lost Host Demo
apps.short_description: A short playable demo of Lost Host — explore the world, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery.

apps.name: Lost Isle Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a new take on open-world survival in a unique and procedural fantasy world. Build your own settlement and protect it from monstrous beasts and players alike. Craft weapons and equipment from a land bathed in cosmic power.

apps.name: LOTTERY Demo
apps.short_description: LOTTERY's Demo allows you to experience the groundbreaking AI in a shrunken version, with the same adaptation and predictions in a tactical first person shooter format.

apps.name: Lucky Dog Rise Demo
apps.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

apps.name: Ludus Magna Demo
apps.short_description: Thirty days. One Ludus. Your chance at glory. Recruit, train and equip gladiators. Watch auto-battles or intervene with quick-time events. Reach 300 Fame to unlock the Primus, then risk your finest fighter in a battle to the death.

apps.name: Magnavale: Eternal Soul Demo
apps.short_description: Eternal Soul is a gothic Metroidvania where you steal the souls of your enemies. Explore the castle, find powerful items & abilities, fight against demonic creatures, and learn the truth of your power.

apps.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim Demo
apps.short_description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

apps.name: Marque & Reprisal Demo
apps.short_description:
Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

The demo takes place entirely in the Mediterranean.

apps.name: Me and You Demo
apps.short_description:
Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. 
Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

apps.name: Medieval Frontiers Demo
apps.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

apps.name: Meltdown Demo
apps.short_description:
Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, the newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to power the surrounding city.
Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank's flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.

apps.name: Memory House Demo
apps.short_description: Your first quiet evening in Memory House. Try illustrated Jigsaw puzzles, an introductory Atlas strategy scenario, five detective chapters, a complete fairy tale, and a small personal journal, with music and changing weather. Available in English and Russian.

apps.name: Message From Aliens Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

apps.name: Midnight Moving Crew Demo
apps.short_description: This is a demo for Midnight Moving Crew. In this demo, step into possessed houses with up to 3 friends to pack up every last box before the paranormal takes over. Evade the entities, load the truck under pressure, and get out alive or join the undead residents.

apps.name: Militsioner Demo
apps.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

apps.name: Mimania Demo
apps.short_description: A survival horror game where you have to find Mimics, who are disguised as different objects, with danger lurking around every corner.

apps.name: Mind Vessel Demo
apps.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

apps.name: Mine of despair Demo
apps.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

apps.name: Miner Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

apps.name: Mini Legends Idle Demo
apps.short_description: Try Mini Legends Idle, a voxel fantasy idle RPG with automatic combat. Farm loot, level up, upgrade weapons and armor and combine passives as you progress through stage.

apps.name: Momotaro and the Oni Island Demo
apps.short_description: Join Momotaro on his journey to the Oni King. Match orbs to attack, exploit Fire, Water, and Plant weaknesses, fight alongside your companions, and choose your own path across the island.

apps.name: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell Demo
apps.short_description:
A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses.
DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

apps.name: Monsterhearts: Welcome to Drowned Lake Demo
apps.short_description: A queer horror narrative deckbuilder about the messy lives of teen monsters.

apps.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or try 20 more puzzles, Easy to Expert, in every world.

apps.name: Moving Castle Demo
apps.short_description: Build a moving castle—or a vast mobile city—and explore a post-apocalyptic world. Live aboard your creation: gather, mine, explore and fight. Travel with your residents, face fearsome monsters, grow crops, cook meals, and share sunrises and sunsets.

apps.name: Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game Demo
apps.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

apps.name: MUPO Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

apps.name: My Fairy Princess Demo
apps.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

apps.name: My Paper Plane is Better Demo
NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy Demo
apps.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

apps.name: Necrolord Demo
apps.short_description: Command an undead army as a Lich in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite demo. Raise the fallen, equip your troops, and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands and play until you defeat the first Inquisition.

apps.name: Neo Junk City Demo
apps.short_description: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a cyberpunk action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

apps.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade Demo
apps.short_description: Neon Breaker is a fun twin-stick horizontal 3d retro shoot 'em up in the legacy of the great action arcade shmup classics. Shoot, evade, and hunt down cute enemy ships to make them all explode! Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

apps.name: Nether Abyss Demo
apps.short_description: Scale the doomed Nether Abyss to leap into the Well of Reincarnation. In this dark Chinese Action-Roguelite with Extraction mechanics, rise as a nameless undead from the blood pools. Scavenge the fallen, endure cycles of rebirth, slay ancient demons, and draw your blade against heaven as you climb.

apps.name: NETWORK & CYBER SECURITY SIMULATOR Demo
apps.short_description: A 3D educational simulation game focused on networking and cybersecurity. Configure network devices, analyze security events, work with SOC tools, and learn penetration testing through hands-on, interactive scenarios.

apps.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space Demo
apps.short_description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

apps.name: Night At The Mall Demo
apps.short_description: A psychological horror job sim. Complete security maintenance in a sprawling, desolate mall while surviving creeping, unpredictable threats. Manage electrical systems, monitor CCTV cameras, and survive a night shift where you never know what is lurking in the dark.

apps.name: Noctheria Demo
apps.short_description: Classic action-adventure dungeons meet survival horror. Explore Albadusk at your own pace, solve cursed dungeons with wit alone, and bring their tools back into the world to reach secrets once out of reach. A dark N64-style adventure of faith, ancient gods, and what hides in the dark.

apps.name: OCTOPTICOM Demo
apps.short_description: OCTOPTICOM is an open-ended puzzle programming game about designing and optimizing optical computing devices. Use lasers, mirrors, filters and other components to read, transform and write sequences of colored squares.

apps.name: Omanah Demo
apps.short_description: Myst-Like 3D free exploration game. This demo allows you to play the first part of the game, which features 8 additional worlds in the full version.

apps.name: One More Shake Demo
apps.short_description: Shake vending machines, collect cans, earn money and scrap, buy upgrades and automate your progress in this colorful incremental idle game. Keep improving your setup and make every shake count.

apps.name: Order of the Holy Crucible Demo
Oreship Stellar Frontier Demo
apps.short_description: Baue Rohstoffe im All ab, erweitere dein Frachtschiff und errichte Produktionsketten, Stationen und Handelsrouten. In Oreship Stellar Frontier wächst dein Weltraumimperium Schritt für Schritt über mehrere Sternensysteme hinweg.

apps.name: Overbooked Demo
apps.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

apps.name: Pack Ripper Demo
apps.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it? Play the free demo with 4 card sets to collect.

apps.name: Pale Incense Demo
apps.short_description: In the Pale Incense demo, run a perfume shop by day and hunt as a vampire by night in a gothic action-simulation. Harvest scents and human essence from victims, evade hunters, and craft healing incense that may save your wife Johanna, left dying by your failed attempt to turn her.

apps.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院 Demo
apps.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

apps.name: Paradox Demo
apps.short_description: One player hunts. Four players run and fight back with superpowers. Use unique abilities, complete objectives, and escape through ancient Egypt, Victorian London, and more, to complete the the story.

apps.name: Password Not Valid Demo
apps.short_description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

apps.name: Path Defenders Demo
apps.short_description: Path Defenders is a 3D action tower defense RPG. Build a strategy party and jump into real-time combat to fight alongside your summoned heroes against epic bosses, all driven by a lofi and vaporwave soundtrack.

apps.name: Peg Champ Demo
apps.short_description: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break pegs, earn money, and unlock a huge upgrade tree in this satisfying physics puzzler.

apps.name: Piece by Piece Demo
apps.short_description: Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into puzzle pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and unconnected each piece to make your way through each of our 13 handcrafted levels in our demo. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

apps.name: Pionero Capital Demo
apps.short_description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

apps.name: Pixel Survivors : Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel roguelike defense game where you fight off endless waves of monsters. Collect skills, upgrade your heroes, combine items, and survive as long as you can!

apps.name: PNEUMA Demo
apps.short_description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

apps.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族 Demo
Police Station Simulator Demo
apps.short_description:
You’re in charge of a run-down police station. Will you manage to restore it to its former glory?
Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts, because there's a lot of renovation and micro-management work to do!

apps.name: Pongcremental Demo
apps.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

apps.name: Press Me Up Demo
apps.short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

apps.name: PRISON OF HUSKS Demo
apps.short_description: Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. In this nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife, explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Battle lovelorn bosses and seek your lost love.

apps.name: Procession Engine Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Procession Engine. Not another turn-based deckbuilder: a real-time tug of war where your cards shape a whole army. During Next Fest, play all 3 races through Act 1 and push two lanes until a stronghold falls.

apps.name: PropAlive Demo
apps.short_description:
PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities.
Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

apps.name: Psycasso® Demo
apps.short_description: Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians in this controversial open world, pixel art, murder simulator.

apps.name: Punch Your Way Out Demo
apps.short_description: A free taste of Punch Your Way Out, the first person digging game for 1 to 4 players. Punch through the first 10 metres or so, vacuum the rubble, sell it and buy your first upgrade. Your run carries over into the full game.

apps.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum Demo
apps.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain propositional calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

apps.name: Railtown Demo
apps.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

apps.name: Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story Demo
apps.short_description: Meet some of your classmates, help solve the mystery behind a broken statue, and get a sense of the overall gameplay of Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story in this short Sneak Peek Demo!

apps.name: Re:Connect Demo
apps.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

apps.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026 Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening weeks of a referee career for free! Create your official, take charge in the English and German second tiers, show cards, review goals with VAR and face the pressure and headlines that follow every call.

apps.name: Rent A Car Together Demo
apps.short_description: Start by renting your first car in Rent A Car Together (Demo). Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

apps.name: Retail Rivals Demo
apps.short_description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

apps.name: Rites of Accord Demo
apps.short_description:
Outsmart your rival and win a full wargame in 30 minutes. Or attempt survival against (nearly) endless hordes.

Command six factions that play nothing alike: turn your enemy's dead into ghosts that hunt them, spread living terrain across the map, or form choirs to share damage with allies.

apps.name: River Drift Demo
apps.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

apps.name: Rock Band Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

apps.name: Rogue Maze Demo
apps.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

apps.name: Rowan Needs Shinies! Demo
apps.short_description: [NO AI] A whimsical incremental game with a colorful cast of critters. Help the greedy crow Rowan gather more shinies with the help of the local wildlife. Discover how to craft strange potions and empower your new friends. All so that you can gather EVEN MORE SHINIES!

apps.name: Runback Demo
apps.short_description: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

apps.name: RYFT STRIKE: BRIGHTER TOMORROW Demo
apps.short_description: Three nights before her war goes on television, Lt. Vesper is found by a Halcyon nature documentary. A complete prologue mission for the bullet-hell shoot 'em up: spell-card bosses, focus and graze scoring, a submarine carrier the size of the screen, and couch or online co-op.

apps.name: Scape Demo
apps.short_description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

apps.name: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Play the demo this spooky season!

apps.name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

apps.name: Screamer Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into the demo of Screamer and get a taste of the most brutal racing showdown!

apps.name: Seaside Wash Demo
apps.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Discover the first steps of your restoration journey in this demo, featuring 3 docks, 10 unique ships and variances, tool upgrades, and additional cleaning activities.

apps.name: Secret of Circadia Demo
apps.short_description: Secret of Circadia is a retro pixel styled RPG Deckbuilder that combines light City Builder elements and Roguelite mechanics with classic Deckbuilder Combat to create a unique, quirky, cute and fun blend!

apps.name: Shadowstone Demo
apps.short_description: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics roguelite where you must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

apps.name: Shark Mart Demo
apps.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

apps.name: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle Demo
apps.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

apps.name: Sleepytime Village Demo
apps.short_description: Sleepytime Village is the story of a workaholic father who makes one wrong choice too many and becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, haunted by the residents of Sleepytime Village, its formless narrator and visions of his childhood. What is the Village and what does it want from him?

apps.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift Demo
apps.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Try a free week of outrageous combos, plugins and performance reviews. Open ZONE.EXE for NERTZ RUSH and SPIT with Steam friends or bots. TRAINING.EXE limits the content, never your playtime. Your trial shift starts here.

apps.name: Sort The Bunnies Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

apps.name: Speed Golf Royale Demo
apps.short_description: Play Quick Match online or over LAN with up to 20 players (bots fill empty spots) across all 8 current courses. It includes the tutorial, power-ups and character customisation. The Level Editor, extra game modes and Steam stats and achievements are only in the full game.

apps.name: Spirit Crossing Demo
apps.short_description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

apps.name: Spirit of Diwata Demo
apps.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

apps.name: Squares of Hell Demo
apps.short_description: Hell is divided into squares for sinners. For each sin there is a separate square. Bad smoker square - smoker is tempted by unavailable cigarettes. Bad Driver Square - The driver is always pushing the car uphill. Those who make a lot of noise jump up and down on a large subwoofer.

apps.name: STARHOME Demo
apps.short_description: Take command of a fleet carrying the last survivors of your civilization. Manage limited space aboard your ships, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and explore an unknown galaxy in search of a new home. Play the STARHOME Demo.

apps.name: STEEL ROAD Demo
apps.short_description: Intense fighting game where you command your fighter in every battle.

apps.name: Stick Life: The Daily Grind Demo
Stop Reading the Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Build a deck. Let the cards do the work. Try the demo of this satirical roguelike card game, with automated combat, a guided tutorial, and keyboard & mouse controls. Camera-based gestures are optional. Management accepts no responsibility for your strategy.

apps.name: Strange island Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere, exploration, and a slow descent into mystery. You wake up on a remote island with no memory and no answers — who you are or how you got there. But with every answer you find, more questions begin to surface

apps.name: Stupid Tankers Demo
apps.short_description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

apps.name: Summoner's Tale Demo
apps.short_description:
Summoner’s Tale is an Action-Platformer monster collecting game in a new way!
Collect Monsters, discover their unique abilities, build your dream squad and fight your way to save the world!

apps.name: SunderBound Demo
apps.short_description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

apps.name: Sunset Painter Demo
apps.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

apps.name: SWOM Demo
apps.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

apps.name: Symphony of the Serpent Demo
apps.short_description: Symphony of the Serpent is the latest thrilling chapter in the NLT saga, where a mysterious sex virus sweeps across the globe, setting the stage for the war between Heaven and Hell to reignite. As the otherworldly forces rise, humanity's fate hangs in the balance.

apps.name: SYSTEM INTRUDER Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in a retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

apps.name: Tactical Squad Demo
apps.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player operation, then settle the score in PvP.

apps.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator Demo
The 9th Dragon Demo
apps.short_description: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

apps.name: The Aether Project TD Demo
apps.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

apps.name: The Afterlife Cafe Demo
apps.short_description:
Travel to the world of the dead, whose stories encourage reflection on life. Chat with spirits, brew drinks to suit your mood, and bond with the people who run the afterlife cafes.

In this urban sci-fi fantasy visual novel, your choices impact the living, the departed, and your own path forward.

apps.name: The Golden Caravan Demo
apps.short_description:
Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate.
Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

apps.name: The Hanging Game Demo
apps.short_description: Hangman was a children's game on paper. Here, you don't draw the hanged man — you are him. Search an abandoned graveyard for letter stones, carry them to the altar, and spell the word before seven mistakes tighten the noose.

apps.name: The Hollowing Demo
apps.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

apps.name: The Little Stomping Girl Demo
apps.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

apps.name: The Long Watch Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike tower defense where you draw the road the enemy walks. Drive back the mist around you if you want to survive, protect your torches and hold the hill. A final boss will be waiting for you in this free demo of The Long Watch.

apps.name: The Loomsong Chronicle Idle Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a growing party through dangerous expeditions in this party-based idle RPG. Recruit, equip, train, gather, craft, and fight through level 25, then carry the same campaign into the full game without restarting.

apps.name: The Rabbit Haul Demo
apps.short_description: The Rabbit Haul is a roguelite farming and tower defense game that challenges you to grow crops, build symbiotic defenses, and protect your haul from the thieving Trash Panda Posse as you rebuild your hometown one run at a time!

apps.name: The Shattered Demo
apps.short_description: The Shattered is a fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

apps.name: The Silent Fare Demo
apps.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

apps.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Demo
apps.short_description: "The Veil Chronicles: Nix University" is an exciting and vibrant adventure in a well-thought-out author's world, combining the genres of visual novel, RPG, and turn-based combat system.

apps.name: This Is the Peace Demo
apps.short_description: One shift. Seven seats. Far too many egos. Try the first day of this satirical dispatch strategy: build your team, handle 15 calls, open diplomatic talks, and discover why the President's phone is everyone's problem.

apps.name: TIC.EXE Demo
apps.short_description: The TIC.EXE demo: four of the eight sectors. Three in a row is not a win, it is a discharge — the line detonates into the hostile process. Build a deck and modules, reach the boss.

apps.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria Demo
apps.short_description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls of 21 real ancient alphabets back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, where every cat wants a toy: find it to get the scroll it guards! Play solo, or tidy up together in online co-op and split screen!

apps.name: TileShire Demo
apps.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.
