apps.name: Totally Nutz: An 80s Adventure – Demo
apps.short_description: Step back into the 80s in this hand-drawn, hidden-object puzzle adventure about a family of squirrels chasing a big dream. Join the Nutz family as they journey from their quiet home in the suburbs to the big city in search of the legendary Acorn Games.

apps.name: TowOrbs Demo
apps.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

apps.name: Trailblazers: Into the March Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

apps.name: Trap Testers Demo
apps.short_description: Trap Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

apps.name: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op dungeon runner. Fight through the shifting towers, loot powerful gear and develop new skills.  Challenge bosses and free the villagers town in this Action-RPG.  The tower will change, but each fountain will save your progress until you face the evil wizard himself.

apps.name: Troubleshooting Demo
apps.short_description: chaotic FPS roguelite inside your old family computer! Blast corrupt files, grab XP, stack weird upgrades, and place desktop junk to shape the arena as the system falls apart in increasingly stupid ways.

apps.name: Twilight Gallery Demo
apps.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

apps.name: Twin Hooks Demo
apps.short_description: Two heroes, one fight. Team up in a 2-player co-op brawler where you juggle enemies skyward together, land synchronized takedowns, shop and loot your way to stronger gear. Wholesome by day. Relentless by night.

apps.name: Underground Security Inc Demo
apps.short_description: Build the most profitable dungeon while defending against parties of adventuring "heroes". Manage minions, mine ores, build traps and collect ancient tomes in this roguelite meets base defense game.

apps.name: Utterance Demo
apps.short_description: Utterance is a Lovecraftian Western roguelite deckbuilder where you chart your own path through a corrupted world. Build a deck of letters, forge words, and battle creatures that twist your deck, your rules, and your sanity.

apps.name: VoidHue Demo
apps.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

apps.name: Voltform Demo
apps.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city. Demo includes Levels 1–20.

apps.name: Voxel Playground Demo
apps.short_description: Voxel Playground is a physics-driven voxel sandbox VR game built for VR. In this fully destructible voxel physics world, you can build, craft and shoot against enemies with limitless possibilities.

apps.name: Waltz & Jam Demo
apps.short_description: Where shadows stretch a little too long and not every whisper in the dark belongs to a friend... Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion, through a spooky afterlife reimagined from the Seven Deadly Sins.

apps.name: War Company: Fortress Europe Demo
apps.short_description: Lead armies across a dynamic 3D campaign, then command the battles they create in real time. Logistics, maneuver, and tactical success combine to decide the fate of the war.

apps.name: WarSlice Demo
apps.short_description:
Fight for the glory of battle in WarSlice!
Try out some turn-based tactical combat with the demo, which offers both offline campaign missions and online PvP!

apps.name: Weavercraft Demo
apps.short_description: Step into your great-aunt's old weaving house, brave the cold, and craft your first warm layers.

apps.name: Welcome, [Employee Name] Demo
apps.short_description:
Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.
Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

apps.name: What Da Font Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of a cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: search the ground floor for scattered lead type, tell one typeface from another, put the sorts back in their cases, then set and print your first two posters by hand.

apps.name: When Voices Died Demo
apps.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

apps.name: Where the Hell Is My Game? Demo
apps.short_description: Explore one trash pile, find rare items and collectible cards, and sell your finds to buy upgrades that make collecting easier. The full game offers more piles to explore in your search for the lost game cartridge.

apps.name: Whisk Demo
apps.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

apps.name: Whispers of Orange Island Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a little girl's soul in this atmospheric 2D stealth puzzle game set in a dark dystopia. Wield magical ancestral tools to rescue wandering spirits, uncover a century of tragic family history, and heal your living families.

apps.name: Who Pressed It?! Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

apps.name: Why's It Getting DARKER?! Demo
apps.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

apps.name: Wild West Canyon Demo
apps.short_description: Revolver in hand, bison in sight: Experience a ruthless survival adventure. Defy wild animals and Native Americans. Build a refuge and show who is in charge!

apps.name: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: tear open Winky chocolate bars, rewrap them as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell them. Hire workers, runners and couriers, knock through the first wall and play ping-pong or air hockey on your break, alone or with up to three friends. The full game goes on to 1 Billion.

apps.name: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion Demo
apps.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories.

apps.name: Witch's Last Curse Demo
apps.short_description: A dark medieval fantasy RPG of mystery and magic. As the last Apprentice of a dead Witch, you must break your Master's final curse before it destroys the town, or the town turns on you. Manage stats, coin, and NPC relationships across a handful of daily actions while fighting back the curse.

apps.name: Zeitnot Demo
apps.short_description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

apps.name: ZombMe Demo
apps.short_description:
Old school platforming...with a twist.

It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

Demo includes the entire first world.

apps.name: Тайны Родиона Demo
apps.short_description: A supernatural adventure with visual novel elements. Explore an antique shop filled with unusual characters, secrets, humor, and heartfelt stories.

apps.name: 东隅荡寇志·朝鲜战争 Demo
人のいない世界に 体験版
apps.short_description: This is the story of humanity and a robot reaching their “end.” A lonely yet beautiful post-apocalyptic pixel-art narrative adventure, following a robot that awakens after humanity’s extinction until the moment it shuts itself down. Experience a rich and memorable journey lasting around two hours.

apps.name: 喵星档案 Meow Star Archives Demo
apps.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

apps.name: 恋爱音游痴 Demo
apps.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games theme. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

apps.name: 挂机放置修仙录 Demo
apps.short_description: Recruit five cultivators, build your formation, solve a sword-mark puzzle, and challenge Qingman in automatic battles with 1x, 2x, and 3x speed. Play and save the complete Chapter 1 journey.

apps.name: 方寸小家 RoomFolk Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own home in this sandbox game, mix and match a huge selection of furniture and decorations, and design your garden too! Export your creative process as a video with one click!

apps.name: 无尽仙路 Dao Without End Demo
apps.short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

apps.name: 无限弹射矿场 Demo
apps.short_description: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!

apps.name: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring Demo
apps.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

apps.name: 桌面小搭档 Demo
apps.short_description: This is a AI desktop companion that works and studies with you! You can choose your favorite companion to work or study with in any scenario. You can also find a favorite scenes to pause, enjoy the view. You can also decorate your desk in your favorite style and create your very own digital desk!

apps.name: 樱华退魔录 Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade. Play 4 exorcist girls, all 20 waves of Stage 1 with the Nine-Tails final boss, the prologue, each heroine's first episode and the shrine hub. Your progress carries over to the full version.

apps.name: 深空遗民 Demo
apps.short_description: This space survival sim lets you build a space station, construct ships to gather resources for expansion, and upgrade tech for stronger shields to withstand cosmic radiation, all while surviving in a radioactive environment.

apps.name: 落仙泱 Demo
apps.short_description:
No spiritual root – can you still ascend?
In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.

apps.name: 하숙생이 전부 미녀입니다만? 시즌2 Demo
apps.short_description:
Boarding house owner Yuman is back!
Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung return—joined by three new residents: a wealthy heiress, a girl haunted by childhood scars, and a gentle nurse with a healing heart.
In a house where past memories and fresh feelings intertwine… who will steal your heart?

apps.name: 1,200 Welcome Pack - Rainbow Six Siege
apps.short_description: Get 1,200 R6 Credits, instant unlock of four operators, and a seven-day Renown Booster for the same price as a standard 1,200 R6 Credits pack. Only available while this season lasts!

apps.name: ACE COMBAT 8 - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
apps.short_description: Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - International 9900i
apps.short_description: A longtime favorite of truckers, the 9900i is making a triumphant return. The International® Eagle 9900i is a classic long-nosed tractor that represents your independent spirit without compromising comfort, durability, power or efficiency.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - International LT®
apps.short_description: Designed and engineered to keep drivers more comfortable and productive for the long haul, the International LT® is the most driver-centric, uptime-focused truck that International Trucks has ever delivered.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Kenworth T680 2022
apps.short_description: The moment we've all been eagerly waiting for is finally here! We're thrilled to announce the release of the much-anticipated Kenworth T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition for American Truck Simulator.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Volvo VNL 2018
apps.short_description: Reliability, performance, and absolute driver satisfaction. This is why the Volvo VNL is an embodiment of excellence in the trucking world, and we are excited to let you know that brand new models have arrived in American Truck Simulator as a free update!

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 49X
apps.short_description: Built to thrive in the most rugged of environments, on a heritage of toughness, the Western Star® 49X will easily take on any challenge it comes across. See and drive this new legend first in American Truck Simulator!

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 5700XE
apps.short_description: The Western Star® 5700XE arrives in American Truck Simulator with a select choice of configurations and customizations. This includes a day cab, the 54" High Roof Stratosphere, and the 82" Ultra High Roof Stratosphere.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 57X
apps.short_description: The Western Star® 57X combines the best of two worlds – taking the X-Series DNA with bold design & rugged durability, combining it with the best of Daimler Truck North America’s on-highway platform, tested over millions of miles. The most advanced and innovative Western Star highway truck. Ever!

apps.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 1: Thillelille & Tiramisu
apps.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

apps.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 2: Elseal & Benedict
apps.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

apps.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 3: Aoife & Wenefica
apps.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

apps.name: 7 Bullets

Fight animal outlaws off in strategic gunfight duels.

But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

apps.name: A Drop of Magenta
apps.short_description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

apps.name: A Kingdom of Soil
apps.short_description: Return to a medieval borderland. Rebuild from a hoe, forge, hunt, and reclaim your tavern amid faction conflicts. Words sway deals, cooking wins hearts, choices shape your legacy. Live your legend in an open world.

apps.name: A Simple Expurriment

Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

apps.name: A Tale of Light
apps.short_description: The Light is dying. You must restore it. Lead a party of six through the city of Sómariel and the dungeons beneath it in a first-person, grid-based dungeon crawler in the old tradition.

apps.name: Abalon Arena
apps.short_description: Cards, tactics and mutant squirrels! Enter the arena and compete head to head, play cooperatively or go it alone to defeat increasingly challenging onslaughts of enemies in a cunning game of wits set in the fantastical world of Abalon.

apps.name: Abax

apps.name: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD
apps.short_description: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD is an atmospheric first-person game that blends everyday work at a roadside convenience store with supernatural events, elements of psychological horror, and dark humor.

apps.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive
apps.short_description: Hijack enemy processes. Steal their kits. A tactical roguelike on a 7×7 grid where every enemy is carrying something you can take lifesteal, defense, entire ability kits. Build from 250+ programs. The system adapts to hunt you. Permadeath. No negotiations.

apps.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
apps.short_description: An idle breaker where you can't miss. Buy and upgrade orbs. Smash skeletons. Go deeper. The orbs bounce on their own: no aiming required, and no way to lose. Click if you want to help — or don't.

apps.name: Abysses: Meridian
apps.short_description: Your drop pod sank on Meridian, a world where the sea has risen sixty metres in six years. Swim out, wake a silent station, build your way from a leaking pod to a real submarine, and dive ever deeper toward the vast ring that made the sea rise.

apps.name: Aequorea Victoria: The Museum
apps.short_description: A first-person journey through a world made of art. Wander a gallery of paintings, music and film, step into surreal rooms of fear, climb a tower where every floor is a different story, and leave your dreams for strangers to find.

apps.name: AFKTower

apps.name: Against Heroes
apps.short_description: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

apps.name: Age of Mankind
apps.short_description: Lead your people through Antiquity, from a small tribe to a mighty empire. Experience real-time grand strategy on a living world map with thousands of provinces and hundreds of peoples. Settle, trade, research, negotiate, and wage wars whose outcome is never certain.

apps.name: Age of Sail
apps.short_description: Set sail across dangerous seas in this co-op pirate adventure. Trade goods, fish for resources, upgrade your ship, and battle ruthless pirate NPCs as you build the ultimate vessel.

apps.name: Agent of Strange: Arrival
apps.short_description: The prologue to Agent of Strange — a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities. Start your path as a Conspirator in a desperate struggle against the secret occult regime.

apps.name: AI Learning Simulator
apps.short_description: A free AI learning lab. Design an animal's body and let neural networks discover movement through generations of trials. Explore how inputs, control and evaluation shape behavior. Save, compare and share results.

apps.name: AirAccel
apps.short_description: Master momentum in this pure movement platformer. Play solo or race friends in online co-op across custom surf ramps and bhop maps. Chain perfect strafes, build terminal velocity, and hit the apex in a physics-driven sandbox where speed is everything.

apps.name: Aircraft Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build an aircraft company from the pioneering age of aviation. Design and test aircraft, source engines, negotiate orders, manage production and cash flow, and grow your reputation through every successful delivery.

apps.name: AlcheMice
apps.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

apps.name: Alchemill: A Witch's Workshop
apps.short_description: Alchemill is a cosy falling-sand brewing game. Brew what villagers need by hand in a living cauldron, gather from the land, mend a ruined house, and become a witch in earnest.

apps.name: Alchemy Workshop
apps.short_description: Process ingredients, mix them, and infuse mana to create unique potions. Master the balance of these three principles, fulfill requests from customers and adventurers, and grow your tiny alchemy shop into the finest workshop in the kingdom.

apps.name: Aleef
apps.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

apps.name: Alice: Defense
apps.short_description: Alice: Defense is a strategic roguelike defense game. Recruit heroes with gold, form a team, and hold back waves of monsters. Uncover why the World Tree has changed in Story Mode, then push your limits in Infinity Mode with Relics, Augments, and Abyss Contracts.

apps.name: Alien Deathstorm
apps.short_description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

apps.name: Alien Entity Hal-09
apps.short_description: Explore a perilous, submerged facility and recover essential supplies that have been abandoned.

apps.name: Alien Friends

apps.name: AltspaceVR
apps.short_description: AltspaceVR is a social platform for virtual reality, a place where people meet inside shared 3D spaces instead of scrolling past each other.

apps.name: ALYSSA
apps.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

apps.name: AMMO DUMP
apps.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

apps.name: Ammo Station Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

apps.name: Among Us Story: On Guard
apps.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

apps.name: Andre Miri Cipa
apps.short_description: What if racism had been almost totally eradicated? An educational, narrative adventure, Andre Miri Cipa / In My Own Skin takes you on a journey to a hopeful future. From there, Robin, Vanessa and Marie return to painful experiences from their adolescence.

apps.name: Anima Trium
apps.short_description: In Anima Trium, Leop believes he and his friends may be the last survivors of an ancient war. Until he spots a boat on the horizon. Explore islands and uncover a forgotten past in an adventure RPG full of mystery, featuring turn-based combat with manual and automatic modes.

apps.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
apps.short_description: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

apps.name: Anomaly Manual: Aquarium
apps.short_description: Work the aquarium's night shift, escort visitors out, and follow the handbook, including its strangest rules. Watch for anomalies and get home safely in this single-player, first-person horror game with a story that gradually reveals the aquarium's past.

apps.name: ANOMIA
apps.short_description:
ANOMIA - 1977.
Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

apps.name: Another Card Game
apps.short_description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

apps.name: Apollyon
apps.short_description: 1979. P.L.U.T.O keeps sending your team of researchers back through G.A.T.E into the backrooms for deeper expeditions, but they are never happy with the lengths you go to. Nearest exit gets your team back safe. Only the deepest exit will suffice.

apps.name: Aquora
apps.short_description: Breed, raise, and sell pixel fish in your own living aquarium. Over 400 quadrillion possible fish. Chase ultra-rare mythic traits through generations of genetics, decorate your tank, fish the river, and grow a humble starter pair into an aquatic empire, even while you're away.

apps.name: ARCS
apps.short_description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

apps.name: Arctic Drive
apps.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

apps.name: Arena of No Return
apps.short_description: Arena of No Return is a dark medieval boxing simulation where you play as Kael, a condemned fighter trapped in a brutal arena-city. Train, unlock new skills, build your fighting style, and climb the ranks to earn your freedom and return to your daughter.

apps.name: Armament Inc
apps.short_description: Build a global arms empire in this idle tycoon. Research weapons, automate production, ship contracts across a live world map, out-maneuver rivals in diplomacy, and flex your fortune in a private mansion on your way to the top.

apps.short_description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

apps.name: Ascend and Fall

apps.name: Ash Hills Investigation
apps.short_description: An atmospheric first-person horror where you play as a forest ranger investigating a series of bloody events. Search for clues, monitor the perimeter through surveillance cameras, and keep your shotgun at the ready: an unfathomable horror lurks in the nocturnal gloom…

apps.name: Ashburrow
apps.short_description: Descend alone or with up to five friends into a gnoll warren where death ends the run but not the story. Fight with blade, shield and spell, bank your gold into permanent unlocks, and hire militia to hold the gate when the clan musters to take it back.

apps.name: Ashe & Granite
apps.short_description: A horror RPG, one life at a time, read to you. Every death teaches the next life. Every door is open to you. Every door costs something. Seventy-six endings are written out, each with its own account of how you got there. One of them is the way out. Nobody has found it.

apps.name: Ashen Swarm
apps.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where deadly sins become weapons. Cut through the condemned, build around your Oath or embrace Corruption, and claim lasting artifacts through your choices. Reach the Judge and stop his sentence from consuming the last lands.

apps.name: ASPIS
apps.short_description: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.

apps.name: Astra Genesis
apps.short_description: ASTRA GENESIS is a multiplayer space strategy and management game. Develop your colonies, automate your industry, explore the unknown, research new technologies, trade with other players, and join forces to build a civilization among the stars.

apps.name: AstroTanto
apps.short_description: You were promised a hero’s journey. You got a vacuum cleaner. Team up with 3 friends in this chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Build your space station out of "recycled" trash, dodge orbital debris, and try not to burn up in the atmosphere. In space, no one can hear you clean.

apps.name: Atomic Picnic: Prologue
apps.short_description: A 4-Player co-op shooter roguelite! Get together with up to 4 friends, defeat hordes of monsters, and upgrade your powers to survive in an anime-style wasteland.

apps.name: Attack of the Astrals
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

apps.name: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
apps.short_description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

apps.name: AuraFalls
apps.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

apps.name: Autopelago
apps.short_description: Autopelago is a game where you automate gathering and crafting to explore the floating islands you find yourself stuck on. Call upon the islands’ friendly wisps to help restore the ancient technology that will carry you home.

apps.name: Aveos
apps.short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

apps.name: Azoth
apps.short_description: Build game-breaking combos as you ascend through challenging rituals in this strategic deck builder. Master the unique card linking resource system to tackle the patterns and bosses within.

apps.name: Backswamps
apps.short_description: Descend into an endless procedurally generated swamp where every step draws you deeper into a reality that watches back. Explore forgotten fragments and preserve your sanity in an atmospheric psychological horror experience.

apps.name: Barn Rush
apps.short_description: Grab food, haul it home, beat the clock. A colorful pixel time-attack roguelite on your own silly farm: draft upgrades until one little sheep has a tornado, a tractor and a snail on the payroll. Every run gets absurdly strong your way. Earn Feed to unlock new animals, themes, and cosmetics.

apps.name: Baron
apps.short_description: Are you ready to rule the underworld in Turkey’s first open-world action/adventure game? Take up your father’s legacy and bring down the Dark Council. Protect your neighborhood in the streets of Ankara, which are rife with betrayal, and uncover the hidden secrets behind it all!

apps.name: Basketball Dynasty
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

apps.name: Bathroom Please!
apps.short_description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

apps.name: Battle Vision
apps.short_description: Battle your way to fame and glory in this cosmic tactical puzzle-battle roguelike! Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and take them on a season-long run of domination in the universe’s most-watched battle-sport!

apps.name: Battles of Arunia
apps.short_description: Build an army of several different factions with different unique bonuses in a turn-based tactical card game. Position your troops, manage action coins and play your Commander cards to change the battle. Collect cards, refine your deck and test your strategies against bots. Climb the ranks in PvP.

apps.name: Bauble
apps.short_description: An action-stealth roguelite about newly-sentient creatures investigating the sudden collapse of their ecosystem. Sneak, fight, and negotiate your way through expeditions, learning a little more about your planet each time.

apps.name: Beat Bots
apps.short_description:
A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots!

Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound

apps.name: Beatlash: Survival
apps.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

apps.name: Beatrix
apps.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

apps.name: beautiful freaks of the desert
apps.short_description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

apps.name: Become A Monarch
apps.short_description: BaM is a simple project, something like an offline animal walking simulator, focusing on the simplicity of everyday animal life. Don't expect an "animal game" experience here; for that, we recommend Animalia Survival. This is a study project where I release updates as I learn more about EU.

apps.name: Become Emperor 2! My Trillion Beauties Universe Empire
apps.short_description: This is an interactive video game set in a cosmic empire. Explore, make choices at key moments, and embark on your own cosmic adventure.
developers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院
publishers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院

apps.name: Behind the Corner
apps.short_description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

apps.name: Belt Bound Boxing
apps.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

apps.name: Benny's Backrooms
apps.short_description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

apps.name: Bento Express
apps.short_description: Run a tiny bento kiosk on a countryside train platform, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Cook to order, ring up commuters and count their change before the doors close. Talk over proximity voice, dress your own stall keeper and make rent by closing time.

apps.name: Big Dig
apps.short_description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

apps.name: BINARY CRINGEVESTOR
apps.short_description: A binary options parody with a Balatro aftertaste. Take a loan, hit UP or DOWN, and 30 seconds later you’re either rich or pawning your wife’s wedding rings. 12 broker decks, 31 passives with editions, manager Billy, collectors and four weeks of payments. Just like real life, only fun.

apps.name: Bio Inc. Classic
apps.short_description: Relive the original Bio Inc. experience, rebuilt from the ground up for PC to celebrate its 15th anniversary. Develop deadly diseases, cripple your victim’s body, and determine their ultimate fate in this biomedical strategy simulator.

apps.name: Biztopia: Prologue
apps.short_description: Biztopia: Prologue is the free opening of Biztopia. Rent a warehouse, buy from the wholesaler, stock your shelves and send out your first deliveries, alone or with friends in online co-op. Reach level 10, then keep playing.

apps.name: Black Death: Russia
apps.short_description: Take control of Russia's response to a deadly epidemic. Manage hospitals, medical personnel, public finances, quarantines and transport restrictions. Balance public trust against the need to contain the outbreak in this challenging strategy simulation.

apps.name: Black Steel: Syndicate Breaker
apps.short_description: A comic‑book styled 3D fighter with rollback netcode where a determined uncle battles a ruthless syndicate.

apps.name: Black Zero
apps.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

apps.name: Blademash
apps.short_description: An ultra fast-paced 2D arena brawler for 1–4 players with a roguelike twist, made for couch multiplayer fun or competitive online matches. Pick a race and a class, each with its own playstyle, then draft items between battles to build a unique fighter. New races and classes unlock as you play.

apps.name: BlastBall: All-Stars
apps.short_description: Curve shots, unleash Blasts, and power up the chaos! BlastBall: All-Stars brings physics-driven Soccer, Air Hockey, and Gagaball to 1-4 players with zany items and local or online play. Jump into Early Access, with more sports, characters, arenas, and items planned along the way.

apps.name: Bleep Wildlife
apps.short_description: Hunt dangerous animals, return to the tavern, and buy new guns and traps. Complete missions for a mysterious wizard and take on stronger prey.

apps.name: Blockflow
apps.short_description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

apps.name: Bloodfell
apps.short_description: Tear through Hell with devastating weapon and spell builds in this gothic action roguelite. Hunt powerful loot across five procedural biomes, risk another floor, and rebuild Ashenhold for your next descent.

apps.name: Bloodscript//END
apps.short_description: BLOODSCRIPT//END is a dark ASCII roguelike that combines the brutal unpredictability of classic dungeon crawlers with the unhinged chaos of Japanese RPGs.

apps.name: BloomTale
apps.short_description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

apps.name: Body Kounts
apps.short_description:
Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death.
Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

apps.name: Bogey Blazers
apps.short_description: A physics-driven 2.5D disc golf game where you chase down every throw. Compete online with up to 12 players and navigate through courses while avoiding obstacles and deadly traps, or play solo to unlock rewards and beat personal records.

apps.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind
apps.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Prague's Bohnice Asylum. As an investigative journalist, you must document forbidden experiments and chilling paranormal encounters. Collect photographic evidence and survive the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

apps.name: Bomb Them Ores
apps.short_description: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!

apps.name: Book Nook
apps.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

apps.name: BOOMSWEEPER
apps.short_description: An incremental twist on classic Minesweeper. Sweep, earn, upgrade, hire a crew, dig up Finds and go deeper into boards inside boards. One wrong click... BOOM.

apps.name: Bot Survivors
apps.short_description: Bot Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle relentless robot swarms, evade the rising police wanted level, and conquer massive mechanical bosses. Choose upgrades, craft devastating synergies, and survive the apocalypse!

apps.name: Bottled by Bears
apps.short_description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

apps.name: Bouncing Body Bits
apps.short_description: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?

apps.name: BPM Bitcrushed
apps.short_description: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite rhythm shooter where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

apps.name: Brandrheim
apps.short_description: A third-person action RPG dungeon crawler with online co-op for up to 4 players. Explore dangerous dungeons, defeat powerful bosses, collect legendary loot, and build your hero through class-based character progression.

apps.name: BRASS: Hard Contact
apps.short_description: A realistic 2D military shooter. Rounds drop, crack past and punch through boards; fire pins men down; sandbags, smoke and the dark decide fights. Lead squad bots or fight friends over Steam in six modes across eight maps. No killstreaks, no power-ups, no health regen.

apps.name: BRAVO, GASPAR
apps.short_description: "SURVIVE my SADISTIC SHOW. An ACTION ROGUELIKE where your performance with COLLECTIBLE CREATURES serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: ENTERTAIN OR DIE!"

apps.name: Breakaway
apps.short_description: Soccer set in Space. Juggle, Curl, and Save the ball. Offline or Online, from 1v1 to 6v6.

apps.name: Breaker League
apps.short_description: Puzzle-battle mayhem on one shared board. Drop pieces, chain combos, and invade your rivals' turf in frantic 1–4 player matches online or on the couch. 37 ridiculous fighters, 12 game-changing specials, and a 32-level story campaign.

apps.name: Breakneck Transmission
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

apps.name: BroCode
apps.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

apps.name: Broke Wizards
apps.short_description: A 2–6 player competitive sandbox party game where wizard roommates vie to make rent! Slay monsters, play prop hunt, race hoverboards, and take on crazy jobs to pay your giant Imp Landlord first!

apps.name: Brokeline
apps.short_description: One new message. There goes your quiet evening. Chat, flirt, choose your replies and collect character photos in Brokeline, a story-driven messenger game. Meet the people behind the profiles while juggling work, money and plans beyond the screen.

apps.name: Broken Horror Anthology
apps.short_description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

apps.name: BrokenLore: ASCEND
apps.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

apps.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
apps.short_description: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.

apps.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
apps.short_description: A short pixel art incremental clicker about chopping trees. Click to chop, hire 14 kinds of crew who chop for you, befriend 13 grumpy Legendary Trees in timed fights, then Replant and Rebloom for lasting upgrades. About 5-6 hours to the Giga Tree, then endless rematches.

apps.name: BugPot
apps.short_description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

apps.name: BULLETJUMP
apps.short_description: Jump with one hand, shoot with the other. BULLETJUMP is a fast arcade score-chaser: weave through bullet storms, skim close calls to push your multiplier to x5, and chase the player one rank above you. Watch any run back, take on a new Daily Challenge every day, and climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: BurgerJoint: Fast Food Simulator
apps.short_description: A fast food simulator game focused on physics-based mechanics and satisfying cooking experience. Flip, stack, grill and assemble burgers however you like, manage your restaurant’s stock, take orders, and enjoy the running of your own virtual kitchen.

apps.name: Burn It Back
apps.short_description: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.

apps.name: Burrowlings
apps.short_description: Grow four tiny hard-hatted burrowlings into a swarm of over a hundred and dig to the planet's core before the oil lamp burns out. A short incremental game: spend the gold in a web of upgrades, dig again, deeper. Solo, or online in co-op and versus, where a block of ice freezes a rival's shaft.

apps.name: Butterfly Æffect: Papillons à Quatre Mains
apps.short_description: A visual novel about love and violence set in the early 2000's.

apps.name: ByteBuddies
apps.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandonned world and figure out what what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

apps.name: Car Crime Simulator
apps.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

apps.name: Car Flipper
apps.short_description: A first person car flipping game. Find underpriced used cars on your phone and inspect them yourself: pull the dipstick, test the paint, read the codes. Buy the ones that are better than they look, fix what a buyer will notice and sell them on. Play solo or with up to three friends online.

apps.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
apps.short_description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world while collecting your own cards to build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

apps.name: Cardboard Conquest
apps.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 21 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

apps.name: Cartoon Bash
apps.short_description:
Cartoon Bash is a horde survivor game where our dear protagonists who just died must fight to get another chance to get back to life.

You equip multiple weapons and items, fighting off waves of enemies and bosses.

apps.name: Carve and Sort: Tidy Up your Pumpkin Patch!
apps.short_description: Carve, paint and drill pumpkins at the workbench, then sort them onto 26 shelves from A to Z. Pick odd and colorful pumpkins from the patch, tidy the hall together or race each other in versus with up to four players, and see what wakes up when the last shelf is full.

apps.name: Castle Siege Commander
apps.short_description: Command your army with your voice in this multiplayer medieval tactical game. Create custom voice commands, control siege warfare, and fight over strategic supply routes.

apps.name: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
apps.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

apps.name: CATHODE
apps.short_description: Build sprawling defensive networks of high-tech turrets and logistics systems to repel massive enemy swarms! Take direct control of your turrets and utilize powerful support powers to repel the invasion!

apps.name: Caution! Platforming Ahead
apps.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

apps.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake
apps.short_description: This quirky, nerdy, alien farm life sim focuses on balancing community and ecosystem needs. Move to a moon town to be a hydroponic farmer. When dust storms threaten the town's sunlight, you'll grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

apps.name: Cavern Wars
apps.short_description: Cavern Wars is a turn-based strategy game playable with up to 8 players. Lead your cavemen to war, expand your territory and build a large army, dominate the entire map and annihilate your opponents !

apps.name: Cellwright - A FreeCell Roguelike
apps.short_description: This is FreeCell, re-imagined as a roguelike. Chain cards to the foundations to build Mult, collect relics that multiply each other, and beat every deal's quota. Win the eight-ante run, then push into true Endless. Renown, feats and eight Grades carry over between runs.

apps.name: CENSOR
apps.short_description: A sci-fi interrogation game. No more than ten people in the galaxy can do your job. The person across the table is already convicted. Find out why they did it, then decide what the truth will cost them.

apps.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
apps.short_description: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

apps.name: Chartward
apps.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

apps.name: Chef's Adventure
apps.short_description: Tomorrow is Harry's birthday. The Chef only wants to bake a simple cake, but the chickens have broken out and cleared out the whole pantry. Chase them through 5 worlds and 10 levels, learn new moves along the way and get the cake on the table.

apps.name: Chick'n Slide
apps.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

apps.name: Chicken Show
apps.short_description:
Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win!
Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure.
Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

apps.name: Chronicles Meteorfall
apps.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

apps.name: Cinderwake
apps.short_description: A dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees. Fight through four acts of random maps alone or with up to 8 players online. Three world levels and the endless Pyre. Loot, die, return.

apps.name: Circuits: VLSI
apps.short_description: Draw the layers of a silicon chip to build working circuits. Solve 100 puzzles, from wires and transistors to logic, memory, and small clocked machines. Inspect simulated signals, compare your layouts, and experiment freely in Sandbox.

apps.name: City Safety
apps.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

apps.name: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
apps.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

apps.name: Classic American Football
apps.short_description: Score touchdowns and win it all in this retro-inspired, side-scrolling American football game. Run the offense with fluid passing, jukes, dives and broken tackles. Games are quick because the defense is simulated, but Career Mode keeps you playing for seasons as you upgrade your team.

apps.name: Clean Memories
apps.short_description: Clean, repair, and organize forgotten spaces. Uncover the memories hidden beneath the dirt in this relaxing first-person cleaning adventure.

apps.name: Clearly Cribbage
apps.short_description: Play cribbage against the computer and count the points in your own hand. Learn with a guided lesson and counting practice, then play to 121 across four difficulty settings.

apps.name: Climb King
apps.short_description: Climb. Fall. Repeat. A high-stakes pixel-art climbing game with grab-and-swing movement, harsh drops, and “safe points” that aren’t as safe as you’d like.

apps.name: Closed Case
apps.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

apps.name: Clown House: Lunacy
apps.short_description:
A narrative horror experience where violence is a trap.

Unravel the secrets of a derelict mansion and its uncanny clown residents. Solve puzzles. Observe the clowns, deduct their needs and what angers them to survive.

And never harm the residents of the Clown House. It has eyes.

apps.name: Cold Salvage
apps.short_description: A co-op horror investigation game. You're salvage engineers sent aboard derelict ships to find what's nesting in the dark and identify it before it finds you. Gather evidence, keep your crew calm, and get out alive. You can't kill it. You can only name it.

apps.name: Collapsle
apps.short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

apps.name: Collec
apps.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

apps.name: Colony Battle Arena
apps.short_description: You are dealt one of several rival factions. Destroy the enemy before your base falls. Kills move you up the tiers, from your faction's unique unit to drones, vehicles and gunships; losses strengthen your enemy. 8-player RTS: solo or co-op vs bots, ranked and casual online, LAN, mobile cross-play.

apps.name: Command Line Tower Defense
apps.short_description: A terminal tower defense where every command counts. Place and upgrade daemons, counter hostile traffic, and build card combinations in Rogue Descent. A 20-operation Campaign, Endless, and a machine full of secrets. Keyboard-first, with optional mouse controls.

apps.name: Company Captain: Westashes
apps.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

apps.name: COMPARTMENT 666 : ANOMALY EXPRESS
apps.short_description: Inspect every compartment, identify anomalies, and survive a mysterious train where every mistake brings you closer to death. Reach the conductor and uncover the truth behind Compartment 666.

apps.name: Comrade, Secrets Escape!
apps.short_description: Comrade, thousands of bio-experiments are escaping. Line escape routes with guns, blast holes through the horde, and unlock absurd Soviet weapons in this incremental tower defence. Excessive force is authorized.

apps.name: Conjoined
apps.short_description: Step into a relaxing world where you stack and merge magical ingredients. Toss herbs, crystals, and curious finds into a bubbling cauldron to gain essence, travel through the portal to discover new cards and mechanics, enjoy a cozy, stress free magical experience.

apps.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
apps.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

apps.name: Convent Of Magical Chambers
apps.short_description: 3D adventure Immersive sim inspired by the early 2000s level design, explore an abandoned convent filled with ghosts and magical chambers and try to solve the mystery behind the creation of the chambers.

apps.name: Corgi Race Live
apps.short_description: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

apps.name: Corner Arcade
apps.short_description:
Live the dream and run your own arcade in this idle management sim.
Purchase arcade machines and build your space, your way.
Run your arcade, level up and upgrade your machines to attract elite gamers and watch as they empty their pockets to fill yours! Then sit back & enjoy the buzz of the arcade.

apps.name: Cornerwitch
apps.short_description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

apps.name: Cosmic Fugue
apps.short_description: A space exploration and crafting game set in a fully simulated N-body small scale solar system, where you build space infrastructure to progress and figure out the mysteries of the cosmos.

apps.name: Cosmo Cargo
apps.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

apps.name: Covenant
apps.short_description: Covenant is a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.

apps.name: Covert Koalas: Phasco
apps.short_description:
A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. 
Because the world is big enough for all!

apps.name: Cow Online World
apps.short_description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

apps.name: Cozy Banker
apps.short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

apps.name: Cranked
apps.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

apps.name: Crimson Ark
apps.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

apps.name: Crimson Solstice
apps.short_description: A cozy horror adventure. Uncover the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice and decide Moonvale’s fate. Build relationships and manage resources as time is of the essence. Spend your days wisely and help the townsfolk of Moonvale survive.

apps.name: Crispy Billiards
apps.short_description: A realistic 3D online billiards game where you prove your skills in thrilling 1v1 duels. Challenge friends or players from around the world, improve your technique, and become the ultimate billiards champion.

apps.name: Croc 2
apps.short_description: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

apps.name: Crosstalk
apps.short_description: Crosstalk is a hardware architecture design sandbox with a built-in, fully inspectable simulator and emulator. Players build designs ranging from LED controllers to complex computers using SystemVerilog, then program them. It has a gate-level simulator, introspection tools, a compiler, and more.

apps.name: Crypt Runner
apps.short_description: Navigate dangerous crypts, defeat enemies, and gather loot in this extraction dungeon crawler. If you die, you lose it all. Extract alive to bring your spoils back to your base camp. Visit NPCs, upgrade your town, and gear up for another crypt run.

apps.name: Crystalcaller
apps.short_description: Turn the battlefield into your weapon. In this side-view wave-survival roguelite you aim every spell yourself: mark enemies with one element, then ignite them with another. Ten elemental reactions, a spellbook full of power spells, three bosses — and four biomes to hold.

apps.name: CtrlC
apps.short_description: CtrlC is an arcade game with the look of the 80s and the technology of today. You have to reach your goal, level by level. The coders among you know: Ctrl+C cancels a running program in the terminal. You might need that info sometime.

apps.name: Cubic Mage
apps.short_description: An open-ended voxel RPG of elemental magic. Train, explore, craft, and fight alone or with friends to save a world collapsing into the Void.

apps.name: Cubus Tower
apps.short_description:
Cubus tower is a platformer game.
Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

apps.name: Culdcept BEGINS
apps.short_description: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

apps.name: Curse of the Chronomancer
apps.short_description: Race against the clock in this top down action roguelike. Trade time for upgrades that will either save you time in the long run, or ultimately lead to your destruction.

apps.name: Custom Fortress - Beta
apps.short_description: Custom Fortress is a community-driven TF2 sourcemod that attempts to removes hardcoded limits and makes the game fully customizable. With regular updates introducing new community content and general improvements, it allows creators and players to shape the game the way they want to play.

apps.name: Cutteridge Estate
apps.short_description: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

apps.name: Cyan Soul
apps.short_description:
An arcade style, pixel art, boss-rush puzzle action game.
Move your character up, down, right and left!
Dash through enemy attacks and obstacles!
Pick up objects and hurl them at the boss to cause damage!
Gather enough points and unleash max damage with a powerful projectile or form!

apps.name: Cyber Maze
apps.short_description: A retro-futuristic 3D maze game with traps and enemies

apps.name: Darcnia Monster
apps.short_description: Place a card and its monster rises onto the board. A tactical card game, online and free, with no pay to win: every card is earned by playing, never from a gacha, and traded with other players in the Trade Hall and the Auction House.

apps.name: Darkness
apps.short_description: Fear not only what the darkness hides, but the power that draws you toward it. Darkness is a top-down dark fantasy action game where light is your only refuge.

apps.name: Darkphobia
apps.short_description: Turn off the lights. Reach the bed. Stay alive. Play through three intertwining nightmares where light is your only lifeline. Don't stay in the dark too long, or "It" will find you.

apps.name: Darts With Mates
apps.short_description: Darts With Mates is a darts party game for 1–4 players. Host a pub night with Steam friends, play 501, Killer, High Score or Pub Bingo, team up in 2v2, and grab a pint or stay sober between throws.

apps.name: Dead Man's Clock
apps.short_description: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.

apps.name: Dead of the Brain
apps.short_description: A cult classic Japanese PC-98 horror adventure from 1992, resurrected for modern platforms. Investigate a zombie outbreak, survive gruesome encounters, and experience unforgettable pixel art terror in this point & click nightmare.

apps.name: Dead-End Bounty
apps.short_description:
Dead-End Bounty is an open-world top-down shooter set in the wild west!
A frontier with 3 kinds of people: the ones on wanted posters, the ones printing them, and people like Charlie—a bounty hunter with his eyes set on one particular bounty that has slipped through his hands a few too many times.

apps.name: DeadRoot
apps.short_description: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds.

apps.name: Dearbnb
apps.short_description:
Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax.
Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones.
A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.

apps.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command
apps.short_description: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.

apps.name: Debtrize
apps.short_description: You're a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old debts long overdue. Hunt. Kill. Negotiate. Not even death can save you from your debts.

apps.name: Deck of Dynasties
apps.short_description: Deck of Dynasties is a turn-based card battler where nine civilizations send their greatest figures into battle. Build a 45-card deck from 333 heroes, deploy to the front, and spend Action Points to attack and capture slots. Kill the enemy leader to win - match online or duel a friend on Steam.

apps.name: Deliwhere?
apps.short_description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

apps.name: Demon Lord's Corruption Codex
apps.short_description: Step into the Demon Lord's throne. Command, break, and transform the adventurers who dare to invade your domain. Deep corruption mechanics driven by stats and choices, 5 unique heroines, and a full roster rendered entirely in complete CG.

apps.name: Demon Spore
apps.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

apps.name: Desktop Destruction
apps.short_description: Your real desktop, frozen into a picture and made of glass, wood, metal, paper, concrete or flesh. Then you get the hammer, the chainsaw, the flamethrower and fourteen more tools, and every one breaks every material the way the real thing would.

apps.name: Deslot Legends
apps.short_description: Deslot Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

apps.name: Detective Club
apps.short_description: Investigate crime scenes, question the people involved, and expose a lie with decisive evidence. Play two complete cases for free, including their endings and explanations. Continue your investigations with separately purchased casebooks.

apps.name: Deus Ex Remastered
apps.short_description: This is Deus Ex Remastered – the definitive version of Ion Storm’s legendary cyberpunk immersive sim, modernized with visual upgrades, modern enhancements, and quality-of-life improvements for a new generation of operatives.

apps.name: Die Casting Together
apps.short_description: A co-op tactics roguelite where two heroes each roll a die and the whole turn goes off at once, enemies and all! Draft cards that bend the rules, push your luck on a big roll, then dig into Endless. Friendly fire stays on. Online, hotseat, or solo: run both heroes or bring a bot.

apps.name: Dino Carnage
apps.short_description: The staff turned. The dinosaurs didn't. ZENGEN sends your crew to its overrun island in a mobile armored rig to clear every zombie, and to mind the company's property: employees are expendable thanks to ZENGEN technology. First-person survival horror for 1-8 players.

apps.name: Dinolords
apps.short_description: Dinolords combines real-time strategy, city-building and action RPG combat in the genre hybrid Hack’n’Strat. Build your stronghold, command human and dinosaur armies and fight as the lord shaping a new age of warfare.

apps.name: Disaster Crew
apps.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

apps.name: Dispatch Loop
apps.short_description: You are the courier. Every contract is a delivery loop: choose which cards go on the map, build combos and survive the obstacles you bring on yourself. Between runs, upgrade your home and your bike, then take the next job.

apps.name: DOME DECRY
apps.short_description: Dome Decry is a semi-tactical, cooperative third-person survival game set in a region of the Amazon trapped beneath a massive containment structure. Betrayed and cast into the Dome, you must survive against creatures and military patrols, explore, rescue survivors, and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Don't Press This SH*T
apps.short_description: You find yourself in a room with no door and fingers sticking out of the walls. At first, you press them out of curiosity. Then you learn to live with the consequences. Survive, experiment and find a way out solo or with up to 4 players. In ranked PvP, objects become weapons.

apps.name: Doomed Village
apps.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

apps.name: Doomigos
apps.short_description: Doomigos is a third-person 3D bullet heaven roguelite! Survive relentless waves of enemies, unleash destruction with automatically firing weapons, and battle powerful bosses in chaotic arena combat. Keep moving, keep fighting, and survive the madness!

apps.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
apps.short_description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

apps.name: DOT: KillBox TD
apps.short_description: Dots are coming. Build a maze of barriers, mount lasers, flamers, missiles and cannons, and stop an ever-growing horde before it reaches the End. Play solo, co-op or PvP — or design your own maps in the built-in editor.

apps.name: Doubtbound
apps.short_description: A turn-based RPG of hidden betrayal. Battle through branching encounters, uncover the traitor within your party, and overthrow the Mad Monarch in multiplayer or solo investigation mode.

apps.name: Draft Eleven
apps.short_description: Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite where you build your perfect XI, scout the transfer market, create powerful synergies, adapt your tactics, and compete in asynchronous PvP against squads built by real players from around the world.

apps.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
apps.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

apps.name: Drainer
apps.short_description:
Fight waves of enemies using your HP as ammunition. Power up and unlock new weapons and abilities.
Take control of a tyrant’s heart. Find him. Punish him for his sins.

apps.name: Dream Hollow
apps.short_description: Manage your courage each day to delve deeper into an eerie storybook forest. Explore the woods, decide the fate of its fearful denizens, and make it back to your cottage before your RESOLVE runs out. A cozy-horror adventure game where choices matter.

apps.name: DriftyLands
apps.short_description: Buy an island, clear it, automate it, then find the hole underneath. A first-person base builder, solo or co-op with up to 4 players: gather, craft, build machines, and take your tools down into the dungeon below every island you buy.

apps.name: Drill Deep
apps.short_description: Drill Deep is a coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into madness of haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

apps.name: Drone Tanks
apps.short_description: Battle through high-energy 3D arenas, forge powerful upgrade synergies, and master fast-paced combat in a roguelite built for endless replayability. Pilot a flying tank, bonk enemies with a massive hammer, and take on bosses whose attacks are orchestrated by the soundtrack itself.

apps.name: Duck Duck Run
apps.short_description:
The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them!
Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

apps.name: Duckpool
