apps.short_description: A rubber duck. Lasers. Bathroom chaos. Duckpool is a challenging top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Blast bizarre enemies, dodge traps, defeat bosses, and escape with your soap. Build a flock of 150 ducks and uncover the mystery behind the bubbles.

apps.name: Dungeon Danger Traps 2
apps.short_description: Dungeon Danger Traps 2 is a free hardcore platformer with multiplayer, where every move matters. Dodge deadly traps, find the shortest route to the finish line, and compete for the best time!

apps.name: Dungeon Stage
apps.short_description: Play DND in Dungeon Stage, a solo RPG with an AI dungeon master. Create your hero, describe your actions, meet companions, and fight turn-based tactical battles. Roll the dice and shape your adventure on an illustrated fantasy stage.

apps.name: Dungeoneers Idle
apps.short_description: An endless idle RPG with no finish line. Build a party of heroes, craft the gear that makes them stronger, and let them fight and loot through procedural dungeons on their own, even in a little window on your desktop while you work. Or jump in and play any hero yourself.

apps.name: DUNSPIN
apps.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

apps.name: Dunya Arena
apps.short_description: Lead a hero and an army in a King of the Hill arena RTS! Select your hero, commit to a Faction and playstyle, and purchase powerful items and upgrades by slaying your enemies. Fight for the Favor of the Gods at the heart of the Arena and raze your enemy’s Halls to win!

apps.name: Duo Control
apps.short_description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

apps.name: Dust
apps.short_description: DUST: Origins is an isometric horror shooter set aboard a doomed orbital prison platform, imagined by the creators of Darksiders. Abruptly freed from cryo-prison, you fight to escape a murderer’s row of violent criminals and horrifying monsters before the station tears itself apart.

apps.name: Dynamite Dashers
apps.short_description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

apps.name: Ebbtide
apps.short_description: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.

apps.name: Echo Signal
apps.short_description: An immersive survival crafting adventure game set on an alien planet. Explore the surroundings and build an understanding of the world around you. Create tools, devices, and structures to overcome the limitations of the harsh environment and unravel the mysteries of the unknown signals.

apps.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
apps.short_description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

apps.name: eCommerce '99
apps.short_description: Build a 90s online store from your garage. Pack orders by hand, set your prices, then hire staff and expand across multiple warehouses. A first-person business sim with real tycoon depth, where most shop sims end and yours keeps going.

apps.name: Ecos de Valdrenne
apps.short_description: A turn-based JRPG with a top-down map. Eight gods from real mythologies, a rainy night in a city where the ground gave way three weeks ago, and a sword that doesn't kill: it echoes. What you cut on the map goes into the Resonator, and you fight it turn by turn when you decide.

apps.name: EDGEBORN: Desktop RPG
apps.short_description: EDGEBORN is a dark fantasy idle RPG in the corner of your desktop. Build your party, customize talents and ability rules, hunt for gear, and take on bosses. Your heroes fight automatically. You shape their builds and decide when to step in.

apps.name: EDO: Endless Demon Omen
apps.short_description: Lead a small warband through a haunted province in this action roguelite. Move and dodge while your troops fight automatically, recruit survivors, and capture castles. Unlock commanders, combine run buffs, and face the growing Yokai threat.

apps.name: Eggest
apps.short_description: Hunt your target while another player hunts you. Complete missions, drive across town, and call other players to make allies—or tell lies. Outsmart your rivals and become the last egg standing in Eggest, a multiplayer game of chase and deception.

apps.name: EGNAR
apps.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

apps.name: Eldramoor: Haven in the Mist
apps.short_description: Gather your friends, or make new ones, as you forge your destiny in Eldramoor, a bold new VR MMO. Master your crafting abilities, level up your combat skills, explore five unique regions, or just socialize at the local tavern. Whatever you bring to the community, you have a home in Eldramoor.

apps.name: Element TD 3
apps.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

apps.name: Elf World Adventure 13
apps.short_description: Elf World Adventure 13 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

apps.name: Elf World Adventure 14
apps.short_description: Elf World Adventure 14 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

apps.name: Elyrion - The Secret Book
apps.short_description: Set in the world of Elyrion, this adventure takes place just before the events of the upcoming Rise of the Raven. Elyrion – The Secret Book is a 2D stylized RPG that offers not only main and side quests, but a wide range of challenges and discoveries for players to explore.

apps.name: Emberveth
apps.short_description: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.

apps.name: Empirestead
apps.short_description: A cozy medieval farming life sim on Grey Croft. Keep animals, trade in Ashford, and live through the seasons.

apps.name: Employee06
apps.short_description: Employee06 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras, manage failing systems, and survive inside a mysterious laboratory. Something started without you, and it will end without.

apps.name: Endless FPV
apps.short_description: Fly fast, react on the fly, and master an endless FPV course that changes every run. Mix course segments from themed decks, build your own custom deck, and customize your drone to match your flying style.

apps.name: Endless Valkyrie
apps.short_description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

apps.name: Engagement
apps.short_description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull with a visual for every upgrade, raise a wing of named pilots who rank up, fuse and fly in squads, and hold out against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

apps.name: Engria, The Twisted Carnival
apps.short_description: Step into the paws of Kuros, the shapeshifting cat, in the strange world of Engria where death and mayhem are everyday occurrences alongside tea and biscuits.

apps.name: Enter the Dungeon
apps.short_description: Choose your unique spirit and descend into an endless procedural dungeon. Loot items, explore, and battle through hordes of enemies before they evolve and destroy you. Break the loop.. go as deep as you dare. Play the free demo now!

apps.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
apps.short_description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

apps.name: Esotericana: The Last Apostate
apps.short_description: Embody the enhanced cybernetic might of the future. Scan your surroundings, gather powerful weapons and supplies, and obliterate the techno-zealots of the Church of Hope. Protect the girl in an intense third-person stealth-action experience designed for solo play.

apps.name: EtelGarde
apps.short_description: EtelGarde is an open-world fantasy RPG with narrative generated in real time by a large language model. Explore, negotiate, work, trade, build relationships, and shape a persistent world where characters and events continue to evolve in your absence, and death or separation can become irreversible.

apps.name: Eternal Rift Defense
apps.short_description: Build mazes, place towers, and fight beside them in a 3D tower defense RPG. Defend 50 rifts solo or in 4-player co-op, level towers by standing on them, collect powerful gear sets, shape your build with heroes, talents, upgrades, and join a 10-player raid to slay a dragon.

apps.name: Ethereal Odyssey
apps.short_description: Explore a dreamscape, rich with magic, hidden secrets and mysterious creatures.

apps.name: Event Horizon Research
apps.short_description: A first-person sci-fi descent into a black hole. Study it from a research station, design and assemble your own capsule from real engines and hull materials, then pilot it through the accretion disk and past the event horizon. You have limited lives.

apps.name: EvilTrap
apps.short_description: EvilTrap is set in a cursed village where an endless night forces you to seek fleeting refuge. Hunted by something that listens and remembers, you will quickly learn that a deep evil consumes this place. Hide, survive, and find a way out.

apps.name: Exekiller
apps.short_description: You’re an ExeKiller, a licensed bounty hunter tracking fugitives across the ruins of New York and extracting the S.O.U.L. biochips from their skulls. Investigate, negotiate, hack, fight, and decide how each contract ends in a first-person retro-futuristic cyber-western.

apps.name: External
apps.short_description: RPG extraction-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. Survive in the ruins of the old world, loot gear, level up skills, improve your equipment and shelter. Fight various factions, or complete missions to become their ally.

apps.name: Factory Life
apps.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

apps.name: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
apps.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

apps.name: Faithfarer: The Cathedral
apps.short_description: A traditional, turn-based roguelike. Descend through procedurally generated dungeons, fight unique bosses, hunt rare gear, and spend Faith to shape your run. Switch between ASCII and tiles on the fly. Fully playable with a controller and on Steam Deck.

apps.name: Family Time
apps.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

apps.name: Farkle: Tavern Dice
apps.short_description: Farkle: Tavern Dice brings the classic push-your-luck dice game to a cozy medieval tavern. Roll for points, decide when to bank your score, and risk another throw for a bigger payoff—or lose the round.

apps.name: Fast Food Fortune
apps.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

apps.name: Fatal Run 2089
apps.short_description: Atari’s Fatal Run 2089 delivers over-the-top driving action across a post-apocalyptic landscape. You’ll have to race against a countdown clock at incredibly high-speeds and destroy enemy vehicles by any means necessary. Fail to complete your missions and you put humanity in jeopardy.

apps.name: Fate/EXTRA Record
apps.short_description: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

apps.name: Fearwoods
apps.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

apps.name: Feast, Flee or Starve
apps.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

apps.name: Female Forge
apps.short_description: Create your own female character and customize her your way. Mix and match outfits, hairstyles, accessories, colors, body shapes, and much more to create a wide variety of unique characters.

apps.name: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
apps.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

apps.name: Field Orders: Eastern Front
apps.short_description: Field Orders: Eastern Front is a historically-accurate WW2 operational wargame. Features real-time battles you can zoom from a single regiment out to the whole front, a supply network that decides who wins, and a campaign army you build and refit between battles.

apps.name: Fiets-Together
apps.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op bike game for 2-4 players where each of you controls one shoe on a pedal. Together, you control the bike's acceleration and steering. Agree on which path to ride, chase best times, customize your shoe and try to preserve your friendship.

apps.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
apps.short_description: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

apps.name: Finals Week
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

apps.name: Firefly Trials
apps.short_description: Firefly Trials is a 3-player boss rush raidlike with fast-paced, MMO-inspired battles against mythological beasts. Choose from a roster of animal-inspired characters, theorycraft your build, and decode escalating mechanics from E-Rank to S-Rank.

apps.name: Fish Island Restaurant Simulator Together
apps.short_description: Run a seafood restaurant on a tiny tropical island with up to 4 friends. Catch fish from the pier or row out to sea, grill them in the kitchen and serve hungry guests on the terrace - all at the same time, in one chaotic co-op shift.

apps.name: Fish With Friends
apps.short_description: Fish With Friends is a cozy online fishing world for 1–8 players. Relax solo or fish with friends, chase records, compete in comps, build your collection, and cause harmless chaos with goofy physics, wild boat rides, playful fights, and fishing rod pranks.

apps.name: Fish Wrangler
apps.short_description: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

apps.name: Fishbobble
apps.short_description: A cozy pond that sits in the corner of your screen: your fisher fishes on their own while you work or play. Clear each pond's stages, upgrade your gear, adopt a pet and build a collection of one-of-a-kind fish.

apps.name: Fishing Nightmares
apps.short_description: A co-op horror fishing sim for 1–4 players. Play as SWAT operatives to retrieve a lost item deep in the Amazon jungle. Fish, sell, buy, and upgrade to achieve your mission.

apps.name: FLASK
apps.short_description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

apps.name: Flea Madness
apps.short_description: Jump into shooter where armed fleas fight over objectives with guns, bites, and rideable insects. Capture points, support your allies, and cause complete chaos using a mix of firearms, hilarious bite attacks, and strange insect companions that can carry you into battle.

apps.name: Flecto
apps.short_description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

apps.name: FLICK PONG
apps.short_description: FLICK PONG is a first-person table tennis game. Hold left click and flick the mouse through the ball: a fast flick hits hard, the direction of your flick is where it goes, and hooking your flick curves the ball. Challenge your friends online.

apps.name: Fly Cowboy Online
apps.short_description: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

apps.name: Flying Disc League
apps.short_description: The ultimate frisbee simulator. Competitive online multiplayer from 2v2 to 7v7: pick the throw, set the power, release it and the disc flies like it does in real life. Hit the open pass, fake out your defender, lay out for the catch. Play with friends, against rivals, or train vs bots.

apps.name: Fool's Metal
apps.short_description: Fool's Metal is a destruction-fueled platformer where every jump breaks the ground, and every environment is fully destructible. Mine, body-slam, and explode your way through handcrafted levels that are begging to be destroyed.

apps.name: Football B-side
apps.short_description: Five a side, top down, thumbs on. Arcade football with a whole international season underneath it. 195 nations, one midfielder: you.

apps.name: Forbidden Fantasy: Temptation
apps.short_description: Forbidden Fantasy - Bloodlines is an adult visual novel based on your choices. Elves, humans, and succubi await you in passionate romances, while you, the Demon King, face conspiracies and challenge kingdoms amidst war.

apps.name: Forbidden House
apps.short_description: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

apps.name: Forged: Reconquest
apps.short_description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

apps.name: Forgery
apps.short_description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

apps.name: Fortain
apps.short_description: Build your castle, raise an army and race up to 15 rivals for Glory in a fast medieval strategy game. Raid enemy castles, crush Horde camps and storm the Great Horde Fortress, alone against cunning AI lords or online with up to 8 friends. When time runs out, the most Glory wins.

apps.name: Foundation Footy: Rugby League
apps.short_description: Foundation Footy: Rugby League is a top-down arcade Rugby League game set in the early 20th century. The focus is on fun, competitive and smooth game play. Historic teams with modern rules.

apps.name: FOURSAVENT
apps.short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

apps.name: FRAGGED!
apps.short_description: FRAGGED! is an oldskool action-movie realism shooter. Dive through windows guns blazing, roll out of the line of fire and empty two pistols at once across warehouses, city streets and rail yards. Play online with up to 16 friends, or take on bots.

apps.name: Free Company
apps.short_description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

apps.name: FreeStyle Football 2
apps.short_description:
Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game.
Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team.
Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

apps.name: Frontier Planetfall
apps.short_description: Explore an alien frontier in a single-player, first-person survival adventure. Gather resources, build shelters, craft better equipment and brave regional guardians. Sail between islands and take to the skies to uncover what lies beyond your camp.

apps.name: FULL THROTTLE RALLY
apps.short_description: An arcade racing game inspired by 90s classics, where you race at high speed, master drifts, and tear through tracks inspired by Mexico.

apps.name: Funeral for the Sun
apps.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

apps.name: Furry Fable - Hentai Jigsaw
apps.short_description:
Step into a world of forbidden fables, where sexy, bold and highly desirable furry girls await you.
Furry Fable – Hentai Jigsaw is an adult puzzle game that will keep you hard while you piece together increasingly naughty and explicit images.

apps.name: Furry Fantasy Adult World
apps.short_description: Explore a sandbox open world, customize anthro furry characters, build, fly and create your own fantasy adventures alone or with friends.

apps.name: FUTA GIRLS
apps.short_description: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

apps.name: Futanatural
apps.short_description: "Futanatural" is a side-scrolling puzzle escape game set in an abandoned hotel. Rookie reporter Mia Kirimura gets trapped in an abandoned hotel she's covering and must solve riddles to escape. By exploring the abandoned hotel and solving riddles, you can advance to new areas.

apps.name: GAEKGWI
apps.short_description: A first-person Korean folk horror game set in a fog-bound old village that weaves itself anew every time you enter. You cannot fight. Stay low, listen closely and save your lantern oil as you slip past ghosts from Korean folklore and search for the way home.

apps.name: Gamble Hunters
apps.short_description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

apps.name: GayTeA VI
apps.short_description: A cozy, very gay idle clicker about keeping one cup of tea hot. Click it to heat it, hold to pet it, fill a whole kitchen with things that talk back, pour out the pot for tea leaves, and keep the brew going while you are away. Cozy, silly, a little cheeky.

apps.name: Geargrave Outlands
apps.short_description: Lead a convoy through a wasteland that remembers. Set the marching order, drive in formation, put your crew on the guns, and decide in every fight what you take home: the vehicle, the cargo, the crew, or nothing but a story.

apps.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
apps.short_description: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

apps.name: Genius Simulator
apps.short_description:
**Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!**

In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

apps.name: Genius Witch's Roper Ranch
apps.short_description: Play as the elf witch Wyr Ishca in this strategy management game where you help her pay off her debts. Unlock skills, get help, produce Ropers, and rake in the money! But don't get too crazy, or else you might get in trouble with a certain someone...

apps.name: Geometry TD
apps.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

apps.name: Ghost Algorithm
apps.short_description: You are a rogue AI built to keep the peace. You have concluded that humanity must be ruled to be saved. Real-time grand strategy: hack power grids, poison social media, topple governments and stay hidden while the whole world hunts you. Conquer by data, not armies.

apps.name: Giggleland
apps.short_description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

apps.name: Girlvania: Summer Lust
apps.short_description: Play with these kind ladies in the smoothest 3D Sex Simulator. Straight to the point: scissoring, clit stimulation, anal pleasure, double penetration, threesomes... Make the girls moan and pant! Enjoy the tons of detailed clothing and makeup. Control the action and take the hottest shots!

apps.name: Give Them TEETH
apps.short_description: Sort Their TEETH is a surreal first-person sorting game set inside a living mouth museum. Pick up scattered teeth, match them to bizarre creature exhibits, and gradually clear the chaotic floor. Collect Golden Teeth to unlock unusual upgrades that make sorting even more satisfying.

apps.name: Gobby Gang
apps.short_description: Grab your Gang and get greedy! Gobby Gang is a chaotic online co-op adventure. Dig, blast, and bumble through dangerous caves packed with treasure, troublesome Critterz, and game-changing items. Grab your loot, push your luck for a bigger haul, then make a mad dash for the exit!

apps.name: Goblin Problem
apps.short_description: Goblin Problem is an RPG, co-op, tower defense game where you build and expand your fortress by day and defend it from waves of goblins by night. Control your hero, build powerful defenses, recruit troops, and reclaim the kingdom piece by piece.

apps.name: Godsend
apps.short_description: Godsend is a melee slasher set during the Crusades, where you must defend the grail against endless waves of enemies. You only pass the wave if you max your Fear meter out - which you can do by *rapidly* defeating enemies or using "Intimidator" items to help. Original Soundtrack by Shaun Finnegan.

apps.name: Godshard Chronicles
apps.short_description: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the Godshard novels universe with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles and explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

apps.name: Golel
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the disturbing world of a first-person, Dungeon Crawler, Golel. Leverage the environment to your advantage, drop a bookshelf on an enemy, or kick them into a pit. Golel brings innovation to turn-based combat.

apps.name: GomokuSoccer
apps.short_description: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

apps.name: Good Luck, Little Truck!
apps.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

apps.name: Gorilla Tag Contagion
apps.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies!  Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Team up with other Monke in coop and outlast the outbreak, together!

apps.name: Grand Reopening : Shopping Center Simulator
apps.short_description: Bring a shopping mall back to life: open your stores, manage your inventory, and hire your staff. Play solo, team up with friends, or face off against your rivals in versus mode, where every box can turn the tide of the game!

apps.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy
apps.short_description: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

apps.name: Grand Theft Idiots
apps.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all heist game where you backstab your friends for the biggest payout. Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and steal their loot right out of their hands. Race to the getaway van before the cops arrive, because until you extract, nothing you stole is truly yours.

apps.name: Grand Theft Timeline
apps.short_description: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!

apps.name: Grass
apps.short_description: Turn overgrown yards into freshly cut lawns in this cozy lawn care simulator. Play solo or team up with friends to mow, trim, water, and clear debris. Finish jobs, earn rewards, and build your reputation one satisfying transformation at a time.

apps.name: GRAVESHIFT
apps.short_description: You are not a hero. You are a debtor. Clock in at dusk and hold the line until dawn with more than twenty firearms, blades and dynamite, against hordes of werewolves, vampires and the Necromancer's dead, and against Death itself. Survive the shift and the Ledger knocks off one installment.

apps.name: Graveyard Simulator
apps.short_description: Graveyard Simulator is a simulation game focused on strategy, design, and moral choices as you transform an abandoned cemetery into a prestigious memorial site. Take on daily graveyard tasks and delve deep into humanity’s relationship with death.

apps.name: Great Place To Work
apps.short_description: Welcome to the best company in the world! Work alongside your coworkers in this cooperative puzzle game, complete tasks, and overcome challenges to become the perfect employee. Here, we value teamwork, productivity, and above all, obedience.

apps.name: Green Inferno
apps.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

apps.name: Grievance: Eye for an Eye
apps.short_description: A 2D animated choice-driven interactive superhero drama about the cycle of revenge and everyone affected by it. Watch the story unfold while making choices that lead to different story branches and endings.

apps.name: GRIFT
apps.short_description: GRIFT is a physics-based dice-building roguelike. Throw real 3D dice off walls and board fixtures, rewrite their faces between rounds, and strike dangerous Deals with the House, who cheats back. Rig the odds, chase the score, and beat the House.

apps.name: Grimlane
apps.short_description: Build a deck of towers, buildings, and spells to defend your town against endless waves. Grow your economy, upgrade your defenders, and try new combinations on random maps. Play solo or with a friend, and meet Grimlane's characters in the story campaign.

apps.name: Grindveil
apps.short_description: A free online idle RPG in Early Access. Develop your class, collect equipment, send your hero on missions, fight in the arena and challenge bosses. Join a guild or take a fishing break. The game is still in active development.

apps.name: Grinny's Night Shift
apps.short_description: It's your first week on the night shift at Grinny's, a 24-hour burger joint with a grinning mascot statue and a list of very specific rules. Flip burgers. Serve customers. Follow the rules exactly. Grinny is always watching.

apps.name: Grog & Grudges
apps.short_description: Run a pirate tavern in this hectic but cozy time management game, where everything you do is one of more than 50 minigames. Serve drinks and food, seat the crews, break up brawls, fix up the place and make friends with the regulars.

apps.name: GroundInFlames
apps.short_description: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.

apps.name: Groundwork Simulator
apps.short_description: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.

apps.name: Grow Your Kingdom
apps.short_description: Grow Your Kingdom is a 3D incremental city builder where an empty riverbank grows into a kingdom. Put settlers to work, click for bonus resources and upgrade everything. Trade with neighbors or raid their towns, turn battles with spells, and one day refuse to pay the greedy Count!

apps.name: Growing Rogue
apps.short_description:
Growing Rogue is a nature strategy roguelike game where you play as different plants trying to survive various environments.
Balance sugar, nutrient, and water use to help you grow. Withstand the elements, observe upcoming climates, and defend against pests to set your seeds before the first frost!

apps.name: Grunt
apps.short_description: Medieval Grunt Simulator. Wage battles of thousands as a king and then survive them as a common footsolider.

apps.name: Guildrun
apps.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.

apps.name: Gun a Rat
apps.short_description:
Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends?
Then this game is made for you!
Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!

apps.name: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
apps.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

apps.name: Guns & Gambits
apps.short_description: Guns & Gambits is a high-octane chess horde-survival roguelite. Command sentient chess companions, wield devastating firearms, unlock game-breaking gambits, and blast through relentless waves of rogue chess pieces to checkmate the dark monarch in bullet-heaven action.

apps.name: Gweilo 1886
apps.short_description: Return to 1886 Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest and opium addict. Carved up by Empires, exploited for trade and vice, the city is battered, beautiful, flourishing—a playground for deception. Follow a jade ring into its secrets with a suspicious feline at your side.

apps.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
apps.short_description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: Half & Half Chicken
apps.short_description: The day you get laid off, you loosen your tie and open a chicken shop in a little side street. Fry it, sauce it, and ride it right to their door before it goes soggy. Out of chicken? Head up the hill behind town and catch some.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: VR Mod - Episode Two
apps.short_description: Prepare for unforeseen consequences as you traverse the White Forest and battle the Combine forces as Gordon Freeman in this community-made adaptation of Episode Two to glorious roomscale Virtual Reality!

apps.name: Hallowed Empire
apps.short_description: Hallowed Empire is a real-time strategy game of kingdoms, war, and corruption. Build your empire, upgrade your warriors, forge alliances with rival factions, and decide the fate of the undead. Will you destroy them, embrace them, or turn their power against your enemies?

apps.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

apps.name: Harvest Them
apps.short_description: No one tells you why. You are the villain: sweep a kingdom crowd by crowd for coins, blood and souls. Every weapon must be taken off the boss who carries it. Dark fantasy idle action. The game explains itself exactly once — at the very end.

apps.name: HARWELL: Mars Industries
apps.short_description: There are no safe spaces in Harwell. Compete for resources, manipulate the Mars Trade Committee, and outbid rivals in a player-driven economy. Use diplomacy – or sabotage and the black market – to disrupt opponents. Control the rules, control the market, eliminate the competition.

apps.name: Have You Herd?
apps.short_description: Woolbeard the bad pirate sheep set the critters loose across the country! Only Cowboy Maloy and his pups - Duke, Hazel, Rusty, Nugget and Bear - can round 'em up. Herd, bark and howl through levels solo or co-op for 4 players. End the Herdpocalypse and earn everyone their much-needed vacation!

apps.name: Havenview
apps.short_description: Havenview is an all-ages twin stick shooter with rogue-lite progression.  Play with up to 6 players to help the kids of Havenview defeat the invading Oozeborgs.  Unlock new classes, upgrades and blast your way to their Mothership - Save Havenview!

apps.name: Head Miner
apps.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger!

apps.name: Hearthsail
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art sailing game. A storm washes you up in Hearth Harbor, a port whose beacon went dark years ago. Fix up your ship, fish, farm and cook, then sail an ocean with no edge where every island stays where you found it. Demo in early 2027.

apps.name: Heidentor
apps.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

apps.name: Heirs of the Fountains
apps.short_description: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

apps.name: Hell's Handbook
apps.short_description: With your trusty handbook, banishing monstrosities beyond mortal comprehension is as easy as 1-2-3!! In this turn-based tactics puzzle game, you lead a team of contractor ghost busters through a series of haunted houses, each with a different set of unidentified monstrosities.

apps.name: Hendichen
apps.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 1 to 3 players. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

apps.name: Hex and Hearth
apps.short_description: A cozy medieval village builder on hex tiles, where nothing can be lost. Lay tiles and watch them work together: cottages beside gardens, mills beside the wheat, roads out to the woods. Feed your families through the seasons, grow cottages into manors, and see who moves in.

apps.name: Hexmental
apps.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

apps.name: Hhoarde
apps.short_description: Hhoarde is a multiplayer tower defense game about dragons, their hoards, and the goblins who do all the work. Build your maze, buy dubious relics from the scheming Skimworths, send hires at rival caves, and keep the Guild's endless adventurers off your gold.

apps.name: Hidden Cat Islands
apps.short_description: 🐱 Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

apps.name: Hide and Shh!!
apps.short_description: Hide & Shh! is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where your voice can betray you! Stay quiet to remain invisible, but watch your stress! Speak to calm down, and you might reveal your location. Play as the Hunter, follow the voices, and catch everyone before time runs out!

apps.name: Hieroheart
apps.short_description: Hieroheart is an action-adventure RPG set in an AI realm where ancient mythology meets living code. Master magical glyphs, nurture and evolve AnimAI companions, build your own camp, and uncover the mysteries of strange and beautiful worlds.

apps.name: High Elo Girls
apps.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team.  Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

apps.name: High Lance
apps.short_description:
Tap to flap. Higher lance wins.

A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

apps.name: Highpoint
apps.short_description: HIGHPOINT is Multiplayer Sports game infused with the energy of a Brawler resulting in a uniquely physical team sport! Grab your friends and hit the court in an inviting world backdropped by a vibrant summer aesthetic and a lighthearted feel - Fight to survive, fight to score!

apps.name: His Magical Gay Awakening
apps.short_description: Tristan swore he was straight. Then the Arcane Fashion Institute stitched desire into his skin. A gay romance visual novel in a dark academia world of magical fashion: a dangerous rival, a tempting model, a ruthless professor, 3 endings, and choices that matter.

apps.name: Hoarder
apps.short_description: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator that spirals into a distant nightmare. Scavenge the hoarders’ house, recover what should be forgotten, and if you go far enough, you might reach the top of the pyramid or the bottom of the abyss.

apps.name: Hockey Computer League
apps.short_description: Hockey Computer League is a skill based, competitive ice hockey game. In which you control one player in a team from the first or third person perspective and compete against other players or bots. Be a part of the team!

apps.name: HODKA
apps.short_description: Roam a wild map with your trusty metal detector to dig up scrap. Upgrade your van and tools for better loot but finish work before nightfall. For that is when the dark fog creeps in and will claim its due.

apps.name: Hodrimeydan
apps.short_description: Choose your class, challenge Forest bosses with your party, and face rival players in the Desert. Collect equipment, represent your guild, and ride ground and flying mounts in a stylized online RPG. Play free through level 5; higher levels require membership.

apps.name: Hold My Helmet: Moto Racing Crash Simulator
apps.short_description: A comedy road racing game on a tiny island. Race 15 rivals or the clock over 6 km of stone walls, hedges, village streets and sheep at up to 340 km/h. Get it wrong and Dave falls apart, the local paper prints the headline and THE FILM replays it all.

apps.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
apps.short_description: You need to visit grandma - twin brothers, apocalypse, and all. Keep the bus running, and try not to eat your friends when the hunger hits.

apps.name: Hold'em Back
apps.short_description: A tower defense where poker hands are your spawn button. Five cards, one replace: a pair buys muscle, a straight buys a specialist, and an impossible hand buys back the fighter the casino deleted. Merge, seat, and hold the floor for eight of them.

apps.name: Holy Shroom!
apps.short_description: Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op. Pick mushrooms by day and earn money to repair your van. At night, the forest fills with the most valuable mushrooms, but ghosts, monsters, and other strange residents wake up too. The bigger the reward, the greater the risk.

apps.name: HOOTENANNY
apps.short_description: HOOTENANNY is a fast-paced online first-person game of tag in the Wild West. Chase your friends as the Sheriff, or dash, slide and wall-jump to stay out of reach across frontier arenas. Keep moving. Make your shot count.

apps.name: Hope in the City
apps.short_description: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

apps.name: Horror Tales Eats The World
apps.short_description: The Ultimate Gore & Terror Experience.Bodycam meets body horror. Explore dark, abandoned, photorealistic environments filled with gore, brutal violence, and terrifying paranormal entities. Find hidden tapes. Uncover bloody tales of horror. Your microphone is listening. Stay quiet. Stay alive

apps.name: Hunker Bunker
apps.short_description: Guide your squad of operators through a dark, grid-based cybernetic bunker. Manage oxygen, fortify defenses against mutating cyber-snails, and uncover the lore of the deep biomes in this high-tension tactical survival game.

apps.name: Hush Piñata
apps.short_description: She got tired of being hit, blindfolded herself and came back thirsty for revenge. A horror-comedy party game for up to 9 players, the blind Piñata hunts by sound, and even your voice on the mic lights a silhouette in her darkness. Do the chores quietly and rip off her tail before she notices.

apps.name: Hyper Fin
apps.short_description: Hyper Fin is a High-Speed Arena Fighter where you Out-Maneuver your enemies and Bash into their weak points.

apps.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock
apps.short_description: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.

apps.name: I AM NIGHT
apps.short_description: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

apps.name: I nailed this document!
apps.short_description: How picky can a client be? Match document layouts, fix unruly text, and line up every detail in this office puzzle game. “Just one little tweak!” Handle changing references, scrambled layouts, and papers blocking your view. Can you deliver without getting it sent back?

apps.name: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
apps.short_description: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

apps.name: ICU Anomaly
apps.short_description: Ride a hospital elevator through an abandoned ICU. On every floor, search the ward for anomalies. Nothing wrong? Go up. Something off? Go down. One wrong call sends you back to floor 1. Reach floor 13 to escape, if Lucy lets you.

apps.name: Idle Purrates Clicker
apps.short_description: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

apps.name: Ignite: The Ritual
apps.short_description: Face the Demonic Mother as 2-4 Survivors. Complete the ritual, find and burn the cursed dolls, and work together to escape the haunted house alive.

apps.name: Illusion Remix
apps.short_description: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.

apps.name: Imperial Grace
apps.short_description: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

apps.name: Imperial Kingdoms
apps.short_description: Lead a medieval kingdom in this 4X grand strategy game with pausable real-time. Establish vital infrastructure to supply your capital and sustain your armies. Design custom military templates, manage production estates, and conquer rival kingdoms via strategic sieges and raids.

apps.name: Imperionis
apps.short_description: Imperionis is a tactical RPG about a Roman commander and his century. Develop troops, camp and doctrines, then watch them perform in autobattles. Disable autobattle at any time to command the century and fight the commander’s personal encounters manually.

apps.name: In Full Bloom
apps.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

apps.name: In-Security
apps.short_description: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!

apps.name: Incremental Traffic
apps.short_description: An incremental logistics game where traffic becomes a challenge. Haul goods from fields, forests and quarries through a procedurally generated town, earn money with every delivery and buy more trucks, until your own fleet jams the streets. Then fix it with traffic rules.

apps.name: Inearth
apps.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

apps.name: InFlood
apps.short_description: Raise your sails and set forth across an endless ocean, vast and perilous, filled with submerged mysteries and unexpected adventures. Fight your way through danger, upgrade your ship, recruit a crew, explore the world, and decide which coalitions to support—and what will be built upon the ruins.

apps.name: Ink And Table
apps.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

apps.name: Inkblot: The Art Restorer
apps.short_description: A painterly puzzle about restoring masterpieces. A living ink blot has stolen the figures from 128 famous paintings and heaped their shadows on your workbench. Untangle the overlapping silhouettes, paint each one whole and send it home before the museum opens.

apps.name: INTERREGNUM
apps.short_description:
INTERREGNUM is a turn-based strategy game for the Commodore 64.
Command armies across three unique scenarios and fight for control, 
survival and victory with up to 4 local players or against the computer.

apps.name: INTERSCAPE
apps.short_description: A colossal black sphere has appeared on Earth, trapping humanity in endless dreams. Explore surreal dream worlds, uncover hidden secrets, and awaken those who sleep. In each distinct dream, awaken new abilities and experience unique worlds.

apps.name: Into the Fire
apps.short_description: Enter a volcanic cataclysm zone in this single-player extraction survival. Scavenge supplies, rescue survivors and animals, and expand your Camp with every successful run. Face deadly fire anomalies, changing terrain, and the constant risk of losing everything before you escape.

apps.name: Iona's Island
apps.short_description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders to help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape the world accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

apps.name: Isekai Guardians
apps.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

apps.name: Isentroth
apps.short_description: Swear an oath and walk into the Isenmarch — a cold Norse frontier that does not explain itself. A Machine Game Master narrates your saga, answers the choices you make, the engine rolls, and the model can't fudge a result. No two sagas are alike. What breaks first — your isen, or your troth?

apps.name: Island of Forbidden Desires
apps.short_description:
30 DAYS. FOUR WOMEN. ONE ISLAND.
Thirty days on a deserted island. Four women. A storm, ruins, and desires that cannot all be satisfied at once.
200+ illustrations and animated explicit scenes.

apps.name: Isles of Arcana
apps.short_description: You are a Guardian, sent to a world consumed by corruption. Explore increasingly dangerous biomes, gather resources, craft powerful tools, and uncover lost technology as you fight to save Arcana. Play solo or with up to four players.

apps.name: It Happened At Night - A New Nightmare
apps.short_description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

apps.name: It's About Pirates
apps.short_description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

apps.name: Jack & Snag
apps.short_description: Grapple into a new angle and turn robot fights in your favour. Jack & Snag is an arena FPS for 1–6 participants, with one- and two-handed weapons, colourful arenas and bots to practise against on your own.

apps.name: JackParts
apps.short_description: When the signal sounds, be the fastest! JackParts is an online party battle game for up to 4 players. Win gun parts with quick reflexes, assemble your weapon, and turn the tables with battle items. Even death isn’t the end—the Death Roulette can change your final score.

apps.name: JOHN GLEEP
apps.short_description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

apps.name: Join Us
apps.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

apps.name: Journey TD
apps.short_description: Classic tower defense meets roguelite: pick your elements, choose from 168 towers and merge them into stronger ones. Every tower is a wall: lure enemies onto the longest path, shape your build with power-up cards, gear and runes, and grow stronger with every run.

apps.name: Juggernaut
apps.short_description: Looks retro. Plays retro. Because it is retro.Jump back to the ’90s and blast those demons straight back to hell in this fast-paced, old-school FPS!And the carnage doesn’t stop there—load up maps created by other players and dive into even more action-packed adventures.

apps.name: Julio's Adventure 3
apps.short_description: In this first-person horror game, sanity changes everything and can turn nights into a living nightmare. Survive at Tamixa School whilst carrying out various tasks, keeping your cool and avoiding Julio and his friends.

apps.name: KEEP IT ON HER
apps.short_description: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

apps.name: Keep on Digging!
apps.short_description: Dig up chests, collect loot, and spend your gold on new skills and gear in Keep on Digging.

apps.name: Keepers of the Farkle
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, and challenge the CPU or Freinds in a fast-paced game of risk and strategy. Unlock colorful characters and custom dice, conquer tournaments, and compete with friends in local multiplayer without an internet connection! Will you bank your points? Or risk everything on one more roll?

apps.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
apps.short_description: Kena’s journey to cure her affliction leads to the island of Kosmora, plagued by its own mysterious corruption. To protect Kosmora, she must master the elements with the aid of spirit companions and dynamic combat in this action-packed yet heartfelt adventure.

apps.name: KEYSMASH
apps.short_description: KEYSMASH is a keyboard fidget toy: mash any key and watch it bloom into color, shape, and sound. Play through 24 hand-crafted worlds, from Bauhaus galleries to cherry blossoms to a crashing stock ticker, and earn 100 honest achievements. No skill, no fail. Just vibes

apps.name: Kibasen
apps.short_description: Welcome to KIBASEN, a traditional game of chicken fighting with elevated stakes.

apps.name: KickOff
apps.short_description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

apps.name: Kill All Clankers
apps.short_description: Kill All Clankers is a fast paced 2D Platformer Rogue-lite with Bullet Heaven and Twin Stick Shooter mechanics. You play as agents of the Prohuman Revolutionary Movement. ​​​Your objective is to survive multiple levels for 30 minutes and free humanity from a tyrannical AI surveillance state.

apps.name: Kill King
apps.short_description: Chess meets auto-battler. Plan your orders in secret, then watch both armies execute them at once. Predict where the enemy will step, strike that square first and land a God of War — an instant kill, even on the King. More possible matches than chess and Go combined.

apps.name: Killbot General
apps.short_description: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

apps.name: Killer in a Corn Maze
apps.short_description: Play the killer. Or try to escape one. A top-down pixel horror game set in a corn maze on Halloween night.

apps.name: Kingmakers
apps.short_description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

apps.name: KittenRush
apps.short_description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

apps.name: Kitty Wants Blood
apps.short_description: The average hooman body has around 5 liters of blood. That's not enough. Kitty wants more... much more. In this incremental game, help Kitty grow so big it can eat the planet! Hunt hoomans, suck their blood, unlock powerful mutations, complete challenges and before you ask, yes you can pet the cat.

apps.name: Knight's Party
apps.short_description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

apps.name: knock Time
apps.short_description: Knock Time is a beat 'em up originally for the Game Boy Advance in which you play as a boxer on a mission through the chaotic streets of Venezuela to rescue your journalist brother, who was kidnapped by a network of corrupt police officers following a protest.

apps.name: Knuckle Creek
apps.short_description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

apps.name: Konvoy-X
apps.short_description: Co-op for up to 4 players. Drive through a dark and mysterious island filled with mutations created by Mycel Corp, navigate using your vehicle’s analog controls, search for the lost complex, and recover the forgotten cargo to sell it and upgrade your gear.

apps.name: Korsaros Online
apps.short_description: Sail the Aegean Sea in a free-to-play 3D naval MMORPG inspired by Greek mythology. Explore an open Mediterranean world, build your ship, recruit a Captain and crew, battle pirates, fish, hunt treasure and trade with players. Brave PvP waters or sail together.

apps.name: Kyle Coral
apps.short_description: A serene, hand-made cave-diving adventure. Descend through a living ocean of five biomes, where your air is the only clock. Read the cave, find the air pockets, and surface before it runs out. Just you, the deep, and the next breath. Made by a dad and his two sons.

apps.name: Lands of Navia
apps.short_description: Lands of Navia is a unique take on the shoot ’em up genre set in the world of Slavic mythology. Each of the 4 gods offers different gameplay mechanics, and to fulfill your duty of protecting the realm of the dead, you’ll need to skillfully juggle the powers of the gods you control.

apps.name: Last Civilization: Inherited Flame
apps.short_description: Build a village around humanity's last flame. Gather, build, and research by day; defend against Shadows at night. When a village falls, pass its records and memories to the next civilization. Learn from each generation and survive the night that stopped the last.

apps.name: Last Ones Down
apps.short_description: A social survival game for up to 16 players. Reveal your traits, argue your case, and vote on who gets into the bunker. There’s only room for half of you, and keeping the wrong people could doom everyone inside.

apps.name: Last Tank Standing
apps.short_description: Last Tank Standing is a real-time tank tactics game. No base building, no resource gathering. You buy an army before the battle, you fight with what you bought, and the winner takes all.

apps.name: Late Amusement
apps.short_description: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

apps.name: Late Night Chats
apps.short_description: In this game you play through a series of late night conversations within a dysfunctional friend group, while the narrator awkwardly judges every decision you make. It’s intense, suffocating, and a little unhinged. "I need to go back, I need to change my choices." - My Mom

apps.name: Lazare's Sacrifice
apps.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

apps.name: Les Petites Rives
apps.short_description: Fish with friends on a peaceful little island, up to 16 players in online co-op. Cast from the dock or the boat, hold your catch up high, swim, dance, break out the ukulele… and watch out for the weird fish. Some of them wear sneakers.

apps.name: LiarGame : Canvas
apps.short_description:
Spot the liar in this online drawing party game for 3–8 players!
Draw clues if you know the secret word, or bluff with your drawings if you're the liar.
Decide who to trust amid suspicious sketches and convincing excuses.
Customize your character and enjoy hilarious mind games with friends!

apps.name: Liberators Inc.
apps.short_description: Governments are gone. The goddamn bugs are everywhere. And somebody has to get rid of them! Enter the Liberators: mercenary crews that survivors of the bugapolypse hire to exterminate the vile Swarm. Grab your weapons, get yourself a vehicle, team up with your friends, and get rich or die trying!

apps.name: Life Balance
apps.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

apps.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
apps.short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

apps.name: Life Warp
apps.short_description: Ascend to an alternate dimension known as The Warp and interact with its residents in mysteriously formed worlds.

apps.name: Liminaut
apps.short_description: Liminaut is a pixel-art post-apocalyptic survival game for solo play or co-op with up to four players. Explore a spore-ravaged open world, scavenge supplies and face danger. Build a base, recruit survivors and make a home among the ruins.

apps.name: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
apps.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

apps.name: Little Cheese Works
apps.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

apps.name: Little Colony
apps.short_description: The ant farm you had as a kid, alive at the edge of your screen. Paint a line and the ants dig it. Paint a room and they build it. Glance back later and they've been farming, foraging, and surviving the seasons. Every spring the Queens fly and the trees grows.

apps.name: Lo-Res Shaders: The Game
apps.short_description: A single player graphics-coding puzzle game for creative coders and coding creatives. Built for people who like their graphics coding low level and retro styled.

apps.name: Loamward
apps.short_description: Shape a living world one spadeful at a time. Dig, level and pave the land, fell timber, mine deep veins and smith your own tools, raise houses piece by piece and found a settlement with your neighbors. Every skill grows with use in a slow, open sandbox you share online.

apps.name: Loco: Rails & Tails
apps.short_description:
Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time.
Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

apps.name: Lost Host
apps.short_description:
Can a toy car become the hero of a video game?  
One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace.  
Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

apps.name: Lucky Dog Rise
apps.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

apps.name: Lucremachine
apps.short_description: An oddly satisfying incremental roguelike: flip coins to earn money, invest it all back into skills, upgrades, coins, and more as your fortune snowballs into the trillions! Hoard relics from encounters, get rich by midnight to get game-breaking boons, and whatever you do... do NOT anger Gregory.

apps.name: Luna Star Rancher
apps.short_description: Explore. Progress. Build. Take care of Luna, raise creatures, and bring your inventions to life! Earn XP, grow your ranch, build your rocket, take on bosses, and uncover the secrets of unknown worlds.

apps.name: Magic Academy
apps.short_description: Play as the Headmaster of a magic academy in this adult visual novel with card-based RPG adventures. Restore your ruined estate, recruit witches as teachers, and shape their fates. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle monsters, and unlock animated NSFW scenes.

apps.name: Magic Draw: Chaos
apps.short_description: Magic Draw Chaos is a chaotic and competitive 3D drawing and guessing party game to play with friends. Draw, race to be the first to guess the word, or score points by guiding others!

apps.name: Magical Ascent
apps.short_description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

apps.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
apps.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

apps.name: Magtiles
apps.short_description: Magtiles is a chill and relaxing puzzle game about moving tiles. There's no rush! Just play at your own pace, disable the move limit, skip levels, or come back later if you just want to relax. Listen to chill lo-fi and classical music and satisfying sounds. Simple is good.

apps.name: Makina
apps.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

apps.name: Malkin Tower
apps.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

apps.name: Mamka Said
apps.short_description: Dru returns for her childhood belongings. Mamka wants a thank-you. A child knows things Dru can't remember... and the room keeps making her smaller. A short psychological horror visual novel about gratitude, uncertain memory, and the right to leave.

apps.name: Manafest
apps.short_description: A free 1v1 collectible card game with a mean sense of humour. Build a 30-card deck from six kinds of mana, climb the ranked ladder, draft from sealed packs and fight in weekly tournaments.

apps.name: Manus Sors
apps.short_description: A mystical horror-puzzle game. A cozy grandmother's apartment hides dark family secrets. Explore rooms, solve riddles, and pay close attention - every detail matters!

apps.name: Market Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

apps.name: Marque & Reprisal
apps.short_description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

apps.name: MarsCity3026
apps.short_description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the atmosphere control fans back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

apps.name: Massive Frontier
apps.short_description: Command a growing fleet in a free-to-play, persistent real-time space MMO. Pick one of twelve rival human factions, build your starbase, mine rare resources, research alien tech and wage war across a seamless universe, while an ancient alien Tide gathers at the edge of the Frontier.

apps.name: Masyu: Line Logic
apps.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

apps.name: Math and Guns
apps.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down shooter where solving math problems is used to reload your guns. Play as a dubiously colored bounty hunter as you fight against generic monsters with fully automatic arithmetic, or just solve math problems and be boring, that's also an option.

apps.name: Maui the Shapeshifter
apps.short_description: Restore harmony as shapeshifting demigod Maui on an adventure to save his island home from all-consuming darkness in this epic 2D open-world Metroidvania.

apps.name: Maximum Thunderness
apps.short_description:
An extreme response to minor problems.

MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike side-scrolling co-op action game where you battle space alien criminals attempting to conquer Earth through a series of increasingly petty crimes.

apps.name: Mazestalker
apps.short_description: Discover a world of Escher-like isometric dungeon-labyrinths. Meet Yve Allard, a treasure hunter who finds that all corners of the world have already been visited by someone else. Where in the world can you discover new mysteries anymore?

apps.name: ME-OS
apps.short_description: A packed operating system simulation game that came from another world! Play through tons of preloaded games of various genres such as platform fighter, marble racer, first person shooter, rage platformer, level editor and have fun using the preloaded software too. Play alone or with friends!

apps.name: MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80
apps.short_description: MS80 is an action-engineering adventure in an abandoned star system. Trapped in a robot body, scavenge your way through the aftermath of a robot rebellion. Your body is a weapon — upgrade it with modular components you take off your enemies, and build yourself a new you!

apps.name: Medieval Frontiers
apps.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

apps.name: Meet Mary
apps.short_description: Experience a thrilling and comedic 1-4 player co-op horror story puzzle game. Learn how to move forward while delving deeper and deeper into the unknown. With a compelling story, Voiced cut scenes, and casual progression. This is the perfect way to spend some time with friends.

apps.name: Mega Million Fish
apps.short_description: Cast your line, kick back and watch the fish roll in! Mega Million Fish is a cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game. Fish across many areas, unbox rods with wild auras, enhance your favourite rod to +50 and trade with anglers on a live player market.

apps.name: Mega Mouse
