apps.short_description: The Shadow Cats have built data centers that are consuming massive amounts of energy from stars across the Milky Way, threatening all life in the galaxy. Take command of Mega Mouse, a half-cyborg soldier on a mission to hunt down and destroy every data center before it’s too late!

apps.name: Meowgic Egg Idle
apps.short_description: Click to hatch, merge, and idle battle on the ranch—raise a bunch of adorable Meowgic Eggs, watch them grow stronger, and challenge the Demon King.

apps.name: Merge Command
apps.short_description: Merge and launch rockets in 1v1 battles, earn resources, fund research, upgrade silos, program attacks, rank up!

apps.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
apps.short_description: [Merge Day: Office Girls] is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

apps.name: Methusalah Redemption
apps.short_description: An exploration platformer!

apps.name: Midgardr
apps.short_description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

apps.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim
apps.short_description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

apps.name: Might & Mushroom
apps.short_description: Draft your own shop in this deckbuilding roguelike auto battler! Summon fungal versions of legendary heroes, and take control of your fate with a unique shop building system and innovative synergy mechanics! Revolution is brewing, let's turn that evil dragon into mushroom soup!

apps.name: Miko Rhythm
apps.short_description: Miko Rhythm is a four-lane arrow rhythm game with a cute-goth heart. Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway or a classic flat lane, play 55 songs on four difficulties, dress up Miko in over 90 looks, chase the daily challenge, and make your own charts.

apps.name: Mimania
apps.short_description: A survival horror game where you have to find Mimics, who are disguised as different objects, with danger lurking around every corner.

apps.name: Mind Vessel
apps.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

apps.name: Miner Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

apps.name: Mini Legends Idle
apps.short_description: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!

apps.name: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
apps.short_description: Run a tiny PC shop through the 2024–26 AI boom. Pick the GPU, parts and model that fit each customer's budget. A light, cozy pixel-art shop sim.

apps.name: Minotaur Pathways
apps.short_description: Take control of the Minotaur as you explore and navigate different pathways throughout this dark fantasy adventure. Venture through dangerous areas and discover new environments. Overcome deadly obstacles and find your way through each level to reach the exit.

apps.name: Mist Seekers
apps.short_description: Venture into a forbidden zone shrouded in mist. Jump, wall-climb and dash, scavenge loot, and reach extraction before you fall. The fuller your pack, the more you stand to lose: push deeper, or extract now? Your haul makes the squad stronger, and rescued allies open paths you couldn't reach before.

apps.name: Moadra
apps.short_description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

apps.name: Mogilev: Apocalypse
apps.short_description: Survive in post-apocalyptic Mogilev. Begin inside Tadas’s club: manage hunger, thirst and sleep, buy vital supplies, complete missions and play Durak for in-game gold. Mogilev: Apocalypse is a single-player survival horror game in development.

apps.name: Money Burner
apps.short_description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

apps.name: Monked
apps.short_description: Monked is a third-person roguelike castle defense where you play a holy monk of the Castle of Bellwick. Battle through 16 waves of unique enemies and bosses, collect blessings between waves and fortify your city with barricades and allies. Unlock and collect over 100 blessings, items, and more.

apps.name: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
apps.short_description:
A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses.
DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

apps.name: Moon Basketball
apps.short_description: This is basketball.  On the moon.  Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

apps.name: Moonblood Mountain
apps.short_description: Survive a snowbound night in this first-person survival horror game. Explore a remote cabin and its frozen surroundings, use your flashlight to navigate the dark, and fight off attacking werewolves with an axe as you hold out until dawn.

apps.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
apps.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

apps.name: MoonTraum
apps.short_description: *MoonTraum* is a fishing game set in a mysterious dream world. Lost in a world where dreams take the form of fish, you meet Welt, a cat fisherman, and begin your fishing adventure. Catch uniquely designed fish and complete your collection!

apps.name: Mortuus
apps.short_description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

apps.name: MOST ARE MINE
apps.short_description: There are thousands of them. Most are mine. Lead a legion of thousands of undead as a necromancer, drown the kingdom's knights, archers and heroes in sheer numbers, and raise everyone who falls to fight for you.

apps.name: Motorsport Manager 2
apps.short_description: Motorsport Manager returns after a decade. Build your racing team, develop faster cars, and make the calls that beat your rivals in reactive racing. Your decisions shape a living world of personalities and rivalries. Build your racing legacy.

apps.name: Movimento
apps.short_description: Teo lives in a world where stopping is forbidden — whoever stops gets collected. Cross a city that never sleeps, face the twelve collectors in fights that turn into music, and learn that the hardest thing in this world is to stand still.

apps.name: Moving Oasis
apps.short_description: The world is drowning in living black goo, and all you have is a water tank. Blast the goo back, grow the land green, wake the fungal cities and link them with mycelium. Bring back the rain and wash the animals free before the goo takes them.

apps.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
apps.short_description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

apps.name: Musdart
apps.short_description: Young gnome, your mission will be to recover the crown of the champion of Musdart in this hand-carved wooden adventure. Avenge your father and reconnect with him by learning his language, the language of the ancient gnomes.

apps.name: Museum Keepers
apps.short_description: Museum Keepers blends museum management, roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense. Curate exhibits and welcome visitors by day. After dark, your collection awakens. Play tactical cards to defend the blue crystal. Spend your gold wisely: growth or survival?

apps.name: Mutual Occult Insurance
apps.short_description: Mutual Occult Insurance is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror and corporate satire. You investigate insurance claims for the only insurer that covers supernatural damage, and decide whether a haunting is real, or whether someone staged it for the payout, then survive whatever the answer is.

apps.name: My Basement is Hungry
apps.short_description: 'My Basement is Hungry' is a Psychological Horror game with survival horror elements. You must find your way through the strange basement of your home and discover what is actually happening down there, learning more about who your father is and what strange ties he may have had.

apps.name: My Fart Adventure
apps.short_description: My Fart Adventure — Cursed by a bad taco, you're now doomed to fart in public. The subtle art of cutting the cheese without getting busted: blend into the crowd, escape the DGREI Agents. Solo or up to 30 players online.

apps.name: my keyboard home!
apps.short_description: 1 key press = 1 game coin. Make typing boring emails, essays, and code feel rewarding ! Spend them on furniture and various items to decorate a cozy home—all hand drawn on real paper !

apps.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
apps.short_description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

apps.name: My Little Secret
apps.short_description: It seems your classmate Tia wasn't expecting company and has a secret she's keen on keeping! Collect evidence and confront Tia to reveal what she's been hiding.

apps.name: My Name Is Vincent Pogo
apps.short_description:
Play as Vincent, a famous pogo-sticking duck whose sent on an adventure towards the kingdom at the request of the king.
A physics-driven platformer where every jump counts as you bounce and balance your way through a hand-crafted world full of discovery.

apps.name: My Stylish Life
apps.short_description: It's 2008, and you just sat down at the family computer. Run your own boutique, build your dream wardrobe, make new friends, fall in love, and explore a colorful world where every day is yours to style. Welcome to My Stylish Life.

apps.name: Mysteries of Black Hollow
apps.short_description: The shop is yours by day. The dark belongs to something else. Raid the abandoned houses of a cursed town, drag your loot home before your lantern gives out, and spend everything you earn on rituals that might just save it or you.

apps.name: Nailcrown
apps.short_description: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

apps.name: nanos world™
apps.short_description: The next-generation open-world multiplayer sandbox. Play community-made game modes, create addons with Lua scripting, import custom assets from Unreal Engine 5, and host your own dedicated servers for hundreds of players!

apps.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
apps.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

apps.name: Necrolord
apps.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

apps.name: Nehrim: At Fate's Edge
apps.short_description: Nehrim: At Fate's Edge is an total conversion mod for TES IV: Oblivion. is Explore the eponymous land of Nehrim and its dense forests and deserts, delve into ancient crypts and labyrinthine caves, and experience an unconventional, gripping storyline that unfolds beyond good and evil.

apps.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
apps.short_description: Blast your way onto the leaderboards in a twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasion, kill combos and overwhelming firepower. Fight escalating fleets, merge power-ups and face 20+ unique bosses solo or in co-op. Play roguelike Anomaly runs that stack risk-reward mutations.

apps.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange
apps.short_description: NEONOVA Puzzle:Orange is an atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game that combines anime aesthetics and Halloween-inspired neon cyberpunk. Assemble futuristic images, connect the pieces, and unlock vibrant illustrations filled with neon lights, mysterious characters, and digital technologies that come to life

apps.name: Nerf Legends
apps.short_description: NERF Legends thrusts you into a futuristic, sci-fi world where you’ll come face-to-face with legions of robot enemies and ultimate boss masters.

apps.name: Neural Spaceship Sandbox
apps.short_description: Neural Spaceship Sandbox is a hybrid turn-based strategy and voxel sandbox with unlimited possibilities. Build custom spaceships, arm them to the teeth with advanced sci-fi weaponry, pilot them or hand the keys to our advanced AI, and then use them to conquer the galaxy / galaxies!

apps.name: Neuron Activation
apps.short_description: A digital fidget box of dopamine-fueled micro-challenges. Push buttons. Shoot targets. Chain actions for higher scores. Complete all tasks. Don’t ask questions.

apps.name: New Hope
apps.short_description: Post-apocalyptic colony survival where you give the orders and then hold the wall yourself. Build a fortified base, send squads on risky expeditions for supplies, and fight beside your settlers in third person when zombies and mutants come for the gates.

apps.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
apps.short_description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

apps.name: Night Concierge
apps.short_description: You are the night concierge of a Soviet apartment block. Check faces against the resident log, watch the security cameras and decide who gets in. Some visitors are "others" who know your neighbors' names. A PS1-style first-person horror game with multiple endings and Twitch chat voting.

apps.name: Night Run EX
apps.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

apps.name: Night Stocker
apps.short_description:
Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits.
The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

apps.name: Night Viewing
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a late-night apartment. Switch between nine strange TV channels, inspect the room, and piece together clues hidden in broadcasts, sounds and notes. Your choices shape the final viewing.

apps.name: Nightveld
apps.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

apps.name: NO CLEAN START
apps.short_description: No Clean Start is a first-person survival horror roguelite set in a hostile underground facility. Explore dangerous sectors, scavenge for weapons and supplies, manage limited resources, and fight or avoid deadly enemies. Complete objectives, adapt your strategy, and survive each expedition.

apps.name: No Good Friends
apps.short_description: “It's a Blade.” Is it? Pass a face-down card across the felt, name it and look your friends in the eye. Every card ends in a verdict for someone. Collect the wrong ones and the table executes you: poison, a knife or the rope. No good friends here. 2–6 players, voice chat.

apps.name: No One Runs Alone
apps.short_description: No One Runs Alone is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where you and your team are bound together by the Soulbinder. Outsmart the Hunter, grab powerful perks, adapt to wild game modes, and make every escape a hilarious fight for survival.

apps.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
apps.short_description: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.

apps.name: NO SUNRISE
apps.short_description: Survive the night in NO SUNRISE, a 2.5D zombie survival shooter for solo play and co-op with up to 8 players. Barricade windows, open new routes, upgrade your weapons and rescue your team as each wave turns up the pressure.

apps.name: Noor
apps.short_description: Explore an Arabian fantasy world as Siraj, wielding a magical lantern to restore lost memories, uncover hidden paths, and awaken new powers. Master fast isometric combat, face powerful bosses, and push back the darkness.

apps.name: North Pole Defense
apps.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

apps.name: NTR Tales - The Elf Next Stream
apps.short_description: An adult RPG about love, streaming, and corruption. Help your elven girlfriend rebuild her lost memories, grow her audience, and repay your debt, one stream at a time.

apps.name: NyanGO
apps.short_description: A 4×4 "push-style Go" played with adorable cat pieces. Place, move, and push—surround your opponent's cats to win. Pushed cats get stunned, and a cat stunned 3 times shatters! Easy to learn, deep to master. Play online or challenge the CPU.

apps.name: Of Dice and Minions
apps.short_description: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.

apps.name: Oink Splash Party
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

apps.name: Old School Baseball
apps.short_description: Baseball like it's 1985. Fast arcade play where the field decides the hit: the scoring zones shuffle every half-inning. Time your swing, paint the corners, and play a 42-game season all the way to the playoffs.

apps.name: Ominous Descent
apps.short_description: Ominous Descent is a fast-paced 2D twin-stick shooter set in an alien deep-sea trench. Piercing the abyss with your headlights, pilot your submarine and blast through the inky depths as everything from small predatory fish to colossal abominations hunt you at every turn.

apps.name: One Dumb Wizard
apps.short_description: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Craft new wands, find powerful charms, and strategically cast spells in your singular mission to GET YOUR MONEY BACK.

apps.name: One Good Turn
apps.short_description: Cozy meets Card Game in One Good Turn. Summon Allies, cast your spells, and combo together Aura cards to help build and protect your town! Craft a deck and go exploring to gather resources and presents for the lovely townsfolk! Make friends, open packs, and create unique decks in One Good Turn!

apps.name: One More Lawn
apps.short_description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

apps.name: One More Rule
apps.short_description: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

apps.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
apps.short_description:
Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE!
 
Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

apps.name: One Second Hero
apps.short_description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

apps.name: One Tank Trip
apps.short_description: Team up as three soldiers forgotten in the evacuation on their journey home by tank!

apps.name: Onions are Life
apps.short_description: The greatest onion game you'll ever play! Plant onions, grow onions, harvest onions, love onions, become onions, in this incremental onion-farming sim!

apps.name: Online: 404
apps.short_description: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

apps.name: Onlympic Up!
apps.short_description:
A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes:
“Your fates are now bound.”
Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable.
Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm.
Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

apps.name: Orbit Core
apps.short_description: Roguelite bullet heaven with mechs: mow down countless robots until you're unstoppable. Absorb their energy, level up, stack modules, unlock items, and combine them into game-breaking builds. And all with an entire planet as your battlefield!

apps.name: Orbital Madness
apps.short_description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

apps.name: Orbz Collector
apps.short_description: Orbz Collector is a 3D re-imagining of the 90s classic Chip's Challenge. Collect coloured keys to unlock the corresponding locks, avoid patrolling enemies and warp around to figure out the variety of puzzles throughout the 12 levels. Some of the levels you'll recognize and some of them are new!

apps.name: Orcthal
apps.short_description: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

apps.name: Ore Legacy
apps.short_description: A retro CRT-style incremental mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

apps.name: Origins Trading Card Game
apps.short_description: Outplay rivals in a fast PvP card game where both players move at once. Adapt your strategy and battle for three of 100+ rotating locations. Build decks with reimagined legends like Robin Hood and Mulan. Every competitive card is free. Rip packs for rare, limited-edition variants to trade on Steam.

apps.name: Ostfriesland Games
apps.short_description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

apps.name: Ostinato
apps.short_description: The musical roguelike deckbuilder. Duel rival casters note against note, silence their melody with your own, and build outrageous combos that swell your score into the millions.

apps.name: Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade
apps.short_description: A crimson moon rises over a spring festival and a hundred yokai pour into town. Lead six exorcists through the Night Parade, build your style from 13 Japanese weapons and 60 charms, defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox and the Great Tengu, and help the thousand-year sakura bloom again.

apps.name: Out of the Shadows
apps.short_description: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.

apps.name: Pack a Plush!
apps.short_description: Pack a Plush! is a cozy collection game where you buy batches of adorable plushies, organize them into displays, and build valuable collections. Discover legendary plushies, fulfill requests, and create a collection that's uniquely yours.

apps.name: PACTFORGE
apps.short_description: Your Phoenix dies – and rises again. Assemble 17 units in three factions, merge them up to tier 5 and let them fight on their own. New: duels against friends. Bosses, artifacts and six worlds.

apps.name: Padel Manager 27
apps.short_description: Build your padel academy, recruit and train players, and take your pairs to the top. Manage from the bench or play every point. Compete online, team up in co-op, or share the court in local multiplayer.

apps.name: Pale Incense
apps.short_description: Pale Incense is a gothic action-simulation where you run a perfume shop by day and hunt as a vampire by night. Harvest scents and human essence from your victims, evade hunters, and craft the healing incense that may save Johanna the wife your failed transformation left dying.

apps.name: Paleokin
apps.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

apps.name: PalmiVelle
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own tropical getaway in PalmiVelle, an isometric hotel management game. Create hotels, pools and beach facilities, manage staff and prices, and meet your guests’ needs as you grow your seaside resort.

apps.name: Palworld: Palfarm
apps.short_description: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!

apps.name: PARLEY
apps.short_description: A 20-minute medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Kale, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. The last Kale standing wins.

apps.name: Password Not Valid
apps.short_description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

apps.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
apps.short_description: A single-player MMORPG fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, Build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.

apps.name: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults
apps.short_description: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults is the first-ever co-op Hack and Slash ARPG based on the Adventure Path, in which players lead iconic Pathfinder heroes into the depths of Gauntlight Keep and battle deadly abominations to reach the evil sorceress Belcorra Haruvex and end her vile schemes.

apps.name: Patternima
apps.short_description: This is a fantastical puzzle game where you manipulate a kaleidoscope system to transform abstract patterns into living creatures. With simple controls—just sliders and dragging—you can enjoy the wondrous and beautiful moment when the completed creature comes to life.

apps.name: Pawn Shop Together
apps.short_description: Uncle Sal left you the keys to his pawn shop on Avenue A. Haggle with sellers, spot the fakes, hand out pawn loans and flip the deals of the week. Run the counter solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Penguin Kart Racer
apps.short_description: Sixteen tracks at the bottom of the world, six penguins, and one orca who wants the ice back. A late-'90s style low-poly kart racer: drift, boost, and race four bosses across Adventure, Cup, Time Trial and Battle modes, solo or in 4-player split-screen.

apps.name: Penis Dungeon
apps.short_description: Penis Dungeon is a roguelike action RPG with procedurally generated dungeons, bizarre enemies, and a branching skill tree. Play solo or in co-op, unlock new weapons and upgrades, and lead your unfortunate hero on a desperate escape from the depths.

apps.name: Per My Last Email
apps.short_description: A 16-bit beat 'em up about the day one employee finally snaps. Brawl through every department of a dysfunctional corporation, one coworker at a time, until you reach the CEO.

apps.name: Perfumed Palaces
apps.short_description: Engage this analog horror slot machine to explore the forbidden maze complex, find a way out, hone your PSY abilities, and make contact with inorganic beings.

apps.name: Persona 4 Revival
apps.short_description:
Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure 
Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

apps.name: Persona 6
apps.short_description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

apps.name: Phantom Blade Zero
apps.short_description: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

apps.name: Phone Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

apps.name: Phuket Paradise
apps.short_description: Welcome to Phuket Paradise!

apps.name: Pierce Through Heavens
apps.short_description: Pierce Through Heavens is an open-world multiplayer RPG inspired by Chinese mythology and xianxia literature. Gather rare resources, craft potent elixirs, and cultivate ancient martial arts to survive the continent’s many dangers and rise as an immortal.

apps.name: Pingo
apps.short_description: Pingo is an AI desktop pet that chats, roasts, remembers, and helps with tasks. Connect local models, official cloud; customize personality, voice, and look; let it observe your screen, keep memory and diary notes, use Skills, knowledge bases, and MCP, and play games with you.

apps.name: Pit & Pat
apps.short_description: Pit & Pat is a chaotic online aerial football game where you cast spells, steal goalposts, and occasionally score a goal. Win matches in ways that would put real footballers to shame.

apps.name: Pit Wizard
apps.short_description:
Pit Wizard is a short action rpg with incremental progression where you play as a wizard custodian. Jump into magical pits, clean out hordes of dangerous monsters, and mine valuable resources while developing two massive skill trees.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not a survivors game.

apps.name: PixelPup Town
apps.short_description: A pixel-art desktop pet game with a little canine companion. Spend time with your pup while you work or unwind, train skills, and choose food, toys and furniture to make a cozy corner of your desktop your own.

apps.name: Plunder & Booty
apps.short_description: Sixteen pirate queens, sirens, ghost captains and navy officers, and every one of them wants to bet against you. Beat them at cards on the high seas, sign them to your crew, then pour the rum in your cabin to unlock 96 animated scenes. One purchase. No microtransactions.

apps.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
apps.short_description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

apps.name: Polandball: The Sixth Day - Destroy
apps.short_description: Endless waves of infected are closing in! A single-player, top-down endless survival shooter starring countryballs. Survive through your own choices and builds, create a character of your own, and fight through a living day-night cycle as the world gradually falls apart.

apps.name: Pongcremental
apps.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

apps.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
apps.short_description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

apps.name: Potion Approaching
apps.short_description: A haunted manor item-crafting game where players combine three everyday objects to brew custom potions for visitors. Earned payments are used to pay off the residing ghosts before things get out of hand.

apps.name: Potions, Please!
apps.short_description: An alchemy shop sim with a hint of RPG, a dash of naughty llamas and a generous helping of morbid humour thanks to your late Aunty, who is patiently awaiting her resurrection from six feet under.

apps.name: Powder Park
apps.short_description: Shape the mountain. Build the lifts and jumps. Then ride it yourself, solo or with friends. A cozy ski resort builder from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

apps.name: PRE-ECHO
apps.short_description: A co-op horror mystery. August 1994: in the small town of Greyford, an old radio picks up events before they happen. Explore by day, survive the Resonance Storm by night and change what is coming, alone or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Prison Legacy
apps.short_description: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

apps.name: Prisonado
apps.short_description: Kick rocks through the Yard in Prisonado. Aim and score pucks to draft your fight moves, then watch the prison brawls unfold in this turn-based roguelike deck slider. Land trick shots, trigger nasty combos, hustle contraband and discover busted synergies on your way to the Warden... and Freedom.

apps.name: Procession Engine
apps.short_description: Not another turn-based deckbuilder. A real-time tug of war where you command a whole army: your buildings spawn it, your cards shape it, and two lanes decide whose stronghold falls first.

apps.name: Program Penguin
apps.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

apps.name: Project Creatures
apps.short_description: Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends in a vast Open World!

apps.name: Project Exhibitionist
apps.short_description: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

apps.name: Project Lightbringer
apps.short_description: Project Lightbringer is an exploration-focused bullet heaven where light is your only safe ground. Fight endless hordes, collect powerful upgrades, activate lanterns to expand your territory, and venture deeper into the mist to hunt massive creatures.

apps.name: Project Seaborne
apps.short_description: Command a ship in the age of sail across a fully circumnavigable globe. Read the wind, trade for a reason, fight broadside to broadside, board and take prizes, and build a name — alone or in Steam co-op. Simulated sea, living crew, seventeen period hulls, a family to leave it all to.

apps.name: Project: G-216
apps.short_description: In "Project: G-216, you are responsible for monitoring various cursed locations around the world. You will monitor surveillance camera feeds and have to react quickly to any anomalies. Don't let too many come together - it could cost your life.

apps.name: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
apps.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

apps.name: Pulse Drive
apps.short_description:
Tap to the beat to build speed!

Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

apps.name: Punch Upon a Time
apps.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

apps.name: Punch Your Way Out
apps.short_description: You wake up in a tiny room. Every wall, floor and ceiling is solid cubes. Punch your way out. Smash blocks, vacuum the rubble, sell it for upgrades, find tools buried in the rock and grow some serious arms. Solo or with up to 3 friends, the daylight is out there somewhere.

apps.name: Puppetry
apps.short_description: Puppetry is a 3D puzzle-mystery adventure where you play as a haunted voodoo doll trapped inside a mysterious mansion.

apps.name: Purr Box
apps.short_description: A little box, lots of kittens and plenty of love! Adopt cats, collect purrs, unlock upgrades and gather memories in this pixel art incremental game. Enjoy minigames and let your kittens keep you company on your desktop while you study or work.

apps.name: Purrrfect Immortal
apps.short_description: Purrrfect Immortal is a story-rich idle adventure where Cat Heroes train, make friends, and embark on an epic quest to rescue magical kittens stolen by dragons.

apps.name: puzzlez - a shapez game
apps.short_description: puzzlez - a shapez game is an easy to learn, hard to master puzzle game about building shapes in compact 3D spaces. Solve handcrafted puzzles with multiple solutions, from simple production chains to complex logistical problems. Design, share, and play custom puzzles with an ever-growing community.

apps.name: QDFracture
apps.short_description: Fast-paced competitive FPS focused on precision, movement, and high-impact combat. Dominate intense online PvP battles or team up in cooperative modes against adaptive AI. Pure skill. Zero gimmicks.

apps.name: QuadMerge
apps.short_description: Think from all four sides. Quad-Merge is a dynamic puzzle game where you launch numbered blocks from the edges of the grid to combine them, build massive combos, and clear the board. Strategize your angles, unlock powerful boosters, and survive an ever-escalating challenge!

apps.name: Queen's Domain
apps.short_description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

apps.name: Querni
apps.short_description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum
apps.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

apps.name: Race on Stream!
apps.short_description: Little cars. Big grudges. Race solo, with Steam friends, or turn Twitch chat into your rivals. Upgrade your car, build your own tracks, throw a chair into the race, or leave it all behind for a long drive and some music.

apps.name: RADZIMA
apps.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

apps.name: Rahasya: The Curse of Ooty
apps.short_description: You drove her from the city to Ooty. Something followed her into the car. Now she is possessed, and an aghori in the hills will only help if you bring him what he asks for. First-person Indian folk horror.

apps.name: RAILRIDERS
apps.short_description: RAILRIDERS is a fast-paced 1-4 player co-op shooter where you ride a moving train into a dieselpunk frontier overrun by hordes of cryptids. Jump off to complete dangerous contracts, survive relentless enemies, and fight your way back aboard with your crew.

apps.name: Railwright
apps.short_description: Design and build your own rail vehicles, lay the tracks they run on, drive your creations, haul cargo, and develop new technology in an open-ended railway engineering sandbox.

apps.name: RAIN HEART
apps.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

apps.name: Ram & Repair
apps.short_description: Smash rival cars to scrap in top-down demolition derby arenas. Survive wave after wave, hammer, weld and bolt your wreck back together by hand, grab rare upgrades, beat each arena's final boss - and face your own champion car as the next one.

apps.name: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
apps.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

apps.name: RAYBREAKER
apps.short_description: A neon twin-stick shooter with the loot heart of an action RPG. Burn down a glowing fuse in 5 to 8 minute runs, read the swarm, break its bosses and bring home gear that rewrites your build. Six bands of a shattered spectrum, solo or in co-op for two, side by side or online.

apps.name: Razor Squadron
apps.short_description: Razor Squadron is a vertical arcade shoot 'em up set inside a colossal fleet war. Shift power between machine guns, lasers, and missiles, rescue wingmen in battle, switch formations on the fly, and push through the MAW's invasion.

apps.name: RCSIM
apps.short_description: RCSIM bridges professional Sim-Racing rigs with real physical RC cars. Drive real-world vehicles in first-person view (FPV) with immersive Force Feedback, live telemetry, and multi-tier hardware support (Audio PPM, USB RP2350, or Direct ExpressLRS).

apps.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
apps.short_description: A 3D action-puzzle game where your corpses become platforms, weights and shields. Leave a body with every death and find a way through BOX, a vast structure filled with deadly traps. Where you die matters. Starring Kuruma Takahira of Reiwa Roman in his first lead role in a game.

apps.name: Real Life Simulator
apps.short_description: Rise to the top of trade with your friends! Buy and sell second-hand goods, establish a car dealership, manage the real estate market, and own the biggest businesses in the city. Real Life Simulator combines all trading simulations in a 2D Co-op world.

apps.name: Realistic Battle Simulator
apps.short_description: Two knights or twenty thousand a side: pick who fights and watch it play out. Every soldier fights by his own armour, reach, speed and nerve, and an army breaks when its courage does. March the Warpath, paint battles in the sandbox, and forge your own units and fields.

apps.name: Realm Protectors
apps.short_description: Hold the line against hundreds of monsters in a bright, top-down survival roguelite. Pick one of four heroes, time your abilities, and grow a build that turns a desperate fight into a screen-clearing storm. Four realms, a boss at the end of every round, and always one more run.

apps.name: Reaper GP
apps.short_description: Fast paced anti gravity combat racing. Choose a frame, select a loadout and race to the death.  Earn new gear from sponsors to enhance your frames.

apps.name: Recovery Syndicate
apps.short_description:
Recovery Syndicate is a prequel to Abeyance, in which you are the leader of one of the factions trying to reconstruct the economy of the galaxy.
You must build and manage your colony's resources carefully, while watching out for rival factions who are also vying for supremacy.

apps.name: Reel Risk
apps.short_description: It's your typical fishing game with a slight catch. Sail out, maintain your boat, and reel in whatever bites. The longer you are out there, the worse it gets. Go as long as you dare. Just make sure to come back alive.

apps.name: REFLECT89
apps.short_description: REFLECT89 is a skill-based arcade shoot 'em up where enemy fire becomes your weapon. Rotate your reflector, master Perfect Reflections, fire the Power Cannon and survive 10 stages of intense projectile patterns, unique bosses and high-score challenges.

apps.name: Refracted
apps.short_description: Refracted: a 4-player co-op shooter where you build turrets and lead troops. Wield powers granted to you by a mysterious crystal against the clanker horde. Empower your hero, upgrade your army & defenses, and push through enemy lines to destroy the clanker base. Die. Refract. Push again.

apps.name: Reign of Victory
apps.short_description: Build and trade, fight and conquer or raid and steal in this multiplayer open-world RPG where you can choose your own adventure by taking part as a villager, knight or outlaw!

apps.name: relay
apps.short_description: A modern-day hacking sim. Take bug bounties, sweet talk a help desk, lift credentials, cash out crypto, upgrade your rig, and more. NPCs respond to you in a realistic manner, and remember what you've done.

apps.name: Remnants of R'lyeh
apps.short_description: Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's Great Work. An ancient dark power is calling you and you need to find an exit. Face your greatest fear, fight, hide... you must escape before the underwater city rises...

apps.name: Rent A Car Together
apps.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

apps.name: Reply All
apps.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

apps.name: Request Stop
apps.short_description: A slow-burning commute horror. Something is slipping, a little each day. Wake up, eat, catch the bus. Work your job, then work on your life. Maybe you'll get it right tomorrow. Or another day.

apps.name: Requiem of Cards
apps.short_description: A tactical card battler where creatures move like chess pieces across a 7×7 battlefield. Build your deck, fuse cards into greater monsters and discover all Archtypes. Duel online in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all.

apps.name: Rerouted
apps.short_description: Stranded deep in the North, you have just one goal: make it home alive. Solo or with friends, fight the cold, hunt for food, set up camps, watch out for wildlife, and... try not to lose anyone along the way.

apps.name: RETROPULSE Halloween
apps.short_description: RETROPULSE Halloween is an atmospheric neon puzzle game in a Halloween RETROWAVE style, where vibrant lines, retro anime, spooky neon nights, and '80s aesthetics merge into one digital world. Connect matching colored dots, create neon waves, and unlock colorful Halloween-inspired illustrations.

apps.name: Revola: Post Hyper
apps.short_description: The Finno-Korean Hyperwar is over. But you are still fighting to survive in the ruins of reality it tore apart, make money, buy weapons, and deal with the consequences of a war that, in some timelines, was only an internet meme.

apps.name: Riddledale
apps.short_description: Riddledale is a new open-world adventure centered on story and characters. Solve riddles, meet memorable characters, and fight ferocious creatures across a vast island full of secrets.

apps.name: Rise of the Merchants
apps.short_description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

apps.name: Rising Together: Nayyar & Riab
apps.short_description:
Rising Together is a fantasy 2D action adventure coop game. With a friend pass. 

It is an emotional story-rich, includes traversal challenges, puzzles and bosses. 

With power systems for individual heroes and combined for both heroes.

apps.name: Riskline
apps.short_description: Riskline is a multiplayer game about risk, greed, and outplaying your rivals. Spin slots, bet on roulette, challenge other players to duels, grab limited items, and decide when to cash out. Whoever hides the most money in the bank by the end of the match wins.

apps.name: Road Riot
apps.short_description: Vehicular combat survivor game, set in the 80's. Dodge swarming enemies, evolve absurd weapons and smash huge bosses. Collect scrap, upgrade your garage and unlock new cars. Get wrecked. Come back louder.

apps.name: Road To School
apps.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

apps.name: ROB RUN
apps.short_description: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

apps.name: Rock Hoppers
apps.short_description: A light-hearted but deep first person exploration and survival game for you and your friends set in a procedurally-generated asteroid belt on the edge of known space. Explore the world, learn new skills, build and defend your base, and conquer the belt's unique threats.

apps.name: Rocks to Riches
apps.short_description: Start with a pickaxe and a plot. Dig ore, haul it to the trucks and pour the money into a bigger operation, then sell the whole thing and start again richer (or don't)! A cozy mining tycoon that takes you from a backyard mine to a lost jungle city and out to the asteroid belt.

apps.name: ROMUL
apps.short_description: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

apps.name: Room on Earth
apps.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

apps.name: Rubber Messiah: 18+ Lust Bunker Simulator
apps.short_description: Clock in for a logistical nightmare. Deliver cargo to an underground cult obsessed with 18+ absurdity. Dodge industrial sex hazards, find the Supreme Mother Womb, and get your invoice signed. Maintain your deadpan sanity. Just get the signature and leave!

apps.name: Ruby's Trick or Treat
apps.short_description: Freeze when the music stops, solve her puzzles, and escape the house before she gets to you. A short, fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game where every second counts.

apps.name: RYFT STRIKE: BRIGHTER TOMORROW
apps.short_description: Fly solo or team up in a story-driven bullet-hell shooter where war is prime-time entertainment. Dodge spell-card bosses, upgrade your fighter jet, and risk a life to rescue your partner—with online and couch co-op and four difficulty levels.

apps.name: S.S.K - project
apps.short_description:
Boomer shooter in the setting of a secret complex in Eastern Europe — Take on the role of an ordinary worker in extraordinary circumstances.

Shooting, puzzles, dark dungeons, retro graphics and more...

apps.name: Sad Damn
apps.short_description: Sad Damn is hiding. Use your fortress to blast your way to him. Tear through his generals' defenses, get better weapons, and try not to get blown up first.

apps.name: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
apps.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that lives on your desktop. Dig with a toy shovel, pour sand and water, plant trees and build little houses, then watch crabs, fish and birds go about their day in stop-motion clay. No goals, no failing. Just a small world to poke at.

apps.name: Sails
apps.short_description: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

apps.name: Salticidae Story
apps.short_description: Keep, feed and breed jumping spiders. A 120-trait genome inherits the way genes actually do -- dominant, recessive, carriers -- and six species cross into hybrids, so a line you breed for is a line you can keep. Level up, play the arcade, and let your favourite live on your desktop.

apps.name: Samhan: Where Korea Began
apps.short_description: Silla's thousand-year reign is crumbling, and Gyeon Hwon, Gung Ye and Wang Geon rise to claim the peninsula. Command 500+ historical figures across a 3D Korea in this turn-based grand strategy of statecraft, diplomacy and war—and reunite the Three Han.

apps.name: Sanitarium Enhanced
apps.short_description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium™ returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

apps.name: Sayaka: My Naughty Milf Neighbor
apps.short_description: Move in, settle down, and let Sayaka, your hot MILF neighbor, spoil you like never before! She’s warm, she’s caring, and she’s ready to make you feel very welcome. Will you resist her charms, or let her teach you a few thing about sex?

apps.name: Scared by Squares
apps.short_description: Scared by Squares is an experiment in horror. Can you create fear without ghosts, zombies, creepy dolls, or the usual tropes? What if all you had was the least scary thing in the world: a simple cube? The result might surprise you.

apps.name: Scary Hot Dogs
apps.short_description: Scary Hot Dogs is a horror game where you run a small hot dog stand, prepare orders, and serve creepy customers. Complete tasks, earn money, and survive terrifying night shifts filled with strange encounters, unexpected scares, and mysterious events. Not every customer is here for a hot dog...

apps.name: School Grounds Survival
apps.short_description: The school has mutated – and you are the janitor. Fight hordes of mutated students and unhinged teachers with a mop, a stapler and a Bunsen burner. 69 weapons, 20 evolutions, subject sets and 9 bullet-hell bosses: an arena roguelite for one more run.

apps.name: ScopeCreep
apps.short_description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

apps.name: Scramble Knights Online
apps.short_description: Adventure with friends in this MMO-lite action RPG! Explore the shared online kingdom of Terracott as a knight-in-training. Team up to conquer dungeons, slay monsters, discover rare loot, and return home to forge powerful new gear before setting out on your next quest.

apps.name: Scraplings
apps.short_description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

apps.name: Scrapmiles
apps.short_description: Explore an autumn valley in an old pickup. Collect and haul scrap, take jobs and secure your cargo. Spend your earnings on repairs, restoration and truck upgrades in an open-world driving and salvage simulator with changing weather and a day-and-night cycle.

apps.name: SCREW IT!
apps.short_description: SCREW IT! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a chaotic retro TV show. Outbid your friends, call their bluffs, prove your claims on the mic, survive ridiculous penalties, and compete in arcade challenges to become the night's champion.

apps.name: Seeking The Cure
apps.short_description: Fight the infected and explore a devastated world in this 2D pixel art action-adventure. As John Austin, rescue scientists, recover supplies, and battle your way through streets, factories, and laboratories in the search for a cure.

apps.name: Seleka-san who Exposes unnoticed with Naked Coat
apps.short_description:
Experience humanity’s greatest dilemma: “I want to expose more!” vs. “The more daring the exposure, the easier it is to get caught!”
Watch where people are and where they’re looking, push things right to the limit, and complete exposure missions in this fresh 3D stealth exhibitionism action game.

apps.name: Server Owner Tycoon
apps.short_description: Server Owner Tycoon has you step into the shoes of a game server owner to build your own online empire. Manage your staff members, catch the latest trends, keep users satisfied, research new features, and administer your server. Do you have what it takes to become the best server owner?

apps.name: Servo The Wildguard
apps.short_description: A Lock On Shooter Roguelike. Defeat Enemies, collect loot, upgrade your woodland village and make new friends!

apps.name: Sex Office 2
apps.short_description: Balance your office work routine with the allure of money and romance. Complete your tasks on time, go out and win over major investors, or risk it all at the casino. Meet three unique female colleagues, deepen your relationships with them, and unlock nine exclusive intimate scenes.

apps.name: Sexy Santa Girls 2
apps.short_description: Sexy Santa Girls 2 is a festive find-the-differences game with beautiful girls and cozy Christmas vibes. Carefully compare two similar images and spot hidden details in outfits, poses, decorations, and backgrounds at a relaxed, enjoyable pace.

apps.name: Shadows in Sanluca
apps.short_description: A Supernatural mystery in the beating heart of a Latin American city. Scour the past memories of an abandoned house, build out a web of connections between its inhabitants, and learn of the sinister truth that led to their downfall.

apps.name: SHAME
apps.short_description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

apps.name: Shattersight
apps.short_description: Shattersight is a fast-paced arcade FPS where every kill earns you cash. Spend it on new guns, attachments and killstreaks, then jump straight back into Team Deathmatch or Capture the Flag. Quick matches, nonstop action, and bots fill in when players are short.

apps.name: Shatterwing
apps.short_description: Turn enemy fire into your greatest weapon. SHATTERWING is a pixel-art bullet hell shooter where you dash to create mirrors, reflect deadly volleys, and build your ship across five stages. Master six ships or switch colors and absorb bullets in Polarity mode.

apps.name: Sheepdog Simulator
apps.short_description: Learn to herd sheep the way real shepherds do: with a whistle and a faithful sheepdog. Send your dog wide around the flock, then ease them down the lane and through the gate. Push too hard and fear spreads until they bolt; hang back and they wander off to graze. Bring every last one home.

apps.name: Shivaliva
apps.short_description: Go on a space adventure, build relationships, and play mini-games along the way. A sky-pirate puzzle adventure where every job, card table, ship's station and fight is its own minigame, and the islanders remember you, gossip about you, and might fall for you.

apps.name: Shroom & Blade
apps.short_description: Two players. One mushroom colony. One explores, fights ants, and hunts scouts before they summon stronger waves. The other builds, automates, and fortifies the colony. Survive escalating attacks together until the Ant Queen arrives in this asymmetric co-op base-defense game.

apps.name: SHUNYA
apps.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

apps.name: Siegehand
apps.short_description: Attack or build? In Siegehand, every minion has a job to do. Lead one of four factions in a free-to-play online & offline collectible card game with two paths to victory. Battle rival players in Ranked mode, build massive war chests, shape an asynchronous Arena run, and grow your collection!

apps.name: Sigils of Nightfall
apps.short_description: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive the horrors that will unleash the world's end.

apps.name: Silent Crew
apps.short_description: You start your own urban exploration vlog called "Silent Crew". Search abandoned buildings, record footage, collect clues, and uncover the dark history hidden within the ruins of forgotten worlds.

apps.name: Silly Souls
apps.short_description: Silly Souls is an online hide-and-seek party game for 2–8 players. Hide your soul, throw props, and taunt a friend playing the Grim Reaper to steal time—or grab the scythe and hunt your friends. Expect close calls, silly escapes, and proximity voice chat.

apps.name: Simple Wars
apps.short_description: Hex wargame. Capture cities, train units, and fight across the map. Skirmish, campaign, missions, and multiplayer.

apps.name: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
apps.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

apps.name: Skifa
apps.short_description: A dice farklelike played at a medieval table. Shake the cup, throw, keep what scores, and decide: bank it, or throw again and risk losing everything. Real dice, real cups, rooms with their own rules, and opponents who play the way they live.

apps.name: Skroyder Rumble
apps.short_description: Survive the waves. Beat the bosses. Bring home the loot. A fast 2.5D action roguelite brawler about surviving chaotic enemy waves, building your character, and fighting huge cartoon bosses.

apps.name: Skull Siege
apps.short_description: 1 knight, 30,000 skeletons. Build a tiny kingdom by day: drop gold coins into houses, towers and traps. By night a river of bones pours through the gap. Ride into it with your lance, charge through hundreds at once and hold the keep until the sun burns the rest to dust.

apps.name: Skyward Masters
apps.short_description: SKYWARD MASTERS is an ARENA FPS with Bedwars-style strategy, where 16 players split across 4 teams fight on floating islands. Set across changing biomes you outlast your opponents to be the last team standing in a format where chaos reigns and teamwork rules.

apps.name: SLABBED: Card Grader
apps.short_description: A first-person card grading game with a story shaped by your choices. Tilt trading cards under the light, inspect their condition, and seal them in plastic. Stay honest, bend the rules, or put a price on your judgment.

apps.name: SLAM TANK
apps.short_description: Swing your cannon barrel and ram straight through an AI’s machine army. A stylish single-player tank action game where the more you wreck, the more the AI pays.

apps.name: Slasher Manager
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

apps.name: Sleighline
apps.short_description: Every Christmas Eve, the same old job, in a much bigger world. Santa’s magic now bends time and opens portals, but the presents still go in by hand, so he flies low: over rooftops, through a pharaoh’s tomb, across the outback. Two buttons, seven courses, one perfect line: TRUE SANTA.

apps.name: Slimy Dude
apps.short_description: Slimy Dude is a hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a soldier, running from kingdom to kingdom against forces greater simply to escape his past. You will meet new allies, become stronger, uncover secrets and explore new environments.

apps.name: Sliz
apps.short_description: Sliz is a brutally simple platformer: jump, climb, and don’t fall. Fight your way to the very top past slippery, unforgiving obstacles — one wrong move can send you all the way back down. How far can you get? PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS ONLINE!

apps.name: Sloppy Warfare
apps.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

apps.name: Smile Thief
apps.short_description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

apps.name: Snipers & Airdrops
apps.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

apps.name: Solar Warden
apps.short_description: A Space Shooter / Real-Time Strategy hybrid. Command the Solar Warden space fleet from the real-time strategy overlay or choose to assume immediate control of any of your fleet directly and combat the Silicoid menace up close!

apps.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE
apps.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Build outrageous combos in a solitaire roguelike, then open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Install plugins, beat the quota and survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

apps.name: Something in the Rows
apps.short_description: First-person survival horror in a corn maze at night. Find the eight wards hidden across Halloway Farms and carry them to the chained gate. Every ward you take lets the Harvester closer. The maze is different every run. Play alone or with up to three friends online.

apps.name: SonaCraft – Instrument Repair
apps.short_description: Take over your great-aunt's old workshop and repair real instruments. Find the fault by ear, take a trumpet, guitar or snare drum apart in 3D, replace worn parts, tune and adjust – until it passes the sound test.

apps.name: Sort The Bunnies
apps.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

apps.name: Soulstonia
apps.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

apps.name: Sound Bounded
apps.short_description: Sound is everything. Explore a dark, misty world, activate mysterious crystals and survive a relentless hunter who sees through sound. Scream to run faster, stay quiet to hide, and use the environment to your advantage. Every noise has consequences.

apps.name: Space Arcade
apps.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

apps.name: Space Savory
apps.short_description:
Not that far away, in a galaxy…

A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness.

Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here.

(Only within the observable part.)

apps.name: SpacePorts
apps.short_description:
Build your fleet, master the market, and carve your own path among the stars.

Start with a modest ship, earn credits by transporting valuable cargo between stations, and expand your operations into a powerful interstellar empire.

Fair warning: this is a real idler, please read: About This Game

apps.name: Speed Golf Royale
apps.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

apps.name: SPEED OF LIGHT
apps.short_description: Start with a fragile ship drifting through deep space and evolve into a physics-defying machine. Upgrade thrusters, harvest particles, vaporize enemies, and race toward the speed of light in this action space incremental game.

apps.name: Spellomancer
apps.short_description: Battle your foes for enchanted letters using wacky weapons and earn points by constructing words in your team's spellbook in this new action platformer spell-em-up!

apps.name: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
apps.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

apps.name: Spellsmith
apps.short_description: Spellsmith is a pixel-art action RPG where you build your own spells, over 100 billion of them, and forge the worlds you fight through. Freeze lakes, crust lava, beat each dungeon's guardian and carry its core home to wake your Master's tower. Alone or with a friend online.

apps.name: SPINE
apps.short_description:
SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies.
Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

apps.name: Spirit of Diwata
apps.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

apps.name: Spirit Tide
apps.short_description:
Cast your line into the ocean in Spirit Tide, a simple 2D fishing simulator! Catch legendary fish, discover new species, earn coins, and upgrade your fishing rods. Explore exciting ocean events and see what awaits you beneath the waves! 
Available for only €0.99!

apps.name: Spooky's Playground
apps.short_description:
Spooky's Playground is an arcade-inspired Score Attack physics sandbox game where wreaking havoc is rewarded!
Complete challenges, find secrets and perfect your scores with each new run!

apps.name: Springs, Eternal
apps.short_description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

apps.name: Stable Champs
apps.short_description: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.

apps.name: Star Fire
apps.short_description: Star Fire is a large-scale sci-fi FPS currently in development. Up to 64 players wage war across land and air. Fight alongside your squad, pilot powerful vehicles and mechs, and command massive capital ships in an all-out war for the Solar System.

apps.name: Star Trek: Warp
apps.short_description:
Command the lanes. Control the outcome. 
Unlock iconic characters, starships, and locations as you play to complete objectives and earn legendary cards worthy of any captain's deck.

apps.name: STARE
apps.short_description: You are alone in an unfamiliar place that grows increasingly restless with your every step. Find and break all the seals before you draw too much attention...

apps.name: Starfall Defense
apps.short_description: Starfall Defense is a real-time multiplayer tower defense game blending ancient mythology with cosmic sci-fi. Deploy legendary heroes like Pangu and Nuwa, trigger class synergies, and fend off alien swarms! Features 2-player co-op and ranked PvP. Free to play, pure strategy!

apps.name: Starward Iron
apps.short_description: Hold Fort Resolute against alien assaults, or defend NORA's 15-minute code download inside the Cincture. A military sci-fi survival FPS with two AI squadmates, physical weapon racks, tactical movement and escalating enemy pressure.

apps.name: Starwinder
apps.short_description: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

apps.name: Static Maw
apps.short_description:
Something out there is trying to reach you.
Work alone as a night operator in a remote antenna facility lost in the void.
Repair broken transmitters and antennas using your computer and tools.
You are not alone. Will you respond?

apps.name: Static Signal
apps.short_description: Static Signal is an open world action horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?

apps.name: Steel Effigy
apps.short_description: Cleave through hordes of enslaved machines in this 1 to 4 player action-roguelite, hack n slash. Equip your Effigy with unique Items and Weapons to fight against The Barons and their machines. Upgrade your Weapons with powerful Augments to modify them and how they play.

apps.name: SteelFall
apps.short_description: Pilot a heavy mech and fight giant kaijus with your steel fists and an arsenal of ranged weapons. Punch, parry, shoot and hurl your way across a world overrun by monsters, in a third-person mecha brawler built on weight and impact.

apps.name: Stellar Smash
apps.short_description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

apps.name: Stone & Throne
apps.short_description: Dig beneath the mountain, march against its walls. Hook ore from the depths to fund your army, line your units across the hex battlefield, fuse the ones that stand together, and break fifteen fortress gates in a rogue-lite siege where what you mine below decides the war above.

apps.name: Stop The F
apps.short_description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle.
Use the camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back. 
Use various filters that expand the camera's abilities.

apps.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
apps.short_description: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

apps.name: Stormforge
apps.short_description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

apps.name: Streets of Fortuna
