apps.short_description: Survive in a giant simulated historical city. Grow from a street rat to a tradesman, a priest, a smuggler, an alchemist, a spy, or perhaps someday a leader to rival the Overlord. A free-roaming sandbox megasim RPG set in a fantasy Constantinople.

apps.name: Strip Bubbles: Maidens of the Castle of Lust
apps.short_description: Enter the Castle of Lust in this sensual dark fantasy arcade bubble shooter! Defeat 4 captivating maidens, strip them sphere by sphere, and unlock interactive private chambers featuring high-definition videos and intense, explicit climaxes.

apps.name: Strip Bubbles: Rich Ladies Club
apps.short_description: Enter the exclusive Rich Ladies Club! Challenge four powerful, ultra-wealthy heiresses in addictive bubble-shooter matches: a strict lawyer with forbidden desires, a casino countess, an innocent noblewoman seeking sin, and an oil princess. Master the art of high-society seduction.

apps.name: Sturmjäger
apps.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

apps.name: SubDuctis
apps.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

apps.name: Sudoku Unlimited
apps.short_description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

apps.name: Sumverse
apps.short_description: Power your spaceship with number puzzles in Sumverse. Swap and stack cores, match row and column totals, and connect numbers into an unbroken trail. Brave cosmic hazards, deliver troublesome cargo, and upgrade your ship as you save for a bigger family home.

apps.name: Sunset Painter
apps.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

apps.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
apps.short_description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

apps.name: Survivors' Hotel
apps.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

apps.name: Sussy NPC
apps.short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

apps.name: Sweet Manor
apps.short_description: Sweet Manor - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around a manor. Spend wonderful time with five pretty and cute maids in the manor, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Sylvaris: Black Reign
apps.short_description: A dark steampunk Metroidvania built around Overload, a combat system that runs on your own health. Burn your life for power, heal with every hit, and fight your way through a world of iron and machinery.

apps.name: Table Night
apps.short_description: A party board game where you can try anything. Write what you do, throw the dice, and a friend as game master or the game itself decides how it goes. Fire spreads, water rises, the map expands, and whoever dies comes back as a ghost to make things worse. from up to 1 to 8 players.

apps.name: Tabula
apps.short_description: A peculiar virus has taken root at the heart of the Tabula CS-1, a computer system that was lost to time. Alongside Little Bit, a newly-installed anti-virus, you are tasked with freeing the computer from the malware's clutches.

apps.name: Tachyon Flow
apps.short_description: Run around, traverse obstacle courses, and weave through environments creatively in this third person parkour runner!

apps.name: Taco Truck Simulator
apps.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

apps.name: Tactical Squad
apps.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player campaign, then settle the score in PvP.

apps.name: Tactical Terry
apps.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.

apps.name: Tactics Adrift
apps.short_description: A competitive turn-based tactics game with simultaneous planning.

apps.name: Tactics: Setting Sun
apps.short_description:
Tactics: Setting Sun is a turn-based strategy game centered around the Pacific Theater of World War II.
Equip and command your troops as you see fit.

Features multiplayer and single-player modes, an integrated map editor, and a rogue-like campaign.

apps.name: Tailgun
apps.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

apps.name: Tales Of Shadowland
apps.short_description: Experience the freedom of a classic RPG within a cutting-edge, free-to-play, open-world, multiplayer online experience. Explore, fight, collect, build, and conquer alongside your friends, and against your enemies, without any pay-to-win elements, all while immersing yourself in the story of Eurone.

apps.name: Tapis
apps.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points.  To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

apps.name: Task Bar Cube
apps.short_description: Task Bar Cube is an idle RPG playable either in full screen or directly from your taskbar. Upgrade your characters and pets, collect rare equipment, and discover dozens of different progression systems.

apps.name: Tavern Aftermath
apps.short_description: Royal soldiers ransacked your late father's tavern. Put 2,500 scattered things back where they belong, earn helpful abilities, and follow a hidden mage's notes to the secret the soldiers were after. A cozy first-person tidying game with no timers and no pressure.

apps.name: Taw Breaker
apps.short_description: Taw Breaker is a marble battle party game on which players fight on intense 1v1 duels while managing element types, powerups and obstacles you can place anywhere on the arena. Do you have what it takes to win in Taw Breaker?

apps.name: Tax Empire
apps.short_description: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

apps.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
apps.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

apps.name: TCG World
apps.short_description: Explore, build, collect Sprites, craft, farm, fish, race, and establish your place in a persistent open-world adventure.

apps.name: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced
apps.short_description: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced is a community-made mod focused on providing a new take on the TF2 experience by rebalancing and redefining its weapons and classes.

apps.name: Temporal Strike
apps.short_description: Time-loop defense shooter. Aim yourself or let your squad fire on auto as orcs, goblins, boar riders and mechs flood in. Spend the loot on a 38-node upgrade tree, unlock five units, beat the boss waves, then rewind time for permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Tenebrarium
apps.short_description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

apps.name: Tequila Moonrise
apps.short_description: Run a bar on the moon in this story-rich card game where choices matter. Build your character sheet and your deck, make drinks and deal with a daily dose of complications, all while balancing personal relationships, space politics and your own quest to rediscover your purpose.

apps.name: Terminal Depth
apps.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

apps.name: Terran Dawn
apps.short_description: An isometric sci-fi RTS of fleet command and orbital industry. Mine asteroids, grow a station from a single command core, research new technology and design your own ships module by module, then wage war across 84 branching missions, survival runs and online battles.

apps.name: That's My Village!
apps.short_description: A roguelite village builder. Assign jobs, feed your villagers and keep their morale high. Defend them from disasters and monster waves. When the horns sound, will your village hold?

apps.name: The 9th Dragon
apps.short_description: Fight your way through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City in a brutal, story-driven action game. Master intense melee combat, take down ruthless enemies, and uncover the dark secrets lurking within the city's walls.

apps.name: The Ant Game
apps.short_description: The Ant Game is a real-time colony sim with no floating cursor and no god's-eye view. You live in the dirt as a single ant while a whole colony runs around you: foraging by scent, digging its own nest, raising brood, and fighting beetles, spiders and rival colonies for the same patch of meadow.

apps.name: The Backrealms
apps.short_description: A dark-fantasy co-op horror game about delivering cursed artifacts through the medieval backrooms. Explore a mysterious dungeon realm in search of buyers... if you can survive what lurks inside.

apps.name: The Backrooms: Liminalphobia
apps.short_description: Liminalphobia is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game set in The Backrooms. A man named James is lost, leaving behind notes as the only guide to finding him. Explore the liminal levels, manage your resources, solve puzzles and avoid the entities throughout the levels.

apps.name: The Brave Few
apps.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

apps.name: THE CELLAR: Ashveil
apps.short_description: A story driven RPG about isolation, choice, and the struggle to define who you are. Explore a haunting parallel realm, fight abnormal creatures, and decide whether to follow a dark legacy or break free from it.

apps.name: The Circuit Alpha
apps.short_description: A tactical 3D fighting RPG with turn‑based, card‑driven combat. Build your fighter, craft powerful decks, and outthink opponents as you rise through a nonlinear combat‑sports career.

apps.name: The Citadel Project
apps.short_description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

apps.name: The Cozy Funemployment
apps.short_description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

apps.name: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
apps.short_description: A free 1v1 creature card battler with roguelike runs. Draft a line of real North American animals, plus a few cryptids. Play a card, make your swing, and watch the die TV decide how hard it lands while the booth calls every roll.

apps.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW
apps.short_description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

apps.name: The Edge Of - Definitive Edition
apps.short_description: The Edge Of is a tense mystery NTR visual novel that will keep you on The Edge Of your seat. Play as Sam, who suspects his wife, or Beth, who couldn't possibly be cheating... or is she? Now with reworked art, animated sex scenes, voice acting for Beth, new CGs, and a longer Beth route.

apps.name: The Gassal
apps.short_description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

apps.name: The Great 48
apps.short_description:
A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games.
Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! 
Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!

apps.name: The Great Sassanelli
apps.short_description: A war of unseen ferocity is ravaging the continent. You, ringmaster dilettante, must keep the circus afloat. Travel, entertain, and keep the troupe’s spirits up while trying to find a mythical safe haven to last out the storm in this beautifully illustrated, text-based narrative adventure.

apps.name: The Idle Undead
apps.short_description: The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse - Upgrade a base, recruit survivors, play minigames to boost your damage!

apps.name: The Impossible Dice Game
apps.short_description: 10 dice, each with a lower chance of success. Can you beat the odds, or will you roll enough to shift them to your favor?

apps.name: The Last Ledger
apps.short_description: The Last Ledger is a pawnshop management game that begins in war-torn Republican-era China. Examine antiques, spot fakes, bargain with customers, and profit from shifting markets. Check the newspaper for stolen goods, beware of suspicious items, and decide when to leave as war approaches.

apps.name: The Legend of Chalkvania
apps.short_description: The Legend of Chalkvania is a compact, open-world side-scrolling action RPG set in a storybook kingdom. Wander freely, hunt monsters, fish quiet waters, uncover hidden paths, meet peculiar locals or sit by the fire. Hoard gear, recover the shattered Sword of Grayscale and decide the world's fate.

apps.name: The Little Stomping Girl
apps.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

apps.name: The Lords' Game
apps.short_description: A grand strategy card game set in the fantasy world of Tolria. Raise your banner, build your deck and lead your chosen lord to victory in single player or multi player modes with up to eight players. Featuring nine factions, 1,000 cards, a full original soundtrack and original card art.

apps.name: The Mighty Eighth
apps.short_description: The Mighty 8th VR puts you in the shoes of a B-17 Flying Fortress crew member at the height of the Strategic Bombing Campaign over Europe. Partner up with friends and do your part to ensure that the plane reaches the target and returns home safely.

apps.name: The Millionth Ticket
apps.short_description: The Millionth Ticket is a lottery simulator: Buy tickets, pick numbers and watch live draws on TV. Manage your money and pay rent so your asshole landlord won't kick you out. Hit the jackpot and escape your shitty life to spend your days drinking and watching TV.

apps.name: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate
apps.short_description: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate is a story-driven adult visual novel about survival, desire, destiny, and the meaning of home. Guide Odysseus through a seductive reimagining of Greek myth filled with gods, monsters, romance, war, mystery, animated NSFW scenes, and a full gallery.

apps.name: The Peasants Are Coming!
apps.short_description: You are the nobility. They are everyone else. Tens of thousands of furious peasants pour down the roads at your granary, your treasury and your gate. Hire the watch, raise a circus, hang a few, and break their leaders before they reach your throne.

apps.name: The Phone from Another World: My First Love
apps.short_description:
If she’s truly gone…
Then who is answering the phone?

apps.name: The Plunge Of Sludge
apps.short_description: The Plunge Of Sludge is a 2D bullet hell roguelite where you collect trinkets, weapons, and hats from a pool of over 500+ items to conquer a dungeon and defeat THE KEEPER. You will fail and perish, but every attempt will be different and more chaotic than the last. Will you take the plunge?

apps.name: The Price of Empire
apps.short_description: Grand strategy on the real Earth: found your nation anywhere you like, build cities and mines, wage war with tanks and artillery and forge alliances – against up to 20 AI rivals or with friends. But every new territory comes at a price.

apps.name: The Remains
apps.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

apps.name: The Rotting Chronicles
apps.short_description: The Rotting Chronicles is a survival action game set in a zombie-ravaged city where you must fight, scavenge, craft, and rebuild to survive. Run solo or with up to 3 friends as you grow your survival skills and find the best strategy to survive.

apps.name: The Royal Restoration Society
apps.short_description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

apps.name: The Sea is Our Stage
apps.short_description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

apps.name: The Seventh Screening
apps.short_description: ESCAPE THE LIMELIGHT. Outsmart, outwit or outrun your demons in this cinematic first person survival horror.

apps.name: The Story of Noah
apps.short_description: Welcome to the captivating world of "The Story of Noah" — a journey for you and your children into ancient times and one of the most inspiring stories of the Holy Scriptures! Step into the role of Noah — the man chosen to build an ark and save his family and all animals from the great flood.

apps.name: The Undercity: Last Light
apps.short_description: Build an underground city in this 2D colony sim. Dig, connect production chains and manage workers whose needs can’t wait. Face earthquakes, make difficult choices and explore forgotten regions as you lead a refuge toward a future beyond survival.

apps.name: THE WASTE
apps.short_description: THE WASTE – a brutal and stylish action game about bloody street shootouts and survival in a city after a global collapse, where authority has fallen, and crime thrives. Two factions fight for control over the city, its resources, and survivors.

apps.name: TheDowsing / ダウジング
apps.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

apps.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
apps.short_description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

apps.name: Throw Weight: Fleet Doctrine
apps.short_description: Hard sci-fi fleet command. No shields, no lasers — just missiles, point defense and electronic warfare.

apps.name: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
apps.short_description: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

apps.name: Tiebreakers
apps.short_description: A SHONEN RUN N' GUN! Discover a heated run n' gun gameplay and challenging boss-fight tiebreaks. Shoot, Parry, and blast your way through intense encounters mastering a combat system about precision and movement. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn: push your limits, and come back stronger.

apps.name: TILEZ
apps.short_description: A 2D creative sandbox where every tile is a tiny machine. Inspired by Redstone, LEGO, and Tabletop Simulator.  Create and play solo or with friends.

apps.name: Time Stop Tower Defense
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

apps.name: Timeless Rain
apps.short_description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

apps.name: Tinker to the Moon
apps.short_description: Give your little invention a chance to do something wonderful. Tinker, take a leap, and feel the joy of getting a little further than before. A cozy flying adventure about small steps, happy accidents, and a dream as big as the Moon.

apps.name: Tiny Desk Pot
apps.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

apps.name: Tiny Pet Salon
apps.short_description: A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

apps.name: TOMIDER
apps.short_description: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.

apps.name: Total Loss
apps.short_description: Pile your mates into a clapped-out banger and slam on the brakes in front of traffic. Total Loss is a low-poly co-op comedy for 1-4 players: stage crashes, fling yourself under buses and claim for every bruise, then swap sides and avoid other chancers on your day job.

apps.name: Towa Powa
apps.short_description: Stack towers, make your own rules, and bring everyone into the same game — local and online. Take on a co-op campaign, create new modes, exploit unbalanced mechanics, share your creations through the Workshop, and relive your most epic matches.

apps.name: Tower of Genn
apps.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests, discover new interactions with special blocks, and uncover the history behind the sacred people of Genn.

apps.name: TowOrbs
apps.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

apps.name: Tragedy for Two
apps.short_description: Experience a 2-player asymmetric co-op horror game where you and a partner investigate the strange behavior of a theater's performers. Separated into different sections of the theater, communicate with your partner to complete your assignments and survive attacks from the supernatural performers.

apps.name: Trailblazers: Into the March
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

apps.name: Trenchhold TD
apps.short_description: Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, strengthen your forces through permanent upgrades, and launch full-scale counterattacks to crush their defenses!

apps.name: Troublemaker 3
apps.short_description: The Fight Comes from Anyone. Three years after Troublemaker 2, Jayakarta still stands under a long-standing political dynasty, but the people are starting to fight back. Citizens, stars, gangsters, and even those within the justice system unite in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

apps.name: TRY
apps.short_description: A quiet evening turns into something far more unsettling. What begins as a normal night at home slowly changes as strange events, memories, and unexplained encounters begin to unfold.

apps.name: TTT Classic
apps.short_description: A multiplayer social deduction shooter built on the GoldSrc engine. Investigate crime scenes as a Detective, deceive your friends as a Traitor, or fight to survive as an Innocent. Utilize forensic tools, set traps, and manage your Karma in this faithful GoldSrc demake.

apps.name: Two & Two: Agents
apps.short_description: Play as two secret agents investigating a scientist’s mysterious experiment. Communicate, exchange clues and solve cooperative puzzles where one agent has a piece and the other knows where it fits.

apps.name: Unbreakable Happy Ball
apps.short_description: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

apps.name: Unclean Hands
apps.short_description: A PS1-style horror card game. Play Durak against Slavic spirits in a bathhouse after midnight. They cheat. Catch them. Cheat back while they look away — alone or with up to three friends online. Lose, and you lose a finger.

apps.name: Under Canopies
apps.short_description: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

apps.name: Under the dead sun
apps.short_description: The Sun is dead. Humanity survives in eternal darkness. Awaken among the corpses as Nameless, guided by a living heart. Explore a dying world, master forbidden magic, and decide what future humanity deserves.

apps.name: Under the Rust
apps.short_description: Keep an underground shelter alive after the collapse. Manage water, power and food, assign your crew, and venture into a dangerous world above. Face desperate visitors, unexpected crises and decisions with lasting consequences in this post-apocalyptic survival management game.

apps.name: Unfree Freesia
apps.short_description: The Demo version of Unfree Freesia. A narrative-driven game where Deduction meets the Dark Arts. Invest crime scenes for evidence and navigate the razor's edge between "Rationality" and "Inspiration." Unlock branching paths through your choices, and decide who survives the encroaching shadows.

apps.name: UnGodly
apps.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

apps.name: Unique Sword
apps.short_description: Assemble one-of-a-kind flying swords from all kinds of blades and parts, draw the Sword Intent each one flies, and deploy your lineup against waves of monsters. Beyond the campaign, the Tower of Trials, the Sword Tomb and an Endless Mode await — and yes, even a rubber chicken can be a sword.

apps.name: UNSTITCHED
apps.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

apps.name: Unyha
apps.short_description: Unyha is the first-ever autochronicle online RPG, where your adventures, victories, and defeats become real stories that influence the game for all, and forever. History content is generated by Unyha's unique Autochronicle AI, making it truly aware of players' activity—and naturally responds to it.

apps.name: Usual June
apps.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

apps.name: Utterance
apps.short_description: Utterance is a Lovecraftian Western roguelite deckbuilder where you chart your own path through a corrupted world. Build a deck of letters, forge words, and battle creatures that twist your deck, your rules, and your sanity.

apps.name: Val Fortuna
apps.short_description:
A tactical roguelite deckbuilder played on a checkerboard, set in the world of casinos.
You are the Gambler. Tonight, you’re playing for your life.
Read your opponent’s moves, go for the one combo too many, and go all in when everything falls apart.
What happens in Val Fortuna stays in Val Fortuna.

apps.name: Valenya Online
apps.short_description: Find your place in a shared world. Dodge attacks, craft your gear and trade with other players in this free 2D MMORPG. Six classes, party dungeons and adventures to build together. No subscription. Cosmetic-only purchases.

apps.name: Valken
apps.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

apps.name: Valoria
apps.short_description: A top-down survival RPG set in a pixel-art medieval countryside. Sow fields, breed livestock, mine and smelt ore, brew potions, and raise a homestead wall by wall. Fight what comes out after dark, plunder ruined watchtowers, explore the realm of Valoria.

apps.name: Vampolitics: Vassal of the Void
apps.short_description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

apps.name: Vanguard Fusion
apps.short_description: Merge three units into one and hold the line in a pixel-art auto-battler with tower defense. The Fusion Heart is shattered, and every creature in Eldvar has broken into furious shards. 24 heroes, 5 biomes, Endless mode and a brutal Boss Rush.

apps.name: VectorForce
apps.short_description: Arm yourselves as ace agents and engage in high-octane light-gun action in this retro-inspired arcade rail shooter. Take on a ruthless criminal organisation shooting down waves of enemies and challenging bosses that will put your reflexes to the test while the city is on the brink of crisis.

apps.name: Veiled Legions: Fantasy Strategy Board Game
apps.short_description: Lead a hidden army in a tactical board game of bluff and deduction. Your rival can't see your units until combat when clashes become animated duels. Outwit a bot, a Steam friend, or an online rival and seize the enemy Relic.

apps.name: Vibin' & Survivin'
apps.short_description: Vibin’ & Survivin’ is an action-packed sci-fi horde survivor roguelike where you unleash cosmic firepower against endless waves of alien foes. Craft game-changing builds, evolve 24 unique weapons, and harness the power of the Vibe Web to conquer chaotic space arenas!

apps.name: VOIDRUSH
apps.short_description: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.

apps.name: Voidwood
apps.short_description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away.  By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

apps.name: Voltform
apps.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city.

apps.name: Voxel Playground
apps.short_description: A highly moddable destructible physics sandbox. Built for VR and non-VR.

apps.name: Vroomity Loops
apps.short_description: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

apps.name: Wall Over
apps.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

apps.name: Wanderer of Spaces
apps.short_description: A lighthearted first-person puzzle game based on real architectural designs. Dive into the inner world of an architect, travel through realistic and imaginary spaces, and experience the architect's career from the beginning to self-fulfillment.

apps.name: War Asunder
apps.short_description:
Remember the card game War? A casual deckbuilder roguelite based on War, but adds tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades. 
Fight the multiplying creatures, cleanse the corrupted realm and confront the Warlock King to stop the Asunder spell at its source.

apps.name: War on Mars
apps.short_description: War on Mars - become the commander of a war battalion and test your skills on the battlefield. Tame the hateful bloodthirsty beasts without putting your troops at risk. Show off your leadership skills and become a world-class commander.

apps.name: War Tactics
apps.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

apps.name: War: Weaponary and Resources
apps.short_description: A top-down RTS for you and your friends, with armies in the thousands. Dig through rock, wall off chokepoints and hide bombs, then throw everything at your rivals' HQ. Every match is a new cave map. Online multiplayer only for now; AI opponents are planned.

apps.name: Warden Campaigns
apps.short_description: Build the world. Run the table. Let it react. Warden Campaigns is an all-in-one VTT where Game Masters create campaigns, build reactive encounters, automate consequences, and host their party through Steam.

apps.name: Wardspire
apps.short_description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

apps.name: Warlapse
apps.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

apps.name: Warstead
apps.short_description: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

apps.name: Water TD
apps.short_description: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

apps.name: We Harvest Shadows
apps.short_description: A single-player, first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

apps.name: We Took That Trip
apps.short_description: A cozy road trip adventure about friendship, loss, and reunion.  Drive and customize your van as you journey down ever-changing roads through idyllic landscapes. Meet unforgettable travelers and uncover heartfelt stories along the way, with your feline companion by your side.

apps.name: We'll Meet Again
apps.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

apps.name: WEAPONS FREE
apps.short_description: WEAPONS FREE is a tactical CQB shooter in the bodycam and helmetcam perspectives. This game prioritizes challenging AI, unpredictable scenarios, and immersion. WEAPONS FREE includes realistic combat, true-to-life bodycam, interaction with civilians, and multiple levels with their own unique feel.

apps.name: WendyQuest
apps.short_description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

apps.name: Wet Streets 💧
apps.short_description: Kenzie’s surprise was clear when she walked in the aftermath of the midnight rain. The streets were dead except for one lonely soul. A soul as hot and horny as her own! In no time at all, the two latex lovers get the streets dirty all over again! A rain is coming, but this time, it’s hot and steamy!

apps.name: Wetherell Farm Saga
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art farming sim in a New England village with something asleep in its woods. Inherit a farm, grow, fish, mine and befriend twelve neighbors. Then follow some of them into the trees on the new moon: stop the ritual, help it, join it, or just keep farming. Horror: full, mild or off.

apps.name: Where the Hell Is My Game?
apps.short_description: Dig through piles of trash to find your lost game cartridge. Collect trash, discover rare items and collectible cards, sell valuables, and buy upgrades to make every search faster and easier. Each new trash pile costs money, so spend wisely and keep digging.

apps.name: Where the Seeds Fall
apps.short_description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

apps.name: Where the Veil Thins
apps.short_description: A monster taming JRPG where your creatures are your cards. Bond over 200 of them, build a deck, and outplay rival summoners with face-down wards and a board that rewards planning. The Imperium is recruiting, cadet. Serve well, and never ask what the Veil is hiding.

apps.name: Whispers of Orange Island
apps.short_description: Love stealth? Discover a fresh take with escort-based stealth, unique tools, and characters with lives, relationships, and stories instead of faceless obstacles. Love story and lore? Explore rich optional narrative and uncover 100 years of history, secrets, and entwined lives on Orange Island.

apps.name: Who Howls?
apps.short_description: Werewolf in a walkable, snowbound 3D village. By day, search for tracks and whisper behind the barn. At dusk, accuse and vote by the campfire. At night, the wolves creep from house to house. Online with 4–16 friends and proximity voice chat.

apps.name: WILD DECK
apps.short_description: Wild Deck is a fast-paced asymmetric hide-and-seek action game where a group of players transform into animals, choosing their form from random cards, while a single armed hunter tries to track them all down and eliminate them.

apps.name: WILDLOTUS荒原幻想
apps.short_description:
This work is a secondary creative game work with the theme of Oriental project.

The game type is the survival sandbox class.

Many players are online to collect all kinds of materials and improve their combat ability

apps.name: Wilds - Night Zookeeper
apps.short_description: Let your imagination run Wilds! From the BAFTA nominated team at Night Zookeeper, Wilds is an online adventure bound only by the limits of your creativity. Create characters, bring them to life, and embark on your own adventure in fast paced multiplayer action.

apps.name: Will You Be My Disciple?
apps.short_description: Will You Be My Disciple? is a choice-driven cult management game shaped by unexpected encounters and characters.

apps.name: Winter Resort Simulator 3
apps.short_description: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

apps.name: Winterover
apps.short_description: A cinematic narrative where you are astronaut NATALIE RAMIREZ. Face time-critical & emotional decisions leading a breakthrough discovery on Mars, while your family is in crisis on Earth. Explore freely, shape relationships through branching dialogue, and face a choice that will define your future.

apps.name: Wizzy the Wood
apps.short_description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

apps.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
apps.short_description:
Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends.
In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

apps.name: Wolcen 2
apps.short_description: Many years after Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, return to a world on the brink of collapse. Master brutal combat, build your character without fixed classes, combine skills and gear, and unleash your Shadow Form in this dark fantasy Action RPG. Play alone or in co-op.

apps.name: Wonder Glider
apps.short_description: A paraglider roguelite on a summer coast where the clouds don't always stay clouds. Every trial ends at nightfall, and there's no flying around it. Choose what you carry, change it at every Shrine, and keep something for the dark. How far will it carry you?

apps.name: WORJONG
apps.short_description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

apps.name: Workshop Keeper
apps.short_description: You bought the cheapest plot of land in town. Then the first tax bill arrived. Gather, craft, automate — link your workshops into a trade network, ship goods across the sea, and get rich enough to show the City-State who's boss.

apps.name: Workshop Valley
apps.short_description: Chop logs, saw planks, and carve little wooden helpers who take over the hauling and crafting. Grow a small, legible production chain — no conveyor belts — sell your wares at the market stall, and bring the valley fair back to life. A cozy automation game with an actual ending.

apps.name: World Of Arena
apps.short_description: This game is an Open World RPG, where you venture into a world to find combat portals and platformers, to get stronger and fight the final boss!!v

apps.name: WoundWake
apps.short_description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption

apps.name: Wren Falls
apps.short_description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

apps.name: Wylde Society
apps.short_description: Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

apps.name: XPELLIT
apps.short_description: A story-driven anime survivors-like. Samara wakes up with no memories in the Eternal Forest: carve through hordes with evolving Xpells, live through events and missions that change every run, and face Mirelle in a cinematic three-phase final battle.

apps.name: Yatai Master
apps.short_description: Cook, serve, and connect with customers while managing a traditional Japanese yatai in a cozy narrative experience about food, community, and legacy.

apps.name: Yollen 2
apps.short_description: Automate your grind. Make your character run through the chain of nodes you programmed while leveling up, all the way to defeat Yollen on the Red Mountains.

apps.name: You Have Been Deleted
apps.short_description: You Have Been Deleted is a first-person survival horror inspired by the early internet and the 90s, all packaged in a surreal retro art style. Trapped within a corrupted virtual reality made by the company you work for, you must Uncover, Hack, and Survive if you ever wish to free yourself from hell.

apps.name: You've Changed
apps.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

apps.name: Your Friend's Mom 2
apps.short_description: 💕 Your new desktop companion is the mom of one of your Steam friends! Chat with her, spark a romance, and customize her look. Play mini-games, solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock photos, invite friends for online co-op, choose pets, and explore tons of handy tools! 🥵

apps.name: Zanerdin: The Unbound
apps.short_description: Zanerdin: The Unbound is a strategy-driven, hero-collecting turn-based RPG where every choice—from your heroes’ action order and party composition to your card and equipment loadouts—is yours to make.

apps.name: Zero Castle
apps.short_description: Take control of a unique flying castle, destroy enemy forces, build your playstyle with powerful upgrades, and survive every cycle.

apps.name: Zero To South
apps.short_description: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.

apps.name: Ziii
apps.short_description: Ziii is a retro fantasy action-adventure game.  Sail between countless islands, exploring their various elemental lands in top-down and sidescroll styles.  Plunder their dungeons for powerful items and precious relics.  Ziii is a treasure-hunter, looking to gain a treasure vault value of 100,000.

apps.name: Zone Nova
apps.short_description: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

apps.name: Zup! Arena
apps.short_description: Zup! Arena is a multiplayer arcade game in which you have to fight with other players! Throw off all your opponents from the battlefield and become the "King of the mountain". Play alone or in a group with friends!

apps.name: Пока помню
apps.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

apps.name: つみみじかん～狂オシイホド愛シテル～
apps.short_description: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 15-day psychological horror adventure.

apps.name: カスペナ～カスタムペナント野球
apps.short_description: Draft prospects, develop your players and build a championship club. Set lineups, negotiate contracts and manage your budget in this baseball management sim. Discover hidden prospects, invest in your town and customize your league. Watch games without direct player control.

apps.name: クライムライト／CRYMELIGHT
apps.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

apps.name: ゴニンカン-津軽トランプゲーム-
apps.short_description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

apps.name: ドラマライク アドベンチャー『本と鍵の季節』
apps.short_description: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

apps.name: ハムスタイピング！
apps.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

apps.name: 亡灵苏生
apps.short_description: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.

apps.name: 伊莉亚娜公主的坠落之夜~她已不再属于你~
apps.short_description: After the Demon King is defeated, hero Edmond rescues Princess Ilyana. With his fall, the balance of power unravels and darkness returns. As hidden schemes arise, you become her guardian. Will you guide her through the shadows to a brighter future?

apps.name: 侠不义·昙花一线
apps.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

apps.name: 古玩掌柜
apps.short_description: Antique Dealer is a card collecting and strategy game with 600+ antique cards from ten Chinese dynasties. Leave it running and a beautiful new card arrives every half hour. For a challenge, play the built-in card game of genuine and fake cards, and outplay rival dealers with knowledge and strategy.

apps.name: 叫魂JIAOHUN
apps.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

apps.name: 喵星档案 Meow Star Archives
apps.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

apps.name: 女神养成：放置型 / Goddess Cultivation: Idle RPG
apps.short_description: Goddess Cultivation: Idle RPG is a fantasy idle JRPG. Summon goddesses, forge bonds, fight goblins & minotaurs, and uncover a conspiracy. It blends turn-based combat, collection & customization, balancing tactics with relaxed offline growth.

apps.name: 工場見学→
apps.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

apps.name: 廃墟の盾と虚空の槍 ～Unity Sanctuary.
apps.short_description:
This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.”
Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

apps.name: 执笔人
apps.short_description: An ink-wash xianxia action game. You are your sect's most worthless disciple — spirit energy leaks right out of you. Then you learn the one technique only you can use: clash blades at the instant steel meets steel and take your enemy's power. Every win becomes a unique ink painting.

apps.name: 抽号小队
apps.short_description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

apps.name: 掌中帝国 HANDSET HQ
apps.short_description: A phone company management sim. Pick a shape, swap materials, or draw the outline yourself, then develop, test, and sell it. Every change instantly shifts the cost and how buyers react. Grow a tiny startup into a phone giant, as long as people actually buy what you build.

apps.name: 数织艺术
apps.short_description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

apps.name: 江湖一牌：无情武林 / Ace of Jianghu
apps.short_description:
Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another.
Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult. Become one of four and step into a jianghu of hidden currents. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts. Your road changes who you meet and the story.
In the jianghu, a man is just a card.

apps.name: 海陆空四国大战
apps.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

apps.name: 淫御天下
apps.short_description: 在《淫御天下》中，你将以皇帝之身统御天下，游走于宫廷权谋、与后宫情感之间。安定后宫风格各异的爱妃，与邻国结交同盟，通过深思熟虑的策略选择，打造一个属于你的“以淫为本”的盛世王朝。

apps.name: 狩人ハ闇夜ヲ餐ウ
apps.short_description: Casual Horror Action RPG "NIGHT DEVOURESS" – Exorcism? Physical is trending!

apps.name: 珠宝之王
apps.short_description: Run a vintage jewelry business: hunt for bargains, haggle, appraise and sell to the right customer. Build your collection from thousands of pieces, balance stock against the bills, and solve 500 jewelry puzzles to earn new treasures.

apps.name: 直面天命
apps.short_description: Face Your Fate is a pixel-art deckbuilding adventure inspired by Eastern mythology. Choose Combat Cards, combine Fate Cards and gear, chain effects, parry deadly attacks, break enemy defenses, and adapt your build across randomized routes, bosses, and ever-harder cycles.

apps.name: 空想心理戦防護課程
apps.short_description: A first-person exam simulator: pass by observing, remembering and deducing.

apps.name: 西游：云行散记
apps.short_description: Journey to the West: Cloudborne Journal is a dark action RPG reimagining the classic myth. Play as one of four Chaos Monkeys, uncover the pilgrimage’s dark truth, assemble a cross-faction party, and forge your demon-slaying legend through visceral combat and strategic progression.

apps.name: 解呈尋
apps.short_description: A seven-day university psychological romance visual novel. Make dialogue choices and play Minesweeper while events elsewhere unfold, whether you witness them or not.

apps.name: 货与刀
apps.short_description:
You cannot have both fish and bear's paw.Arrange your cargo and supplies wisely in your inventory.
Survive this journey.Bring enough goods to avoid a wasted trip, and become the legendary Escort King.

apps.name: 雪月の星霜
apps.short_description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

apps.name: 이직
apps.short_description: Fight for a better job in this pixel-art action roguelite. Wield four office weapons, combine Specs, and train after hours. Start at a tiny startup and climb toward bigger companies, where familiar coworkers and office machines reveal monstrous forms.

apps.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽
apps.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: years after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks. By day, an absurdly ordinary army routine. After lights-out, search the base while avoiding “him”, who is still awake. A first-person comedy-horror adventure over three days in the Korean army.
